02---areas/docker/dockerfile/01---instru.title: 01 · Dockerfile Instructions Reference
02---areas/docker/dockerfile/01---instru.content:
01 · Dockerfile Instructions Reference
← 🐳 Docker MOC

Tổng quan nhanh





































































































InstructionKhi nào chạyTạo layerMục đíchFROMBuildKhôngChọn base imageRUNBuildCóChạy lệnh shellCOPYBuildCóCopy files vào imageADDBuildCóCopy + extract/downloadWORKDIRBuildKhôngSet working directoryENVBuild + RuntimeKhôngBiến môi trườngARGBuild onlyKhôngBiến build-timeEXPOSEDocumentationKhôngKhai báo portVOLUMERuntimeKhôngMount pointUSERBuild + RuntimeKhôngSwitch userLABELBuildKhôngMetadataCMDRuntimeKhôngLệnh mặc địnhENTRYPOINTRuntimeKhôngLệnh chínhHEALTHCHECKRuntimeKhôngHealth monitoringONBUILDChild build—Trigger cho child image

FROM — Base Image
# Cú pháp
FROM <image>[:<tag>]
FROM <image>@<digest>       # Pin by hash (immutable)
 
# Ví dụ
FROM ubuntu:22.04
FROM node:18-alpine
FROM python:3.11-slim
FROM scratch                # Empty image (for Go binaries)
Lựa chọn tag:
# ❌ Tránh — thay đổi theo thời gian
FROM node:latest
FROM python:3
 
# ✅ Pin major.minor (stable nhưng vẫn nhận patches)
FROM node:18-alpine
FROM python:3.11-slim
 
# ✅ Pin exact version (most reproducible)
FROM node:18.17.0-alpine3.18
FROM python:3.11.4-slim-bookworm
Dùng với ARG:
ARG NODE_VERSION=18
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine

WORKDIR — Working Directory
WORKDIR /app
WORKDIR /usr/src/app
WORKDIR ./subdir          # Relative to previous WORKDIR

Tự động tạo thư mục nếu chưa tồn tại
Ảnh hưởng đến: RUN, CMD, ENTRYPOINT, COPY, ADD
Tốt hơn RUN cd /app vì persistent

FROM node:18-alpine
 
WORKDIR /app
# Bây giờ đang ở /app
 
COPY package.json .
# → /app/package.json
 
WORKDIR logs
# Bây giờ đang ở /app/logs

COPY — Copy Files
# Cú pháp
COPY <src>... <dest>
COPY ["<src>",... "<dest>"]  # Cho paths có spaces
 
# Ví dụ
COPY package.json .
COPY package*.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/
COPY . .
COPY --chown=node:node . .   # Với ownership
Best practice — tách dependencies và source:
# ✅ Tận dụng cache
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./    # Layer 1: dependencies
RUN npm ci --only=production              # Layer 2: install (cached)
COPY --chown=node:node . .                # Layer 3: source code
 
# ❌ Mất cache mỗi lần code thay đổi
COPY . .
RUN npm install
COPY từ stage khác (Multi-stage):
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=nginx:alpine /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/

ADD — Copy với tính năng thêm
# Giải nén tự động (chỉ local tar)
ADD app.tar.gz /app/
 
# Copy từ URL (KHÔNG giải nén)
ADD example.com/file.zip /tmp/
 
# Thông thường
ADD config.txt /app/


                  
                   Dùng COPY thay ADD
                  
                

Chỉ dùng ADD khi cần giải nén tar tự động.
Với URLs: dùng RUN curl hoặc RUN wget để có cache control tốt hơn.



RUN — Chạy lệnh khi Build
# Shell form (chạy qua /bin/sh -c)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl
 
# Exec form (không qua shell)
RUN ["apt-get", "install", "-y", "curl"]
 
# Multi-line với \
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        curl \
        vim \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
BuildKit cache mount:
# Cache npm packages (không lưu vào image)
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm \
    npm ci
 
# Cache pip packages
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/pip \
    pip install -r requirements.txt
 
# Cache apt packages
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt \
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl

ENV — Environment Variables
# Cú pháp
ENV KEY=value
ENV KEY1=value1 KEY2=value2    # Multiple in one instruction
 
# Ví dụ
ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT=3000
ENV APP_HOME=/app
 
# Multi-line
ENV NODE_ENV=production \
    PORT=3000 \
    LOG_LEVEL=info

Tồn tại trong cả build và runtime
Có thể override khi run: docker run -e PORT=8080 myapp
Sử dụng: $VAR hoặc ${VAR}

ENV APP_HOME=/app
WORKDIR $APP_HOME     # /app
COPY . $APP_HOME      # /app


                  
                   Bảo mật
                  
                

Không đặt secrets trong ENV — visible qua docker inspect!



ARG — Build-time Variables
ARG VERSION=1.0.0           # Với default
ARG BUILD_DATE              # Không default
ARG NODE_VERSION=18
 
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine
 
ARG APP_ENV=production       # Phải khai báo lại sau FROM
ENV NODE_ENV=${APP_ENV}     # Convert ARG → ENV cho runtime
# Override khi build
docker build --build-arg NODE_VERSION=20 -t myapp .
docker build --build-arg BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d) -t myapp .






























ARGENVBuild time✅✅Runtime❌✅Override--build-arg-eTrong history⚠️ Có⚠️ Có


                  
                   ARG trong image history
                  
                

docker history --no-trunc myimage có thể thấy ARG values.
Không dùng ARG cho secrets!



CMD — Lệnh mặc định
# Exec form (KHUYÊN DÙNG)
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
 
# Shell form (có thể bị override signal)
CMD node server.js
 
# Cung cấp args cho ENTRYPOINT
CMD ["--port", "3000"]

Chỉ một CMD có hiệu lực (CMD cuối cùng)
Dễ override: docker run myapp python other.py
Kết hợp với ENTRYPOINT: CMD cung cấp args mặc định


ENTRYPOINT — Lệnh chính
# Exec form (KHUYÊN DÙNG)
ENTRYPOINT ["node", "server.js"]
ENTRYPOINT ["python"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/entrypoint.sh"]
 
# Shell form (TRÁNH — signal issue)
ENTRYPOINT node server.js
Kết hợp ENTRYPOINT + CMD:
ENTRYPOINT ["python"]    # Lệnh chính — khó override
CMD ["app.py"]           # Args mặc định — dễ override
docker run myapp              # python app.py
docker run myapp other.py     # python other.py  (override CMD)
docker run --entrypoint sh myapp  # override ENTRYPOINT






























CMDENTRYPOINTOverridedocker run myapp CMD--entrypoint CMDDễ override✅ Rất dễ❌ Khó hơnUse caseLệnh thay đổi đượcContainer như executablePID 1Là PID 1 (exec form)Là PID 1 (exec form)

EXPOSE — Khai báo Port
EXPOSE 3000
EXPOSE 8080/tcp
EXPOSE 53/udp
EXPOSE 80 443          # Multiple ports


                  
                   EXPOSE chỉ là documentation
                  
                

Không tự động mở port. Cần -p hoặc -P khi docker run.


docker run -p 3000:3000 myapp     # Map cụ thể
docker run -P myapp               # Auto-map tất cả EXPOSE ports

VOLUME — Mount Point
VOLUME /data
VOLUME ["/var/log", "/var/db"]


                  
                  Tip
                  
                

Nên dùng named volume khi docker run thay vì dựa vào VOLUME directive:
docker run -v mydata:/data myapp



USER — Switch User
# Dùng username
USER node
USER appuser
 
# Dùng UID:GID
USER 1000:1000
 
# Cú pháp đầy đủ
USER <user>[:<group>]
USER <UID>[:<GID>]
# Pattern chuẩn
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 appuser
COPY --chown=appuser:appuser . .
USER appuser
CMD ["./app"]

LABEL — Metadata
LABEL maintainer="dev@example.com" \
      version="1.0.0" \
      description="My Application" \
      org.opencontainers.image.source="github.com/user/repo" \
      org.opencontainers.image.created="2024-01-01"
# Xem labels
docker inspect --format='{{json .Config.Labels}}' myapp | jq

HEALTHCHECK — Health Monitoring
HEALTHCHECK [OPTIONS] CMD <command>
HEALTHCHECK NONE          # Disable inherited healthcheck
 
# Options:
# --interval=30s    (mặc định: 30s)
# --timeout=30s     (mặc định: 30s)
# --start-period=0s (grace period khi startup)
# --retries=3       (số lần retry trước khi unhealthy)
# HTTP endpoint check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1
 
# Script check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s \
    CMD python healthcheck.py || exit 1
 
# wget (không cần curl)
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s \
    CMD wget --quiet --tries=1 --spider http://localhost/ || exit 1
 
# Node.js inline
HEALTHCHECK CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health', (r) => {process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)})"
# Xem health status
docker ps                          # Cột STATUS: (healthy) / (unhealthy)
docker inspect --format='{{json .State.Health}}' mycontainer | jq

Xem thêm

02 - Multi-stage Builds — COPY —from, multiple FROM
03 - Best Practices — Tối ưu sắp xếp instructions
../theory/01 - Fundamentals — CMD vs ENTRYPOINT signals
../theory/05 - Security — USER và secrets best practices

02---areas/docker/dockerfile/02---multi-.title: 02 · Multi-stage Builds
02---areas/docker/dockerfile/02---multi-.content:
02 · Multi-stage Builds
← 🐳 Docker MOC

Tại sao cần Multi-stage?
Vấn đề: Image production chứa toàn bộ build tools → rất lớn và không an toàn.
# ❌ Single stage — ~1.2GB, chứa dev tools, source code
FROM node:18
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install    # Bao gồm devDependencies
RUN npm run build
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
Giải pháp Multi-stage: Dùng nhiều FROM, chỉ copy artifacts cần thiết sang image cuối.
# ✅ Multi-stage — ~120MB, chỉ runtime + compiled code
FROM node:18-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
 
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]

Cú pháp cơ bản
# Stage có tên
FROM <image> AS <stage-name>
 
# Copy từ stage khác
COPY --from=<stage-name> <src> <dest>
COPY --from=0 <src> <dest>          # Theo index (0-based)
 
# Copy từ external image (không cần stage)
COPY --from=nginx:alpine /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/
 
# Build đến stage cụ thể
docker build --target <stage-name> -t myapp .

So sánh kích thước






























ApproachNode.jsGoSingle stage (full)~1.1GB~800MBSingle stage (slim)~450MB—Multi-stage (alpine)~130MB~15MBMulti-stage (scratch)—~5MB

Ví dụ 1: Node.js / TypeScript App
# Stage 1: Install production dependencies
FROM node:18-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
 
# Stage 2: Build (needs devDependencies)
FROM node:18-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci                    # All dependencies
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/
RUN npm run build
 
# Stage 3: Production (minimal)
FROM node:18-alpine AS production
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs && adduser -S nodejs -u 1001
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps --chown=nodejs:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder --chown=nodejs:nodejs /app/dist ./dist
USER nodejs
ENV NODE_ENV=production
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s \
    CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
docker build -t myapp:latest .
docker images myapp  # ~120-150MB

Ví dụ 2: React App → Nginx
# Stage 1: Build React
FROM node:18-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY public/ ./public/
COPY src/ ./src/
RUN npm run build      # → /app/build/
 
# Stage 2: Serve với Nginx (~25MB total!)
FROM nginx:alpine
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY --from=builder /app/build /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
nginx.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;
 
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }
 
    location /health {
        return 200 "OK\n";
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
    }
}

Ví dụ 3: Go Binary → Scratch (~5MB)
# Stage 1: Build static binary
FROM golang:1.21-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /build
RUN apk add --no-cache git ca-certificates
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux \
    go build -ldflags="-w -s" -o app ./cmd/server
 
# Stage 2: Scratch image — chỉ có binary!
FROM scratch
COPY --from=builder /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/
COPY --from=builder /build/app /app
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]

Ví dụ 4: Python với Build Dependencies
# Stage 1: Build (có gcc, build tools)
FROM python:3.11 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        gcc g++ make libpq-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --user --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
 
# Stage 2: Runtime (slim, không có build tools)
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /root/.local /root/.local
ENV PATH=/root/.local/bin:$PATH
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 appuser
COPY --chown=appuser:appuser . .
USER appuser
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

Ví dụ 5: Multiple Targets (Dev + Prod)
# Base chung
FROM node:18-alpine AS base
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
 
# Development — hot reload
FROM base AS development
RUN npm install           # All deps including dev
COPY . .
ENV NODE_ENV=development
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["npm", "run", "dev"]
 
# Test — chạy tests
FROM base AS test
RUN npm install
COPY . .
RUN npm test
 
# Builder
FROM base AS builder
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
 
# Production — minimal
FROM node:18-alpine AS production
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs && adduser -S nodejs -u 1001
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=base /app/node_modules ./node_modules  # reuse from base
USER nodejs
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
# Build target cụ thể
docker build --target development -t myapp:dev .
docker build --target test -t myapp:test .
docker build --target production -t myapp:prod .
 
# Mặc định build stage cuối cùng
docker build -t myapp .

Ví dụ 6: Java / Maven
# Stage 1: Build với Maven
FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17 AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY pom.xml .
RUN mvn dependency:go-offline -q    # Cache dependencies
COPY src ./src
RUN mvn package -DskipTests -q
 
# Stage 2: Runtime với JRE only
FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /build/target/*.jar app.jar
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S javagroup && adduser -S javauser -u 1001 -G javagroup
USER javauser
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/actuator/health || exit 1
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]

Copy từ External Images
FROM ubuntu:22.04
 
# Lấy binary từ image khác — không cần build
COPY --from=golang:1.21-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/bin/go
COPY --from=node:18-alpine /usr/local/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node
 
# Lấy config từ image khác
COPY --from=nginx:alpine /etc/nginx /etc/nginx

Debug Multi-stage Builds
# Build đến stage trung gian để inspect
docker build --target builder -t myapp:debug .
docker run --rm -it myapp:debug sh
 
# Xem layers của từng stage
docker history myapp:debug
docker history myapp:latest
 
# So sánh size
docker images | grep myapp

Best Practices
# ✅ Đặt tên stage rõ ràng
FROM node:18 AS deps        # deps, builder, production
FROM node:18 AS build-stage # Hoặc descriptive names
 
# ✅ Chia dependencies theo stage (deps riêng để tận dụng cache)
FROM base AS deps
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
 
FROM base AS builder
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
 
# ✅ Dùng ARG cho version flexibility
ARG NODE_VERSION=18
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine AS builder
 
# ✅ Copy chỉ những gì cần thiết vào production stage
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist        # ✅ Specific
# COPY --from=builder /app .               # ❌ Quá nhiều

02---areas/docker/dockerfile/03---best-p.title: 03 · Dockerfile Best Practices
02---areas/docker/dockerfile/03---best-p.content:
03 · Dockerfile Best Practices
← 🐳 Docker MOC

Production-Ready Checklist
🔒 Security

 Dùng non-root user (USER instruction)
 Không hardcode secrets (passwords, API keys)
 Pin base image version cụ thể (không dùng latest)
 Dùng multi-stage để loại bỏ build tools
 Scan vulnerabilities với Trivy / Docker Scout
 .dockerignore ngăn copy .env, .git, secrets

📦 Size Optimization

 Dùng base image nhỏ (alpine, slim, distroless)
 Multi-stage builds
 Xóa cache trong cùng RUN layer
 .dockerignore loại trừ node_modules, __pycache__, .git

⚡ Build Speed

 Sắp xếp layers: ít thay đổi → hay thay đổi
 Copy dependency files trước source code
 Dùng BuildKit cache mounts (--mount=type=cache)
 Enable BuildKit: export DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1

🔧 Maintainability

 LABEL với maintainer, version, description
 Pin dependency versions (requirements.txt, package-lock.json)
 Dùng HEALTHCHECK
 Comment những phần không rõ ràng
 Exec form cho CMD/ENTRYPOINT

🏃 Runtime

 HEALTHCHECK endpoint
 Exec form CMD ["node", "app.js"] (không phải shell form)
 EXPOSE đúng port
 Config qua ENV (không hardcode)


1. Layer Ordering — Stable → Volatile
FROM node:18-alpine
 
WORKDIR /app
 
# 1️⃣ Ít thay đổi nhất: build configs
COPY tsconfig.json .eslintrc.js ./
 
# 2️⃣ Thay đổi khi thêm package
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
 
# 3️⃣ Rebuild khi package thay đổi
RUN npm ci --only=production
 
# 4️⃣ Hay thay đổi nhất: source code
COPY src/ ./src/
 
# 5️⃣ Rebuild khi source thay đổi
RUN npm run build
 
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
# ✅ Python — đúng thứ tự
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
 
# ❌ Sai — mất cache mỗi lần code thay đổi
COPY . .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt

2. Combine RUN commands
# ❌ 4 layers riêng biệt — tốn space, apt cache còn trong layer 2
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y curl
RUN apt-get install -y vim
RUN rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 
# ✅ 1 layer, cleanup trong cùng RUN
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        curl \
        vim \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

3. Exec Form cho CMD/ENTRYPOINT
# ❌ Shell form — signal handling issues, shell là PID 1
CMD npm start
CMD python app.py
ENTRYPOINT python app.py
 
# ✅ Exec form — app là PID 1, nhận SIGTERM đúng cách
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
ENTRYPOINT ["python", "app.py"]

4. Không dùng latest Tag
# ❌ Không reproducible
FROM node:latest
FROM python:3
 
# ✅ Pin exact minor version
FROM node:18-alpine
FROM python:3.11-slim
 
# ✅ Pin exact patch (most strict)
FROM node:18.17.1-alpine3.18
FROM python:3.11.5-slim-bookworm

5. Non-root User
# ✅ Node.js — dùng user có sẵn
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --chown=node:node package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY --chown=node:node . .
USER node
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
 
# ✅ Python / Alpine — tạo user mới
FROM python:3.11-alpine
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S appgroup && \
    adduser -S appuser -u 1001 -G appgroup -H
WORKDIR /app
COPY --chown=appuser:appgroup . .
USER appuser
CMD ["python", "app.py"]

6. .dockerignore Đầy đủ
# Node.js
node_modules/
npm-debug.log
.npm/

# Python
__pycache__/
*.py[cod]
*.egg-info/
venv/
.venv/
.pytest_cache/

# Build outputs
dist/
build/
*.o
*.a

# Version control
.git/
.gitignore
.gitattributes

# IDE
.vscode/
.idea/
*.swp
*.swo

# Tests
tests/
test/
coverage/
*.test.js

# Documentation
*.md
docs/

# CI/CD
.github/
.gitlab-ci.yml
Jenkinsfile

# Logs & temp
*.log
logs/
tmp/
.cache/

# OS
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# SECURITY — không bao giờ copy vào image
.env
.env.*
*.pem
*.key
*.crt
secrets/


7. COPY specific files, không COPY . .
# ❌ Vô tình copy file nhạy cảm hoặc không cần thiết
COPY . .
 
# ✅ Explicit — chỉ copy những gì cần
COPY src/ ./src/
COPY public/ ./public/
COPY package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json ./

8. Xóa cache trong cùng layer
# ❌ apt cache còn trong layer 1, layer 2 không thể xóa được
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl
RUN rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 
# ✅ Xóa trong cùng RUN
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 
# Alpine
RUN apk add --no-cache curl vim
 
# pip
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
 
# npm
RUN npm ci --only=production && npm cache clean --force

9. LABEL Metadata
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GIT_COMMIT
 
LABEL maintainer="dev@example.com" \
      org.opencontainers.image.title="My App" \
      org.opencontainers.image.description="Production API server" \
      org.opencontainers.image.version="1.0.0" \
      org.opencontainers.image.created="${BUILD_DATE}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.revision="${GIT_COMMIT}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.source="github.com/org/repo"
docker build \
  --build-arg BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) \
  --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) \
  -t myapp:1.0.0 .

10. Tools — Lint & Analyze
Hadolint — Dockerfile Linter
# Fedora: cài hadolint
sudo dnf5 install hadolint
 
# Hoặc dùng Docker
docker run --rm -i hadolint/hadolint < Dockerfile
 
# Lint với custom config
cat > .hadolint.yaml << EOF
ignore:
  - DL3008   # Pin versions in apt
  - DL3018   # Pin versions in apk
EOF
hadolint Dockerfile
Dive — Layer Analyzer
# Cài dive
sudo dnf5 install dive
 
# Analyze image
dive myapp:latest
 
# CI mode — kiểm tra wasted space
CI=true dive myapp:latest
 
# Output: Image efficiency score: 95%
Trivy — Vulnerability Scanner
# Cài Trivy
sudo dnf5 install trivy
 
# Scan image
trivy image myapp:latest
 
# Chỉ HIGH/CRITICAL
trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL myapp:latest
 
# Scan Dockerfile cho misconfigurations
trivy config Dockerfile

Xem thêm

04 - Production Patterns — Complete production Dockerfiles

02---areas/docker/dockerfile/04---produc.title: 04 · Production Patterns
02---areas/docker/dockerfile/04---produc.content:
04 · Production Patterns
← 🐳 Docker MOC

Pattern 1: Web API (Node.js — Stateless)
Use case: REST API, GraphQL, microservice
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
ARG NODE_VERSION=18
 
# Stage 1: Production dependencies only
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm \
    npm ci --only=production
 
# Stage 2: Build (TypeScript compile)
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY package.json tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/
RUN npm run build
 
# Stage 3: Production runtime
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine
RUN apk add --no-cache tini
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs && adduser -S nodejs -u 1001
 
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps    --chown=nodejs:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder --chown=nodejs:nodejs /app/dist         ./dist
 
ENV NODE_ENV=production PORT=3000
USER nodejs
EXPOSE 3000
 
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
    CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1
 
ENTRYPOINT ["/sbin/tini", "--"]
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
Key features: multi-stage, tini init, non-root, health check, BuildKit cache mounts.

Pattern 2: Python Web App (FastAPI / Flask)
FROM python:3.11-slim AS base
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1
 
WORKDIR /app
 
# Stage: Builder (compile native extensions)
FROM base AS builder
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc python3-dev libpq-dev && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --user --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
 
# Stage: Production
FROM base
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dumb-init && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 -s /sbin/nologin appuser
 
COPY --from=builder /root/.local /root/.local
ENV PATH=/root/.local/bin:$PATH
 
COPY --chown=appuser:appuser . .
USER appuser
 
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=15s --retries=3 \
    CMD python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/health')" || exit 1
 
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--workers", "4"]

Pattern 3: Background Worker
Use case: Message queue consumer, job processor, Celery worker
FROM python:3.11-slim AS base
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1
WORKDIR /app
 
FROM base AS builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --user --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
 
FROM base
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dumb-init && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 worker
 
COPY --from=builder /root/.local /root/.local
ENV PATH=/root/.local/bin:$PATH
 
WORKDIR /app
COPY --chown=worker:worker . .
USER worker
 
# Config qua ENV
ENV WORKER_CONCURRENCY=4 \
    REDIS_URL="" \
    QUEUE_NAME="default"
 
# Không EXPOSE (không phải HTTP server)
# Health check qua script
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=30s \
    CMD python worker_healthcheck.py || exit 1
 
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]
CMD ["celery", "-A", "tasks", "worker", "--loglevel=info"]
worker_healthcheck.py:
import redis, os, sys
try:
    r = redis.from_url(os.environ['REDIS_URL'])
    r.ping()
    sys.exit(0)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(1)

Pattern 4: Scheduled Job / CronJob
Use case: Backup jobs, data sync, cleanup tasks — chạy và thoát
FROM golang:1.21-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -ldflags="-w -s" -o job ./cmd/job
 
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN apk --no-cache add ca-certificates tzdata
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S appgroup && adduser -S appuser -u 1001 -G appgroup
 
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder --chown=appuser:appgroup /build/job .
USER appuser
 
# Không cần EXPOSE (không HTTP)
# Không cần HEALTHCHECK (chạy một lần rồi thoát)
ENV TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh
 
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/job"]
# Chạy một lần (CronJob pattern)
docker run --rm \
    -e DATABASE_URL=postgres://... \
    myjob:latest
 
# Dùng Systemd timer trên Fedora (thay cron)
# Xem: man systemd.timer

Pattern 5: Static Site — React/Vue → Nginx
# Build
FROM node:18-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build    # → /app/dist/
 
# Production (~25MB)
FROM nginx:1.25-alpine
RUN rm -rf /usr/share/nginx/html/*
 
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
 
# Non-root nginx
RUN chown -R nginx:nginx /usr/share/nginx/html \
    /var/cache/nginx /var/log/nginx \
    && touch /var/run/nginx.pid \
    && chown nginx:nginx /var/run/nginx.pid
 
USER nginx
EXPOSE 8080
 
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s \
    CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1
 
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
nginx.conf (non-root port 8080):
server {
    listen 8080;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;
 
    gzip on;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript;
 
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }
 
    location /health {
        access_log off;
        return 200 "OK\n";
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
    }
 
    location ~* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg|woff2)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }
}

Pattern 6: Database Migration Container
Use case: Init container chạy migrations trước khi app start
FROM python:3.11-slim
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-client netcat-openbsd && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /migrations
COPY migrations/ ./
COPY wait-for-db.sh migrate.sh ./
RUN chmod +x wait-for-db.sh migrate.sh
 
ENV DATABASE_URL="" DB_HOST="" DB_PORT=5432 MAX_WAIT=60
 
# Run once and exit
ENTRYPOINT ["./migrate.sh"]
migrate.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
 
echo "Waiting for database at $DB_HOST:$DB_PORT..."
timeout "$MAX_WAIT" bash -c \
    "until nc -z $DB_HOST $DB_PORT; do sleep 2; echo 'waiting...'; done"
 
echo "Running migrations..."
psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f all_migrations.sql
 
echo "✅ Migrations complete"
exit 0
# Chạy migration trước app
docker run --rm \
    -e DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@db/myapp \
    -e DB_HOST=db \
    mymigration:latest
 
# Sau đó start app
docker run -d myapp:latest

Common Mistakes to Avoid
# ❌ 1. Shell form CMD — SIGTERM không tới app
CMD npm start
 
# ✅ Fix
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
 
# ❌ 2. Chạy với root
FROM node:18
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "app.js"]
 
# ✅ Fix
FROM node:18
COPY --chown=node:node . .
USER node
CMD ["node", "app.js"]
 
# ❌ 3. Secrets trong ENV
ENV DB_PASSWORD=secret123
 
# ✅ Fix — set tại runtime
# docker run -e DB_PASSWORD=secret myapp
# hoặc --env-file .env
 
# ❌ 4. Không có healthcheck
FROM python:3.11
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
 
# ✅ Fix
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD python healthcheck.py || exit 1
 
# ❌ 5. Lưu data trong container
RUN mkdir /app/uploads
 
# ✅ Fix — external storage (S3, volume)
VOLUME /app/uploads  # hoặc dùng env: S3_BUCKET

02---areas/docker/dockerfile/05---advanc.title: 05 · Advanced Techniques
02---areas/docker/dockerfile/05---advanc.content:
05 · Advanced Techniques
← 🐳 Docker MOC

1. BuildKit — Enable
BuildKit là build engine hiện đại của Docker với nhiều tính năng nâng cao:
# Cách 1: Per-command
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build -t myapp .
 
# Cách 2: Permanent (thêm vào ~/.bashrc)
export DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1
 
# Cách 3: Docker daemon config
# /etc/docker/daemon.json
{ "features": { "buildkit": true } }
 
# Cách 4: Dùng BuildKit syntax directive trong Dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1


                  
                   Podman / Buildah
                  
                

Podman dùng Buildah làm build backend — hầu hết BuildKit features được hỗ trợ tự nhiên:
podman build --layers -t myapp .



2. Cache Mounts — Giữ cache giữa các builds
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
 
FROM node:18-alpine
 
# npm cache được giữ lại giữa các lần build
# Cache KHÔNG được copy vào image
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm \
    npm ci --only=production
 
# pip cache
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/pip \
    pip install -r requirements.txt
 
# apt cache
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt,sharing=locked \
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl
 
# Go module cache
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    go mod download
 
# Maven cache
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.m2 \
    mvn dependency:go-offline
Kết quả: Build lần 2 trở đi nhanh hơn đáng kể vì packages được cache trên host.

3. Secret Mounts — Secrets an toàn trong build
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM alpine
 
# Secret KHÔNG được lưu vào image history!
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=aws_creds \
    AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/run/secrets/aws_creds \
    aws s3 cp s3://private-bucket/file.txt .
 
# Dùng pip với private PyPI
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=pip_config,dst=/root/.pip/pip.conf \
    pip install --no-cache-dir private-package
# Build với secret
docker build \
    --secret id=aws_creds,src=$HOME/.aws/credentials \
    --secret id=pip_config,src=./pip.conf \
    -t myapp .

4. SSH Mounts — Clone private repos
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM golang:1.21-alpine
 
RUN --mount=type=ssh \
    go env -w GOPRIVATE="github.com/myorg/*" && \
    go mod download
# Build với SSH agent forwarding
eval $(ssh-agent)
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa
docker build --ssh default -t myapp .

5. Bind Mounts trong RUN
# Mount file từ host vào build context — KHÔNG copy vào image
RUN --mount=type=bind,source=scripts/setup.sh,target=/setup.sh \
    sh /setup.sh

6. Heredoc Syntax (BuildKit)
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM alpine
 
# Tạo file inline
COPY <<EOF /app/config.json
{
  "server": "localhost",
  "port": 3000,
  "debug": false
}
EOF
 
# Multi-line RUN
RUN <<EOF
apk add --no-cache curl wget
curl -o /tmp/file.tar.gz example.com/file.tar.gz
tar xzf /tmp/file.tar.gz -C /app
rm /tmp/file.tar.gz
EOF
 
# Python script inline
RUN python3 <<PYEOF
import json
config = {"version": "1.0", "env": "production"}
with open('/app/build-config.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(config, f)
PYEOF

7. Multi-platform Builds — Buildx
Setup
# Tạo builder hỗ trợ multi-platform
docker buildx create --name multiplatform --use --bootstrap
docker buildx ls
 
# Inspect builder
docker buildx inspect --bootstrap
Build
# Build cho platform cụ thể
docker build --platform linux/arm64 -t myapp:arm64 .
docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t myapp:amd64 .
 
# Build và push nhiều platforms (cần registry)
docker buildx build \
    --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7 \
    --push \
    -t myregistry/myapp:latest .
 
# Build local (không push) — chỉ dùng 1 platform
docker buildx build \
    --platform linux/amd64 \
    --load \
    -t myapp:latest .
Trong Dockerfile
# Platform-specific base image
FROM --platform=linux/amd64 node:18-alpine AS builder-amd64
FROM --platform=linux/arm64 node:18-alpine AS builder-arm64
 
# Detect platform với ARG
ARG TARGETPLATFORM
ARG BUILDPLATFORM
RUN echo "Building on $BUILDPLATFORM for $TARGETPLATFORM"


                  
                   Fedora ARM64 (nếu dùng RPi / Apple Silicon)
                  
                

# Enable QEMU emulation cho cross-build
sudo dnf5 install qemu-user-static
docker run --rm --privileged multiarch/qemu-user-static --reset -p yes
docker buildx create --use --name multi
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --push -t myapp .



8. BuildKit Parallel Stages
BuildKit tự động chạy các stages không có dependency song song:
FROM base AS deps-python
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
 
FROM base AS deps-node
RUN npm ci
 
FROM base AS deps-go
RUN go mod download
 
# Stage này đợi tất cả deps stages xong
FROM final AS production
COPY --from=deps-python /root/.local /root/.local
COPY --from=deps-node /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=deps-go /go/pkg/mod ./pkg/mod
# Xem build graph
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --progress=plain -t myapp . 2>&1 | grep "#"

9. ONBUILD — Trigger cho Child Images
# base-node/Dockerfile — dùng làm parent image
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
 
# Các lệnh này TỰ ĐỘNG chạy khi có Dockerfile khác FROM image này
ONBUILD COPY package*.json ./
ONBUILD RUN npm ci --only=production
ONBUILD COPY . .
ONBUILD CMD ["node", "server.js"]
# myapp/Dockerfile — không cần viết gì nhiều
FROM myorg/base-node:latest
# ONBUILD triggers tự động chạy ở đây!
# Tự động: COPY package.json, npm ci, COPY ., CMD node server.js


                  
                   Ít dùng trong thực tế
                  
                

ONBUILD gây khó debug và không minh bạch. Chỉ dùng khi tạo parent images cho team dùng chung.



10. Inline Cache — Cache từ Registry
# Build và export cache lên registry
docker buildx build \
    --cache-to type=registry,ref=myregistry/myapp:cache \
    --cache-from type=registry,ref=myregistry/myapp:cache \
    --push \
    -t myregistry/myapp:latest .
 
# Build dùng cache từ registry (CI/CD)
docker build \
    --cache-from myregistry/myapp:latest \
    -t myapp:new .

11. Build Arguments cho Flexibility
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
ARG BASE_IMAGE=node:18-alpine
ARG BUILD_ENV=production
ARG APP_VERSION=unknown
ARG GIT_COMMIT=unknown
ARG BUILD_DATE=unknown
 
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}
 
ARG BUILD_ENV
ARG APP_VERSION GIT_COMMIT BUILD_DATE
 
ENV NODE_ENV=${BUILD_ENV}
 
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.version="${APP_VERSION}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.revision="${GIT_COMMIT}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.created="${BUILD_DATE}"
# Build script
docker build \
    --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=node:20-alpine \
    --build-arg APP_VERSION=$(cat VERSION) \
    --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) \
    --build-arg BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) \
    -t myapp:$(cat VERSION) .

12. Output Types — Export Build Results
# Load vào local Docker images (default)
docker buildx build --load -t myapp .
 
# Push lên registry
docker buildx build --push -t myregistry/myapp:latest .
 
# Export ra tar file
docker buildx build --output type=docker,dest=myapp.tar -t myapp .
 
# Export filesystem (không có image metadata)
docker buildx build --output type=local,dest=./output .
 
# OCI format
docker buildx build --output type=oci,dest=myapp-oci.tar .

Xem thêm

02 - Multi-stage Builds — Parallel stages
../theory/02 - Image Layers & Cache — Cache concepts
../operations/02 - Registry & Images — Registry & pushing images

02---areas/docker/example-nodejs/readme.title: Ví dụ Node.js với Docker
02---areas/docker/example-nodejs/readme.content:
Ví dụ Node.js với Docker
Mô tả
Ứng dụng Node.js đơn giản sử dụng Express framework, chạy trong Docker container.
Cấu trúc file
example-nodejs/
├── Dockerfile          # File cấu hình Docker
├── package.json        # Dependencies của Node.js
├── index.js           # File chính của ứng dụng
├── .dockerignore      # File loại trừ khi build
└── README.md          # File này

Cách sử dụng
1. Build Docker image
cd example-nodejs
docker build -t nodejs-app .
2. Chạy container
# Chạy và xem output
docker run -p 3000:3000 nodejs-app
 
# Hoặc chạy ở background
docker run -d -p 3000:3000 --name my-nodejs-app nodejs-app
3. Kiểm tra ứng dụng
Mở trình duyệt và truy cập:

Trang chủ: http://localhost:3000
Health check: http://localhost:3000/health

4. Xem logs
docker logs my-nodejs-app
docker logs -f my-nodejs-app  # Theo dõi real-time
5. Dừng và xóa container
docker stop my-nodejs-app
docker rm my-nodejs-app
Giải thích Dockerfile
FROM node:18-alpine
# Sử dụng Node.js 18 với Alpine (nhỏ gọn ~150MB thay vì ~900MB)
 
WORKDIR /app
# Tạo và di chuyển vào thư mục /app
 
COPY package*.json ./
# Sao chép package.json trước để tận dụng Docker cache
 
RUN npm install
# Cài đặt dependencies
 
COPY . .
# Sao chép toàn bộ source code
 
ENV NODE_ENV=production
# Thiết lập biến môi trường
 
EXPOSE 3000
# Khai báo port (chỉ là documentation)
 
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
# Lệnh chạy khi container khởi động
Tips

Thêm dependencies mới: Cập nhật package.json, sau đó rebuild image
Development mode: Mount volume để không cần rebuild mỗi lần thay đổi code
docker run -p 3000:3000 -v $(pwd):/app nodejs-app

02---areas/docker/example-python/readme.title: Ví dụ Python Flask với Docker
02---areas/docker/example-python/readme.content:
Ví dụ Python Flask với Docker
Mô tả
Ứng dụng web Python đơn giản sử dụng Flask framework, chạy trong Docker container.
Cấu trúc file
example-python/
├── Dockerfile          # File cấu hình Docker
├── requirements.txt    # Dependencies của Python
├── app.py             # File chính của ứng dụng
├── .dockerignore      # File loại trừ khi build
└── README.md          # File này

Cách sử dụng
1. Build Docker image
cd example-python
docker build -t python-app .
2. Chạy container
# Chạy và xem output
docker run -p 8000:8000 python-app
 
# Hoặc chạy ở background
docker run -d -p 8000:8000 --name my-python-app python-app
3. Kiểm tra ứng dụng
Mở trình duyệt và truy cập:

Trang chủ: http://localhost:8000
Health check: http://localhost:8000/health

4. Xem logs
docker logs my-python-app
docker logs -f my-python-app  # Theo dõi real-time
5. Dừng và xóa container
docker stop my-python-app
docker rm my-python-app
Giải thích Dockerfile
FROM python:3.9-alpine
# Sử dụng Python 3.9 với Alpine (nhỏ gọn ~50MB thay vì ~900MB)
 
WORKDIR /app
# Tạo và di chuyển vào thư mục /app
 
COPY requirements.txt .
# Sao chép file requirements.txt trước
 
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
# Cài đặt Python packages (--no-cache-dir để giảm kích thước)
 
COPY . .
# Sao chép toàn bộ source code
 
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
# Không buffer output (xem logs real-time)
 
EXPOSE 8000
# Khai báo port
 
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
# Lệnh chạy ứng dụng
Tips

Thêm dependencies mới: Cập nhật requirements.txt, sau đó rebuild image
Development mode: Mount volume
docker run -p 8000:8000 -v $(pwd):/app python-app

Sử dụng Flask debug mode: Thêm -e FLASK_DEBUG=1
docker run -p 8000:8000 -e FLASK_DEBUG=1 python-app

02---areas/docker/example-static/readme.title: Ví dụ Website Tĩnh với Nginx và Docker
02---areas/docker/example-static/readme.content:
Ví dụ Website Tĩnh với Nginx và Docker
Mô tả
Website tĩnh (HTML/CSS/JS) được phục vụ bởi Nginx web server trong Docker container.
Cấu trúc file
example-static/
├── Dockerfile          # File cấu hình Docker
├── index.html         # Trang web chính
├── .dockerignore      # File loại trừ khi build
└── README.md          # File này

Cách sử dụng
1. Build Docker image
cd example-static
docker build -t static-website .
2. Chạy container
# Chạy và xem output
docker run -p 8080:80 static-website
 
# Hoặc chạy ở background
docker run -d -p 8080:80 --name my-website static-website
3. Kiểm tra website
Mở trình duyệt và truy cập: http://localhost:8080
4. Dừng và xóa container
docker stop my-website
docker rm my-website
Giải thích Dockerfile
FROM nginx:alpine
# Sử dụng Nginx với Alpine (cực kỳ nhỏ gọn ~23MB)
 
RUN rm -rf /usr/share/nginx/html/*
# Xóa nội dung mặc định của Nginx
 
COPY . /usr/share/nginx/html
# Sao chép website vào thư mục public của Nginx
 
EXPOSE 80
# Khai báo port 80 (HTTP)
 
# Nginx sẽ tự động chạy, không cần CMD
Tùy chỉnh Nginx
Nếu cần cấu hình Nginx tùy chỉnh, tạo file nginx.conf:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name localhost;
    
    location / {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        index index.html;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }
    
    # Cache static files
    location ~* \.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|ico|css|js)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }
}
Sau đó thêm vào Dockerfile:
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
Tips

Cực kỳ nhỏ gọn: Image chỉ ~25-30MB
Nhanh: Nginx rất hiệu quả cho static files
Production-ready: Nginx là web server dành cho production
SSL/HTTPS: Có thể thêm certificates và cấu hình HTTPS

Use cases

Landing pages
Documentation sites
Single Page Applications (React, Vue, Angular)
Portfolio websites
Marketing websites

02---areas/docker/operations/01---docker.title: 01 · Docker Compose
02---areas/docker/operations/01---docker.content:
01 · Docker Compose
← 🐳 Docker MOC

Docker Compose là gì?
Docker Compose là tool để định nghĩa và chạy multi-container applications bằng một file YAML duy nhất.
# Một lệnh thay vì nhiều docker run
docker compose up -d
 
# Dừng và xóa tất cả
docker compose down
 
# Podman Compose
podman compose up -d
sudo dnf5 install podman-compose  # Nếu chưa có

Cấu trúc file Compose
# docker-compose.yml
version: "3.9"   # Có thể bỏ nếu dùng Compose V2
 
services:         # Định nghĩa các containers
  web:
    image: nginx
  api:
    build: .
 
networks:         # Networks (optional, mặc định có 1 network)
  frontend:
  backend:
 
volumes:          # Named volumes
  dbdata:
  redis-data:
 
configs:          # Config files (Swarm mode)
secrets:          # Secrets (Swarm mode)

Ví dụ 1: Full Stack App (API + DB + Redis + Nginx)
version: "3.9"
 
services:
 
  # ─── Database ───────────────────────────────────────
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: myapp
      POSTGRES_USER: appuser
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./init-db:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
    networks:
      - backend
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U appuser -d myapp"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
 
  # ─── Cache ──────────────────────────────────────────
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    networks:
      - backend
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
 
  # ─── API Server ─────────────────────────────────────
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: production
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://appuser:${DB_PASSWORD}@postgres/myapp
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: 3000
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - frontend
      - backend
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 15s
      retries: 3
 
  # ─── Reverse Proxy ──────────────────────────────────
  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./nginx/certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - frontend
 
volumes:
  pgdata:
  redis-data:
 
networks:
  frontend:
  backend:
    internal: true   # Backend không có internet access
.env file:
DB_PASSWORD=supersecretpassword
COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=myapp
# Chạy với env file
docker compose --env-file .env up -d
 
# Xem logs
docker compose logs -f api
 
# Scale api
docker compose up -d --scale api=3

Ví dụ 2: Development Stack với Hot Reload
version: "3.9"
 
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      target: development    # Build dev stage
    volumes:
      - ./src:/app/src:Z    # Hot reload (SELinux safe)
      - /app/node_modules   # Preserve node_modules trong container
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      - "9229:9229"         # Node.js debugger
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@db/devdb
    depends_on:
      - db
 
  db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: devdb
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"         # Expose cho local DB clients
    volumes:
      - pgdata-dev:/var/lib/postgresql/data
 
volumes:
  pgdata-dev:


                  
                   SELinux trên Fedora
                  
                

Thêm :Z cho bind mounts: ./src:/app/src:Z
Với Podman Compose: tương tự, cần :Z



Compose File Reference
build — Build từ Dockerfile
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: .              # Build context directory
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.prod
      target: production      # Multi-stage target
      args:
        NODE_VERSION: "18"
        BUILD_DATE: "2024-01-01"
      cache_from:
        - myregistry/api:latest
      labels:
        app: "myapi"
environment và .env
services:
  api:
    environment:
      # Explicit value
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: 3000
      # Lấy từ host environment
      API_KEY:              # Nếu host có API_KEY, dùng giá trị đó
      DATABASE_URL: ${DB_URL}  # Từ .env file
    env_file:
      - .env                # Load tất cả từ .env file
      - .env.local          # Override (nếu tồn tại)
depends_on — Service Dependencies
services:
  api:
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy    # Đợi healthcheck pass
      redis:
        condition: service_started    # Chỉ đợi started
      migration:
        condition: service_completed_successfully  # Đợi exit 0
volumes — Mount Types
services:
  api:
    volumes:
      # Named volume
      - appdata:/app/data
 
      # Bind mount (absolute path)
      - /host/path:/container/path:ro
 
      # Bind mount (relative path)
      - ./config:/app/config:ro
 
      # Bind mount với SELinux (Fedora!)
      - ./src:/app/src:Z
 
      # tmpfs
      - type: tmpfs
        target: /app/tmp
        tmpfs:
          size: 100m
networks — Network Config
services:
  api:
    networks:
      frontend:
        aliases:
          - api-service    # DNS alias trong network này
      backend:
 
networks:
  frontend:
    driver: bridge
  backend:
    driver: bridge
    internal: true          # Không có internet
  shared:
    external: true          # Dùng network đã có sẵn
    name: my-existing-net
healthcheck
services:
  api:
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      # test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s          # Kiểm tra mỗi 30s
      timeout: 10s           # Timeout 10s
      start_period: 40s      # Grace period khi startup
      retries: 3             # Retry 3 lần trước khi unhealthy
      disable: false
deploy — Resource Limits (Compose V3)
services:
  api:
    deploy:
      replicas: 2
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: "1.0"
          memory: 512M
        reservations:
          cpus: "0.5"
          memory: 256M
      restart_policy:
        condition: on-failure
        max_attempts: 3

Compose Commands
# Start
docker compose up                    # Foreground
docker compose up -d                 # Detached (background)
docker compose up --build            # Rebuild images trước
docker compose up --force-recreate   # Recreate containers
 
# Stop
docker compose down                  # Stop + remove containers + networks
docker compose down -v               # Cũng xóa volumes!
docker compose stop                  # Stop nhưng giữ containers
 
# Logs
docker compose logs                  # Tất cả services
docker compose logs -f api           # Follow một service
docker compose logs --tail 50 api    # Last 50 lines
 
# Exec
docker compose exec api sh           # Interactive shell
docker compose exec db psql -U appuser myapp
 
# Scale
docker compose up -d --scale api=3  # 3 instances của api
 
# Status
docker compose ps
docker compose top                   # Processes trong containers
 
# Build
docker compose build api             # Build specific service
docker compose build --no-cache      # Build không cache
 
# Pull
docker compose pull                  # Pull tất cả images mới nhất
 
# Run one-off command
docker compose run --rm api python manage.py migrate
docker compose run --rm api sh
 
# Config validation
docker compose config                # Xem merged config
docker compose config --quiet        # Validate không output

Override Files
# docker-compose.yml         = base (production defaults)
# docker-compose.override.yml = local overrides (auto-loaded)
# docker-compose.dev.yml     = dev overrides (manual)
# docker-compose.prod.yml    = prod overrides (manual)
 
# Development (auto-loads override.yml)
docker compose up
 
# Production
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
 
# Custom file
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
docker-compose.override.yml (development):
services:
  api:
    build:
      target: development
    volumes:
      - ./src:/app/src:Z
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development
    ports:
      - "9229:9229"    # Debugger

Podman Compose (Fedora)
# Cài Podman Compose
sudo dnf5 install podman-compose
 
# Sử dụng (cú pháp giống Docker Compose)
podman compose up -d
podman compose logs -f
podman compose down
 
# Lưu ý: Podman Compose dùng Podman network
# - Không cần daemon
# - Rootless by default
# - SELinux labels cho volumes là bắt buộc

Xem thêm

../theory/03 - Networking — Docker networks
../theory/04 - Volumes & Storage — Volume management
../theory/05 - Security — Secrets trong Compose

02---areas/docker/operations/02---regist.title: 02 · Registry & Images
02---areas/docker/operations/02---regist.content:
02 · Registry & Images
← 🐳 Docker MOC

Image Naming Convention
[registry/][namespace/]repository[:tag][@digest]

Ví dụ:
nginx                                 → docker.io/library/nginx:latest
node:18-alpine                        → docker.io/library/node:18-alpine
myuser/myapp:1.0.0                    → docker.io/myuser/myapp:1.0.0
ghcr.io/myorg/myapp:latest            → GitHub Container Registry
registry.example.com/team/myapp:v2   → Private registry


Docker Hub (Registry mặc định)
# Đăng nhập
docker login
docker login -u myusername  # Interactive nhập password
 
# Logout
docker logout
 
# Tìm kiếm image
docker search nginx
docker search --filter is-official=true node
 
# Pull image
docker pull nginx
docker pull nginx:1.25-alpine
docker pull nginx@sha256:abc123...  # Pin by digest (immutable!)
 
# Push image
docker tag myapp myusername/myapp:1.0.0
docker push myusername/myapp:1.0.0
docker push myusername/myapp:latest
 
# Podman
podman login docker.io
podman pull nginx
podman push myusername/myapp:1.0.0

GitHub Container Registry (GHCR)
# Login với Personal Access Token
echo $GITHUB_TOKEN | docker login ghcr.io -u USERNAME --password-stdin
 
# Tag và push
docker tag myapp ghcr.io/myorg/myapp:1.0.0
docker push ghcr.io/myorg/myapp:1.0.0
 
# Pull
docker pull ghcr.io/myorg/myapp:1.0.0
 
# Podman
echo $GITHUB_TOKEN | podman login ghcr.io -u USERNAME --password-stdin
podman push ghcr.io/myorg/myapp:1.0.0
Đặt image public/private: GitHub → Package → Settings → Visibility

Private Registry
Self-hosted Registry
# Chạy local registry
docker run -d \
    --name registry \
    --restart always \
    -p 5000:5000 \
    -v registry-data:/var/lib/registry \
    registry:2
 
# Push vào local registry
docker tag myapp localhost:5000/myapp:1.0.0
docker push localhost:5000/myapp:1.0.0
 
# Pull từ local registry
docker pull localhost:5000/myapp:1.0.0
 
# List images trong registry
curl http://localhost:5000/v2/_catalog
curl http://localhost:5000/v2/myapp/tags/list
Insecure Registry (cho development)
// /etc/docker/daemon.json
{
  "insecure-registries": ["localhost:5000", "192.168.1.100:5000"]
}
sudo systemctl restart docker
 
# Podman — /etc/containers/registries.conf
# [[registry]]
# location = "localhost:5000"
# insecure = true

Image Tagging Strategy
Semantic Versioning (Khuyên dùng)
MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
1.0.0 → 1.0.1   Bug fix (backward compatible)
1.0.1 → 1.1.0   New feature (backward compatible)
1.1.0 → 2.0.0   Breaking change

# Build với nhiều tags
docker build \
    -t myapp:1.2.3 \        # Exact version (immutable)
    -t myapp:1.2 \           # Latest patch trong 1.2.x
    -t myapp:1 \             # Latest minor trong 1.x.x
    -t myapp:latest \        # Latest stable
    .
 
# Push tất cả
docker push myregistry/myapp:1.2.3
docker push myregistry/myapp:1.2
docker push myregistry/myapp:1
docker push myregistry/myapp:latest
Git-based Tagging
# Tag với git commit hash
GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
docker build -t myapp:${GIT_SHA} .
 
# Tag với version + commit
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
docker build \
    -t myapp:${VERSION} \
    -t myapp:${VERSION}-${GIT_SHA} \
    .
 
# Tag với timestamp + commit (CI/CD)
BUILD_DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d)
docker build -t myapp:${BUILD_DATE}-${GIT_SHA} .
Build Script đầy đủ
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
 
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
IMAGE_NAME="myregistry.com/myteam/myapp"
 
echo "Building ${IMAGE_NAME}:${VERSION}..."
 
docker build \
    --build-arg VERSION="${VERSION}" \
    --build-arg GIT_COMMIT="${GIT_COMMIT}" \
    --build-arg BUILD_DATE="${BUILD_DATE}" \
    -t "${IMAGE_NAME}:${VERSION}" \
    -t "${IMAGE_NAME}:${VERSION}-${GIT_COMMIT}" \
    -t "${IMAGE_NAME}:latest" \
    .
 
echo "Pushing images..."
docker push "${IMAGE_NAME}:${VERSION}"
docker push "${IMAGE_NAME}:${VERSION}-${GIT_COMMIT}"
docker push "${IMAGE_NAME}:latest"
 
echo "Done! Image: ${IMAGE_NAME}:${VERSION}"

Image Management
# List images
docker images
docker images myapp                        # Filter by name
docker images --format "table {{.Repository}}\t{{.Tag}}\t{{.Size}}"
 
# Remove images
docker rmi myapp:1.0.0
docker rmi -f myapp:1.0.0                 # Force (even if container exists)
docker image prune                         # Remove dangling (untagged)
docker image prune -a                      # Remove all unused
 
# Inspect image
docker inspect myapp:1.0.0
docker inspect --format='{{json .Config.Labels}}' myapp | jq
docker inspect --format='{{.Config.Env}}' myapp
 
# Image history (layers)
docker history myapp:latest
docker history --no-trunc myapp:latest     # Full commands
 
# Save/Load (không cần registry)
docker save myapp:1.0.0 > myapp-1.0.0.tar
docker save myapp:1.0.0 | gzip > myapp-1.0.0.tar.gz
docker load < myapp-1.0.0.tar.gz
 
# Export/Import container filesystem
docker export mycontainer > mycontainer.tar
docker import mycontainer.tar myapp:imported
 
# Copy image giữa machines
docker save myapp | ssh user@server "docker load"

Pin Images by Digest (Immutable)
# Lấy digest của image
docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' nginx:alpine
# nginx@sha256:2d194184b067db3598b83f...
 
# Pin bằng digest trong Dockerfile
FROM nginx@sha256:2d194184b067db3598b83f...
 
# Pin khi pull
docker pull nginx:alpine@sha256:2d194184b067db3598b83f...


                  
                   Tại sao dùng digest?
                  
                

Tags có thể thay đổi nội dung (mutable). Digest là immutable — cùng digest = cùng content chính xác.
Dùng trong production Dockerfiles để đảm bảo reproducibility.



Registry Credentials Management
# Docker credential lưu ở
cat ~/.docker/config.json
 
# Dùng credential helper (an toàn hơn)
# Cài docker-credential-secretservice trên Fedora
sudo dnf5 install docker-credential-secretservice
 
# Cấu hình trong ~/.docker/config.json
{
  "credsStore": "secretservice"
}
 
# Podman sử dụng system keyring tự động
# ~/.config/containers/auth.json

Image Scanning
# Trivy — scan vulnerabilities
trivy image myapp:latest
trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL myapp:latest
 
# Docker Scout (Docker Desktop)
docker scout cves myapp:latest
docker scout recommendations myapp:latest
 
# Grype (Anchore)
grype myapp:latest

02---areas/docker/operations/03---comman.title: 03 · Commands Cheat Sheet
02---areas/docker/operations/03---comman.content:
03 · Commands Cheat Sheet
← 🐳 Docker MOC

💡 Hầu hết lệnh docker đều có thể thay bằng podman 1:1 trên Fedora.


🏗️ Build
# Build cơ bản
docker build -t myapp .
docker build -t myapp:1.0.0 .
 
# Build với Dockerfile khác
docker build -f Dockerfile.prod -t myapp:prod .
 
# Build không dùng cache
docker build --no-cache -t myapp .
 
# Build với build args
docker build --build-arg NODE_VERSION=20 -t myapp .
docker build \
    --build-arg VERSION=$(cat VERSION) \
    --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) \
    -t myapp:$(cat VERSION) .
 
# Build specific stage (multi-stage)
docker build --target builder -t myapp:builder .
docker build --target production -t myapp:prod .
 
# Build với progress output
docker build --progress=plain -t myapp .   # Verbose (show all steps)
docker build --progress=auto -t myapp .    # Default
 
# Build với platform
docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t myapp .
 
# Build từ stdin
docker build -t myapp - < Dockerfile
 
# Buildx multi-platform (cần buildx setup)
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --push -t myapp .
 
# Enable BuildKit (nhanh hơn)
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build -t myapp .

▶️ Run
# Run cơ bản
docker run myapp
docker run -d myapp                         # Detached (background)
docker run -it myapp                        # Interactive + TTY
docker run --rm myapp                       # Tự xóa sau khi stop
 
# Đặt tên
docker run --name mycontainer myapp
 
# Port mapping (HOST:CONTAINER)
docker run -p 3000:3000 myapp
docker run -p 8080:3000 myapp              # Map khác port
docker run -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 myapp   # Chỉ localhost
docker run -P myapp                        # Auto-map EXPOSE ports
 
# Environment variables
docker run -e PORT=8080 myapp
docker run -e PORT=8080 -e NODE_ENV=prod myapp
docker run --env-file .env myapp
 
# Volume mounts
docker run -v myvolume:/app/data myapp              # Named volume
docker run -v $(pwd):/app myapp                     # Bind mount
docker run -v $(pwd):/app:ro myapp                  # Read-only
docker run -v $(pwd):/app:Z myapp                   # SELinux (Fedora!)
 
# Network
docker run --network mynetwork myapp
docker run --network host myapp
docker run --add-host db:192.168.1.100 myapp        # Custom /etc/hosts
 
# Resource limits
docker run --memory 512m myapp
docker run --cpus 1.5 myapp
docker run --memory 1g --cpus 2 myapp
 
# Security
docker run --user 1000:1000 myapp
docker run --read-only --tmpfs /tmp myapp
docker run --cap-drop ALL --cap-add NET_BIND_SERVICE myapp
docker run --security-opt no-new-privileges:true myapp
 
# Override CMD / ENTRYPOINT
docker run myapp echo "hello"
docker run myapp python other.py
docker run --entrypoint /bin/sh myapp
docker run --entrypoint /bin/sh myapp -c "ls -la"
 
# Restart policy
docker run --restart always myapp
docker run --restart unless-stopped myapp
docker run --restart on-failure:5 myapp
 
# Init system (tini)
docker run --init myapp
 
# Combine common flags
docker run -d \
    --name myapp \
    --restart unless-stopped \
    -p 3000:3000 \
    --env-file .env \
    --memory 512m --cpus 1 \
    --user 1000:1000 \
    myapp:1.0.0

📋 Container Management
# List containers
docker ps                               # Running only
docker ps -a                            # All (including stopped)
docker ps -q                            # Only IDs
docker ps --filter status=exited        # Filter by status
docker ps --filter name=myapp           # Filter by name
docker ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}"
 
# Start / Stop / Restart
docker start mycontainer
docker stop mycontainer                 # Graceful (SIGTERM)
docker stop --time 30 mycontainer       # Custom timeout
docker kill mycontainer                 # Force (SIGKILL)
docker restart mycontainer
docker pause mycontainer
docker unpause mycontainer
 
# Remove containers
docker rm mycontainer                   # Must be stopped first
docker rm -f mycontainer               # Force remove running
docker rm $(docker ps -aq)             # Remove all stopped
docker container prune                  # Remove all stopped
 
# Logs
docker logs mycontainer
docker logs -f mycontainer             # Follow
docker logs --tail 100 mycontainer     # Last 100 lines
docker logs --since 1h mycontainer     # Last 1 hour
docker logs --since "2024-01-01T10:00:00" mycontainer
docker logs -f --timestamps mycontainer
 
# Execute commands in running container
docker exec mycontainer ls -la
docker exec -it mycontainer sh         # Interactive shell
docker exec -it mycontainer bash
docker exec -u root mycontainer whoami # As root
docker exec -w /tmp mycontainer pwd    # Custom workdir
 
# Copy files
docker cp file.txt mycontainer:/app/   # Host → Container
docker cp mycontainer:/app/file.txt .  # Container → Host
 
# Inspect
docker inspect mycontainer
docker inspect --format='{{.State.Status}}' mycontainer
docker inspect --format='{{.NetworkSettings.IPAddress}}' mycontainer
docker inspect --format='{{json .State.Health}}' mycontainer | jq
 
# Stats & Processes
docker stats                           # All containers (real-time)
docker stats --no-stream               # Snapshot (không loop)
docker stats mycontainer --no-stream
docker top mycontainer                 # Processes trong container
 
# Port info
docker port mycontainer
 
# Events
docker events                          # Real-time events
docker events --since 1h
docker events --filter event=die

🖼️ Image Management
# List images
docker images
docker images myapp                    # Filter by name
docker images -a                       # Include intermediate layers
docker images -q                       # Only IDs
docker images --filter dangling=true   # Untagged images
docker images --format "table {{.Repository}}\t{{.Tag}}\t{{.Size}}"
 
# Pull
docker pull nginx
docker pull nginx:1.25-alpine
docker pull nginx@sha256:abc123...     # By digest (immutable)
 
# Tag
docker tag myapp:latest myapp:1.0.0
docker tag myapp myregistry.com/myapp:latest
 
# Push
docker push myregistry.com/myapp:latest
docker push myregistry.com/myapp:1.0.0
 
# Remove images
docker rmi myapp:1.0.0
docker rmi -f myapp:1.0.0
docker rmi $(docker images -q)         # Remove all
docker image prune                     # Remove dangling
docker image prune -a                  # Remove all unused
 
# Inspect
docker inspect myapp:1.0.0
docker history myapp:latest
docker history --no-trunc myapp:latest
 
# Save / Load (transfer without registry)
docker save myapp:1.0.0 | gzip > myapp.tar.gz
docker save myapp:1.0.0 -o myapp.tar
docker load < myapp.tar.gz
docker load -i myapp.tar
 
# Export / Import (container → image)
docker export mycontainer > container.tar
docker import container.tar myapp:imported

🌐 Network Management
# List networks
docker network ls
 
# Create
docker network create mynetwork
docker network create --driver bridge mynetwork
docker network create --subnet 192.168.100.0/24 mynetwork
docker network create --internal private-net   # No internet
 
# Connect / Disconnect
docker network connect mynetwork mycontainer
docker network disconnect mynetwork mycontainer
 
# Inspect
docker network inspect mynetwork
docker network inspect bridge --format='{{json .Containers}}' | jq
 
# Remove
docker network rm mynetwork
docker network prune                   # Remove unused

💾 Volume Management
# List volumes
docker volume ls
docker volume ls --filter dangling=true
 
# Create
docker volume create myvolume
 
# Inspect
docker volume inspect myvolume
 
# Remove
docker volume rm myvolume
docker volume prune                    # Remove unused
 
# Backup volume
docker run --rm \
    -v myvolume:/data \
    -v $(pwd):/backup \
    alpine \
    tar czf /backup/backup-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz -C /data .
 
# Restore volume
docker run --rm \
    -v myvolume:/data \
    -v $(pwd):/backup \
    alpine \
    tar xzf /backup/backup-20240101.tar.gz -C /data

🧹 System & Cleanup
# Disk usage
docker system df
docker system df -v                    # Verbose
 
# System info
docker info
docker version
 
# Cleanup
docker system prune                    # Remove stopped containers + dangling images + unused networks
docker system prune -a                 # + all unused images
docker system prune -a --volumes       # + unused volumes
 
# Individual pruning
docker container prune
docker image prune
docker image prune -a
docker volume prune
docker network prune
 
# Force cleanup everything (CẨN THẬN!)
docker stop $(docker ps -q)           # Stop all running
docker rm $(docker ps -aq)            # Remove all containers
docker rmi $(docker images -q) -f     # Remove all images
docker volume prune -f                 # Remove unused volumes

🔐 Registry
docker login
docker login myregistry.com
docker login ghcr.io -u USERNAME
echo $TOKEN | docker login ghcr.io -u USERNAME --password-stdin
 
docker logout
docker logout myregistry.com
 
docker search nginx
docker search --filter is-official=true node

⚡ Docker Compose
docker compose up
docker compose up -d
docker compose up --build
docker compose up --force-recreate
docker compose up -d --scale api=3
 
docker compose down
docker compose down -v                 # Cũng xóa volumes
docker compose stop
 
docker compose logs
docker compose logs -f api
docker compose logs --tail 50 api
 
docker compose ps
docker compose top
 
docker compose exec api sh
docker compose exec db psql -U postgres
 
docker compose build
docker compose build --no-cache api
docker compose pull
 
docker compose run --rm api python migrate.py
docker compose config                  # Validate + print merged config

🔧 Debug Shortcuts
# Xem chi tiết container
docker inspect mycontainer | jq '.[0]'
 
# Xem environment variables
docker inspect --format='{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' mycontainer
 
# Shell vào container đã dừng
docker commit mycontainer debug-image
docker run -it debug-image sh
 
# Xem filesystem changes
docker diff mycontainer
 
# Chạy container tạm và tự xóa
docker run --rm -it alpine sh
docker run --rm -it --entrypoint sh myapp
 
# Test connectivity từ trong container
docker exec mycontainer wget -qO- http://backend:3000/health
docker exec mycontainer nslookup backend
docker exec mycontainer ping -c 3 backend

Podman Compatibility Notes


















































DockerPodmanNotesdocker runpodman run✅ Identicaldocker buildpodman build✅ Identicaldocker composepodman compose⚠️ Cần podman-composedocker loginpodman login✅ Identicaldocker system prunepodman system prune✅ Identical-v path:/app-v path:/app:Z⚠️ Cần :Z cho SELinux--network host⚠️ Limited rootlessCần sudo podmandocker socket/run/podman/podman.sockPath khác
# Fedora — alias docker → podman (nếu muốn)
alias docker=podman
echo "alias docker=podman" >> ~/.bashrc
