                  Don't skip stages! 
                  
                

MVP → Docker → Kubernetes. Mỗi stage giúp bạn hiểu rõ hơn nhu cầu thực tế.



🎯 Key Takeaways
Ghi Nhớ 5 Điều Quan Trọng


Kubernetes KHÔNG phải cho everyone

Chỉ dùng khi thực sự cần



Start simple, scale later

MVP → Docker → Kubernetes



Consider costs

K8s expensive cho small projects
Cost-effective when scale



Team expertise matters

Cần training time
Có DevOps engineer tốt hơn



Alternatives exist

PaaS cho simple apps
Docker Swarm cho medium apps
Kubernetes cho enterprise




💪 Bài Tập Tự Đánh Giá
Đánh Giá Dự Án Của Bạn
Scenario 1:
Personal Blog
├── WordPress
├── 100 visitors/day
├── 1 developer (you)
└── Budget: $20/month

Nên dùng gì?

Xem đáp án
KHÔNG dùng Kubernetes!
Giải pháp: Shared hosting hoặc Docker Compose
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'
services:
  wordpress:
    image: wordpress:latest
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    environment:
      WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db
      WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD: secret
  
  db:
    image: mysql:5.7
    volumes:
      - db_data:/var/lib/mysql
 
# Deploy on $10 VPS
Lý do: Quá simple, K8s overkill!


Scenario 2:
E-learning Platform
├── 50,000 students
├── 15 microservices
├── Peak traffic: 8-10 PM (10x normal)
├── Team: 20 developers
└── Budget: $5000/month

Nên dùng gì?

Xem đáp án
Kubernetes là MUST-HAVE!
Lý do:
✓ Multiple microservices
✓ Need auto-scaling (peak traffic)
✓ Large team
✓ Budget sufficient
✓ High availability needed
Setup:
# Managed Kubernetes (GKE/EKS)
# Auto-scaling enabled
# Multi-zone deployment
# Monitoring & logging integrated


Scenario 3:
SaaS MVP
├── 2 developers
├── Validating idea
├── Timeline: 6 weeks
├── Budget: $200/month
└── No K8s experience

Nên dùng gì?

Xem đáp án
Heroku/Railway/Render (PaaS)!
Lý do:
✓ Fast deployment
✓ Zero K8s learning curve
✓ Focus on product
✓ Can migrate to K8s later if successful
# Deploy to Heroku in 5 minutes
$ heroku create myapp
$ git push heroku main
$ heroku ps:scale web=1
 
Done!


📚 Alternatives to Kubernetes
Khi Nào KHÔNG Cần K8s
1. Docker Compose
Use when:
✓ Single server
✓ < 10 containers
✓ Development/small production

Example: docker-compose.yml

2. PaaS (Platform as a Service)
Options:
├── Heroku (easiest)
├── Railway (modern)
├── Render (affordable)
├── Fly.io (edge deployment)
└── DigitalOcean App Platform

Use when:
✓ Want simplicity
✓ Small/medium apps
✓ No DevOps resources

3. Docker Swarm
Use when:
✓ Need orchestration
✓ Simpler than K8s
✓ Team knows Docker well
✓ Medium scale (5-20 nodes)

4. Serverless
Options:
├── AWS Lambda
├── Google Cloud Functions
├── Azure Functions
└── Vercel/Netlify

Use when:
✓ Event-driven workloads
✓ Variable traffic
✓ No server management wanted


🚀 Tiếp Theo
Bạn đã biết khi nào nên/không nên dùng Kubernetes!

02---areas/k8s/01-introduction/readme.title: Phần 1: Introduction - Giới Thiệu Kubernetes
02---areas/k8s/01-introduction/readme.content:
📘 Phần 1: Introduction - Giới Thiệu Kubernetes

Hiểu Kubernetes từ vấn đề thực tế và biết khi nào nên sử dụng


🎯 Mục Tiêu Phần Này
Sau khi hoàn thành Phần 1, bạn sẽ:
✅ Hiểu Kubernetes là gì và giải quyết vấn đề gì
✅ Phân biệt Docker và Kubernetes
✅ Biết khi nào nên và không nên dùng K8s
✅ Có foundation để học các phần tiếp theo

📚 Nội Dung
1.1. Kubernetes Là Gì? ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Thời gian: 30-45 phút
Nội dung:

Vấn đề thực tế (Startup phát triển từ 10 → 100,000 users)

2.1. Tổng Quan Kiến Trúc Kubernetes

Hiểu big picture trước khi đi vào chi tiết từng thành phần


🎯 Mục Tiêu Học
Sau khi học xong phần này, bạn sẽ:

✅ Hiểu kiến trúc tổng thể của Kubernetes
✅ Phân biệt Control Plane và Worker Node
✅ Hiểu communication flow giữa các components
✅ Biết vai trò của từng thành phần chính


🏗️ Kubernetes Cluster - Big Picture
Cluster Là Gì?
Kubernetes Cluster = Tập hợp servers làm việc cùng nhau như một hệ thống thống nhất.
Giải Thích Bằng Ví Dụ
Cluster giống như một công ty:
🏢 Công Ty (Cluster)
├── 🎯 Phòng Giám Đốc (Control Plane)
│   ├── CEO (API Server) - Nhận mọi yêu cầu
│   ├── CFO (etcd) - Quản lý dữ liệu/trạng thái
│   ├── HR Manager (Scheduler) - Phân công nhân viên
│   └── Operations Manager (Controller Manager) - Đảm bảo mọi thứ chạy đúng
│
└── 👷 Phòng Sản Xuất (Worker Nodes)
    ├── Worker Node 1 - Nhân viên làm việc
    ├── Worker Node 2 - Nhân viên làm việc  
    └── Worker Node 3 - Nhân viên làm việc


📐 Kiến Trúc Tổng Thể
Diagram Cluster Architecture
graph TD
    USER["👤 User / Developer"] -->|kubectl| API

    subgraph CP["🧠 CONTROL PLANE — Bộ Não"]
        API["🔀 API Server<br/><i>Cổng vào duy nhất</i>"]
        ETCD["💾 etcd<br/><i>Database cluster</i>"]
        SCHED["📋 Scheduler<br/><i>Phân công Pod → Node</i>"]
        CM["⚙️ Controller Manager<br/><i>Giám sát desired state</i>"]

        API --> SCHED
        API --> CM
    end

    end

    subgraph WN2["🖥️ Worker Node 2"]
        KL2["kubelet"] --> CR2["Container Runtime"]

    end

    subgraph WN3["🖥️ Worker Node 3"]

    end

    API <-->|"Commands & Status"| KL1 & KL2 & KL3
    API -->|"Service rules"| KP1 & KP2 & KP3

🎯 Control Plane vs Worker Nodes
So Sánh Chi Tiết








































Đặc ĐiểmControl PlaneWorker NodesVai tròBộ não - Ra quyết địnhThợ làm việc - Thực hiện công việcSố lượng1-3 nodes (HA)Nhiều nodes (10, 100, 1000+)Chạy gì?K8s system componentsApplication PodsQuan trọngCritical - Chết = cluster chếtImportant - Chết 1 node OKTài nguyênÍt CPU/RAMNhiều CPU/RAM cho appsExposeAPI Server publicThường private

🧠 Control Plane - Bộ Não
Thành Phần Chính
1. API Server (kube-apiserver)
Vai trò: Cổng vào duy nhất của cluster
Ví dụ: Receptionist tại công ty

Làm gì:
├── Nhận tất cả requests (kubectl, dashboard, etc.)
├── Authenticate & authorize
├── Validate requests
└── Forward đến components khác

Communication:
User → kubectl → API Server → Other components

2. etcd
Vai trò: Database của cluster
Ví dụ: Kho lưu trữ hồ sơ công ty

Lưu gì:
├── Cluster state
├── Configuration data
├── Pods đang chạy ở đâu
├── Services có những Endpoints nào
└── Mọi thông tin về cluster

Đặc điểm:
✓ Distributed key-value store
✓ Consistent và highly-available
✓ Chỉ API Server có thể đọc/ghi

3. Scheduler (kube-scheduler)
Vai trò: Quyết định Pod chạy ở Node nào
Ví dụ: HR Manager phân công nhân viên

Làm gì:
1. Watch for new Pods (chưa assign Node)
2. Chọn Node phù hợp nhất dựa trên:
   ├── Resource available (CPU, RAM)
   ├── Node constraints (taints, tolerations)
   ├── Affinity/Anti-affinity rules
   └── Data locality
3. Assign Pod → Node

4. Controller Manager (kube-controller-manager)
Vai trò: Đảm bảo desired state = actual state
Ví dụ: Operations Manager giám sát mọi thứ

Gồm nhiều controllers:
├── Node Controller: Watch nodes health
├── Replication Controller: Đảm bảo đủ số Pods
├── Endpoints Controller: Populate Endpoints
├── Service Account Controller: Tạo default accounts
└── Nhiều controllers khác...

Logic: Continuous reconciliation loop
Desired: 3 Pods
Actual: 2 Pods (1 crashed)
→ Controller: Tạo thêm 1 Pod!


👷 Worker Nodes - Thợ Làm Việc
Thành Phần Chính
1. kubelet
Vai trò: Agent chạy trên mỗi Node
Ví dụ: Supervisor của mỗi nhân viên

Làm gì:
├── Communicate với API Server
├── Watch for Pods assigned to this Node
├── Start/Stop containers (via Container Runtime)
├── Monitor Pod health
├── Report status về API Server
└── Mount volumes

Đặc điểm:
✓ Primary "node agent"
✓ Chạy trên MỌI node (kể cả control plane)
✓ Không manage containers không được K8s tạo

2. kube-proxy
Vai trò: Network proxy
Ví dụ: Nhân viên bưu điện - Forward thư/gói hàng

Làm gì:
├── Maintain network rules trên Node
├── Enable Pod-to-Pod communication
├── Implement Service abstraction
├── Load balance traffic đến Pods
└── Support ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer

Implementation modes:
├── iptables (phổ biến)
├── IPVS (performance cao hơn)
└── userspace (legacy)

3. Container Runtime
Vai trò: Chạy containers
Ví dụ: Máy móc để nhân viên làm việc

Options:
├── Docker (phổ biến nhất)
├── containerd (lightweight)
├── CRI-O (OCI-compliant)
└── Others...

Làm gì:
├── Pull images từ registry
├── Start/stop containers
├── Manage container lifecycle
└── Resource isolation


🔄 Communication Flow - Luồng Hoạt Động
Scenario: Deploy Application
Step-by-step workflow:
kubectl create deployment webapp --image=nginx --replicas=3
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as 👤 User
    participant API as 🔀 API Server
    participant ETCD as 💾 etcd
    participant DC as ⚙️ Deployment<br/>Controller
    participant RSC as ⚙️ ReplicaSet<br/>Controller
    participant S as 📋 Scheduler
    participant KL as 🔧 kubelet

    U->>API: kubectl create deployment webapp
    
    Note over API: ✓ Authenticate user<br/>✓ Authorize request<br/>✓ Validate spec
    
    API->>ETCD: Write Deployment<br/>"Desired: 3 Pods"
    API-->>U: deployment.apps/webapp created
    
    Note over DC: 👁️ "New Deployment detected!"<br/>→ Tạo ReplicaSet
    DC->>API: Create ReplicaSet (3 replicas)
    API->>ETCD: Write ReplicaSet
    
    Note over RSC: 👁️ "New ReplicaSet!"<br/>Desired=3, Actual=0
    RSC->>API: Create 3 Pods (Pending)
    API->>ETCD: Write 3 Pods
    
    Note over S: 👁️ "3 Pods chưa có Node!"<br/>Evaluate: Filter → Score<br/>Pod1→Node2, Pod2→Node1, Pod3→Node2
    S->>API: Bind Pods to Nodes
    API->>ETCD: Update nodeName
    
    Note over KL: 👁️ "Pods assigned to me!"<br/>Pull image → Create → Start<br/>Monitor → Report status
    KL->>API: Pod status: Running ✅
    API->>ETCD: Update Pod status

Kết quả:
$ kubectl get pods
NAME                     READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
webapp-7d8bc4c5d-abc12   1/1     Running   0          30s
webapp-7d8bc4c5d-def34   1/1     Running   0          30s
webapp-7d8bc4c5d-ghi56   1/1     Running   0          30s

💡 Tại Sao Kiến Trúc Này?
Design Principles


                  
                  1. Separation of Concerns 
                  
                

Control Plane quyết định, Worker Nodes thực hiện.

✅ Scale riêng biệt — thêm Workers mà không ảnh hưởng Control Plane
✅ Failure isolation — Worker chết, Control Plane vẫn OK
✅ Easier maintenance — upgrade từng layer độc lập





                  
                  2. Declarative API 
                  
                

Bạn nói: “Tôi muốn 3 Pods” → K8s tự lo tất cả!

❌ Không cần: “Tạo Pod1 trên Node1”, “Config networking”…
✅ Chỉ khai báo desired state, K8s tự động handle





                  
                  3. Watch & Reconciliation Loop 
                  
                

Controllers chạy vòng lặp liên tục:
Watch actual state → Compare desired → Take action → Repeat
→ Self-healing automatic!




                  
                  4. API-Driven 
                  
                

Mọi interaction qua API Server:
✅ Centralized control · ✅ Auditable · ✅ Secure (authn/authz) · ✅ Extensible



🎓 Kiểm Tra Hiểu Biết
Câu Hỏi Tự Kiểm Tra
1. Control Plane và Worker Nodes khác nhau như thế nào?

Xem đáp án
Control Plane (Bộ não):

Vai trò: Ra quyết định, điều phối
Components: API Server, etcd, Scheduler, Controller Manager
Chạy: K8s system components
Quan trọng: Critical - chết = cluster chết

Worker Nodes (Thợ):

Vai trò: Thực hiện công việc, chạy applications
Components: kubelet, kube-proxy, Container Runtime
Chạy: Application Pods
Redundant: Chết 1 node, apps vẫn OK trên nodes khác


2. API Server làm gì?

Xem đáp án
API Server là cổng vào duy nhất của cluster:

Nhận tất cả requests (kubectl, dashboard)
Authenticate & authorize
Validate requests
Write/Read từ etcd
Forward requests đến components khác

Analogy: Receptionist/Switchboard operator

3. Scheduler quyết định Pod chạy ở đâu dựa trên gì?

Xem đáp án
Scheduler evaluate dựa trên:

Resource availability: CPU, RAM available trên node
Resource requests: Pod cần bao nhiêu CPU/RAM
Node constraints: Taints, tolerations, node selectors
Affinity rules: Pod muốn/không muốn chạy gần Pod nào
Data locality: Data ở đâu (optimize network)
Priority: Pod nào priority cao hơn

Choose node có score cao nhất!

4. Vẽ flow khi bạn run kubectl create deployment

Xem đáp án
kubectl 
  → API Server (validate, write etcd)
    → Deployment Controller (create ReplicaSet)
      → ReplicaSet Controller (create Pods)
        → API Server (write Pods to etcd)
          → Scheduler (assign Pods to Nodes)
            → kubelet on Nodes (create containers)
              → Containers running!

Bài 1: Identify Components
Tình huống: Các components sau thuộc Control Plane hay Worker Node?

kubelet

Bài 2: Trace the Flow
Pod crash, vẽ flow K8s tự phục hồi:

Xem đáp án
flowchart TD
    A["💥 Container crashes"] --> B["🔧 kubelet detects<br/>(health check fail)"]
    B --> C["kubelet → API Server<br/>Pod X: status = Failed"]
    C --> D["API Server → etcd<br/>Update Pod status"]

    F --> G["📋 Scheduler<br/>Evaluate Nodes → Choose Node Z"]
    G --> H["🔧 kubelet on Node Z<br/>Pull image → Create → Start"]
    H --> I["kubelet → API Server<br/>Pod is Running! ✅"]
    
    style A fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff
    style I fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff



🎯 Key Takeaways
Ghi Nhớ 5 Điều Quan Trọng


Cluster = Control Plane + Worker Nodes

Control Plane: Bộ não (quyết định)
Worker Nodes: Thợ làm việc (thực hiện)



API Server = Cổng vào duy nhất

Mọi request đều qua API Server
Tương tác với etcd
Central hub



etcd = Database của cluster

Lưu mọi state
Single source of truth
Highly available



Scheduler = Phân công thông minh

Quyết định Pod chạy ở Node nào
Dựa trên resources, constraints, affinity



Controllers = Reconciliation loops

Watch desired vs actual state
Take action to match
Self-healing mechanism




📚 Thuật Ngữ Cần Nhớ

02---areas/k8s/02-architecture/02-contro.content:
2.2. Control Plane - Bộ Não Của Cluster

Deep dive vào từng component của Control Plane


🎯 Mục Tiêu Học
Sau khi học xong phần này, bạn sẽ:

✅ Hiểu chi tiết từng component của Control Plane
✅ Biết vai trò cụ thể của mỗi component
✅ Hiểu cách các components tương tác với nhau
✅ Troubleshoot được issues liên quan Control Plane


🧠 Control Plane Components
Tổng Quan
│  │     • Run multiple controllers           │ │
│  │     • Watch & reconcile state            │ │
│  │     • Ensure desired = actual            │ │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  5. cloud-controller-manager (optional)  │ │
│  │     • Cloud-specific control logic       │ │
│  │     • Manage cloud resources             │ │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


1️⃣ API Server (kube-apiserver)
Vai Trò: Trung Tâm Giao Tiếp
API Server = Receptionist/Switchboard Operator của cluster
USER/SYSTEM
    ↓
 API Server  ← Điểm vào DUY NHẤT
    ↓
All other components

Chức Năng Chính
1. Frontend cho Cluster
Mọi interaction với cluster đều qua API Server:
├── kubectl commands
├── Dashboard
├── CI/CD tools
├── Custom controllers
└── Other K8s components

→ KHÔNG AI có thể bypass API Server!

2. Authentication & Authorization
Mỗi request phải:
1. Authentication: "Bạn là ai?"
   ├── Client certificates
   ├── Bearer tokens
   ├── Service account tokens
   └── OpenID Connect (OIDC)

2. Authorization: "Bạn được làm gì?"
   ├── RBAC (Role-Based Access Control)
   ├── ABAC (Attribute-Based)
   └── Webhook mode

3. Admission Control: "Request có hợp lệ không?"
   ├── Validate resources
   ├── Mutate resources (add defaults)
   └── Custom admission webhooks

3. Validation
API Server validates:
├── Syntax correctness (YAML structure)
├── Required fields present
├── Field values valid (e.g., CPU format: "100m")
├── References exist (e.g., ConfigMap exists)
└── Quota limits not exceeded

4. etcd Gateway
API Server là component DUY NHẤT giao tiếp với etcd:

Write path:
User → API Server → Validate → etcd

Read path:
User → API Server → etcd → API Server → User

Other components:
Scheduler/Controllers → API Server → etcd
(KHÔNG truy cập etcd trực tiếp!)

Ví Dụ: Create Pod Request
# user.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:latest
Flow chi tiết:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as 👤 User
    participant API as 🔀 API Server
    participant ETCD as 💾 etcd
    
    U->>API: kubectl create -f user.yaml<br/>POST /api/v1/.../pods
    
    Note over API: 🔐 Authentication<br/>✓ Verify client certificate<br/>✓ Identity: user@example.com
    
    Note over API: 🛡️ Authorization (RBAC)<br/>"Can user create Pods<br/>in default namespace?"<br/>✓ Allowed!
    
    Note over API: ✅ Admission Control<br/>Mutating: add defaults<br/>(imagePullPolicy, restartPolicy)<br/>Validating: check constraints
    
    Note over API: 📝 Validation<br/>✓ YAML syntax, required fields<br/>✓ Image name, container name
    
    API->>ETCD: Write Pod<br/>Key: /registry/pods/default/nginx<br/>Status: Pending
    ETCD-->>API: ACK
    API-->>U: HTTP 201 Created<br/>pod/nginx created

Commands để Monitor
# Check API Server logs
kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-apiserver-<node>
 
# API Server metrics
kubectl get --raw /metrics | grep apiserver
 
# Check API Server endpoints
kubectl get --raw /api/v1 | jq
kubectl get --raw /apis | jq
 
# API Server health
curl -k https://localhost:6443/healthz
curl -k https://localhost:6443/readyz

2️⃣ etcd
Vai Trò: Database Của Cluster
etcd = Kho lưu trữ hồ sơ của công ty
etcd lưu TẤT CẢ:
├── Pods
├── Services
├── Deployments
├── Secrets
├── ConfigMaps
├── Nodes
└── Mọi K8s resources!

Đặc Điểm
1. Distributed Key-Value Store
Key-Value Database:
Key: /registry/pods/default/nginx
Value: {
  "apiVersion": "v1",
  "kind": "Pod",
  "metadata": { ... },
  "spec": { ... },
  "status": { ... }
}

Distributed:
├── Run trên multiple nodes (usually 3 or 5)
├── Use Raft consensus algorithm
├── Survive node failures
└── Always consistent

2. Consistency is Key
Strong Consistency Guarantee:
├── Một write được ack → Guaranteed durable
├── Reads always return latest write
├── No stale data
└── Perfect for cluster state!

Vì sao quan trọng:
- Cluster state phải accurate 100%
- Pod đang chạy ở đâu?
- Service có những Endpoints nào?
- Wrong data = disaster!

3. Watch Mechanism
Components "watch" API Server for changes:
(NOT etcd directly! Only API Server talks to etcd)

Example - Scheduler watches API Server:
API Server: "New Pod created (status: Pending)"
     ↓
Scheduler: "Aha! Pod cần Node. Let me assign..."
          ↓
Scheduler → API Server: "Assign Pod to Node X"
          ↓
API Server → etcd: Save binding
          ↓
API Server → kubelet (watch): "Pod assigned to you!"
          ↓
kubelet on Node X: "Aha! Let me start this Pod!"

Key Point: Components NEVER access etcd directly!
All communication goes through API Server.

Data Structure trong etcd
# View etcd structure (requires etcd access)
export ETCDCTL_API=3
 
# List all keys
etcdctl get / --prefix --keys-only
 
# Sample structure:
/registry/
├── pods/
│   ├── default/
│   │   ├── nginx
│   │   └── webapp-abc123
│   └── kube-system/
│       └── coredns-xyz789
├── services/
│   └── default/
│       └── kubernetes
├── deployments/
│   └── default/
│       └── webapp
├── secrets/
│   └── default/
│       └── my-secret
└── ...
 
# Get specific Pod
etcdctl get /registry/pods/default/nginx


                  
                  Backup etcd - CỰC KỲ QUAN TRỌNG! 
                  
                

etcd chết = mất TOÀN BỘ cluster state! Backup định kỳ là bắt buộc trong production.


# Backup etcd
ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save /backup/etcd-snapshot.db \
  --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 \
  --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt \
  --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt \
  --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key
 
# Verify backup
ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot status /backup/etcd-snapshot.db
 
# Restore từ backup
ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot restore /backup/etcd-snapshot.db \
  --data-dir=/var/lib/etcd-restore
 
# Schedule regular backups (production must-have!)
# Cron job every 6 hours

3️⃣ Scheduler (kube-scheduler)
Vai Trò: Phân Công Thông Minh
Scheduler = HR Manager phân công nhân viên vào projects
Scheduler's job:
1. Watch for Pods without Node assignment (status: Pending)
2. Find best Node for each Pod
3. Assign Pod → Node (write to API Server)

Scheduling Algorithm (3 bước):
flowchart LR
    PENDING["🟡 Pending Pod<br/><i>no Node assigned</i>"] --> FILTER
    
    subgraph FILTER["Step 1: Filtering"]
        F1{{"Đủ CPU/RAM?"}}
        F2{{"Đúng NodeSelector?"}}
        F3{{"Taint tolerated?"}}
        F4{{"Affinity OK?"}}
    end
    
    FILTER --> SCORE
    
    subgraph SCORE["Step 2: Scoring"]
        S1["LeastRequested<br/><i>nhiều resource = điểm cao</i>"]
        S2["BalancedAllocation<br/><i>CPU/RAM cân bằng</i>"]
        S3["NodeAffinity<br/><i>preference match</i>"]
        S4["ImageLocality<br/><i>image đã có</i>"]
    end
    
    SCORE --> BIND["Step 3: Binding<br/>🟢 Assign Pod → Best Node"]
    
    style PENDING fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style BIND fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff

Ví Dụ Thực Tế
Scenario: Schedule 3 Pods
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: webapp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: webapp
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
Cluster state:
Nodes:
├── node-1: 2 CPU, 4Gi RAM (available: 1.5 CPU, 3Gi)
├── node-2: 4 CPU, 8Gi RAM (available: 3 CPU, 7Gi)
└── node-3: 2 CPU, 4Gi RAM (available: 0.3 CPU, 1Gi)

Scheduler decisions:
Pod 1:
├── Filter: node-1 ✓, node-2 ✓, node-3 ✗ (not enough CPU)
├── Score: node-2 (195) > node-1 (145)
└── Assign: Pod 1 → node-2
   (node-2 available: 2.5 CPU, 6.75Gi RAM)

Pod 2:
├── Filter: node-1 ✓, node-2 ✓, node-3 ✗
├── Score: node-2 (175) > node-1 (145)
└── Assign: Pod 2 → node-2
   (node-2 available: 2 CPU, 6.5Gi RAM)

Pod 3:
├── Filter: node-1 ✓, node-2 ✓, node-3 ✗
├── Score: node-2 (155) > node-1 (145)
└── Assign: Pod 3 → node-2
   (node-2 available: 1.5 CPU, 6.25Gi RAM)

Final distribution:
├── node-1: 0 Pods (still available)
├── node-2: 3 Pods (all Pods fit!)
└── node-3: 0 Pods (insufficient resources)

Note: Scheduler prefers node-2 vì có nhiều resources nhất


4️⃣ Controller Manager (kube-controller-manager)
Vai Trò: Đảm Bảo Desired State
Controller Manager = Operations Manager giám sát mọi thứ
Controller Pattern:
1. Watch actual state
2. Compare với desired state
3. If different → Take action
4. Repeat (forever!)

→ Self-healing mechanism!

Controllers Chính
1. Node Controller
Nhiệm vụ:
├── Monitor Node health
├── Mark unhealthy Nodes as NotReady
├── Evict Pods từ dead Nodes (sau 40s default)
└── Update Node conditions

Watch loop (every 5s):
for each Node:
  if no heartbeat for 40s:
    Mark Node as NotReady
    Wait 5 minutes
    if still NotReady:
      Delete Pods on that Node

2. Replication Controller / ReplicaSet Controller
Nhiệm vụ: Đảm bảo số lượng Pods

Watch loop (every 30s):
Desired replicas: 3
Actual replicas: 2  ← Một Pod crashed!

Action:
└─> Create 1 new Pod

Example:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ReplicaSet
metadata:
  name: webapp-rs
spec:
  replicas: 3  ← Controller maintains this!
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: webapp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: webapp
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx

3. Endpoints Controller
Nhiệm vụ: Update Service Endpoints

Watch:
├── Services created/updated
└── Pods created/deleted/changed

Action:
Service "webapp" selects app=webapp Pods
  → Find all matching Pods
  → Get their IPs
  → Update Endpoints object

Endpoints object:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Endpoints
metadata:
  name: webapp
subsets:
- addresses:
  - ip: 10.244.1.5  # Pod 1
  - ip: 10.244.2.8  # Pod 2
  - ip: 10.244.1.9  # Pod 3
  ports:
  - port: 80

4. Service Account Controller
Nhiệm vụ: Manage ServiceAccounts

Watch:
└── Namespaces created

Action:
When new Namespace created:
  → Create "default" ServiceAccount
  → Create token Secret for ServiceAccount

Every Pod gets a ServiceAccount (default if not specified)

5. Deployment Controller
Nhiệm vụ: Manage Deployments (ReplicaSets + Rolling Updates)

Watch:
└── Deployment changes

Actions:
├── New Deployment → Create ReplicaSet
├── Update image → Create new ReplicaSet, scale up/down
├── Rollback → Switch to old ReplicaSet
└── Pause/Resume → Control rollout

Example rolling update:
Deployment: nginx:1.19 → nginx:1.20
1. Create new ReplicaSet (nginx:1.20) with 0 replicas
2. Scale up new (1), scale down old (2)
3. Scale up new (2), scale down old (1)
4. Scale up new (3), scale down old (0)
→ Done! Zero downtime!

6. Job Controller
Nhiệm vụ: Run Jobs to completion

Watch:
└── Jobs

Actions:
├── Create Pods for Job
├── Monitor completion
├── Restart Pods nếu fail (based on restartPolicy)
└── Mark Job as Complete/Failed

Example:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: backup-job
spec:
  completions: 1  # Run once
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: backup
        image: backup:latest
      restartPolicy: Never

Reconciliation Loop Pattern
Core pattern của tất cả controllers:
// Pseudo-code
for {
  // 1. Watch for changes
  actualState = getActualState()
  desiredState = getDesiredState()
  
  // 2. Compare
  if actualState != desiredState {
    // 3. Take action
    reconcile(actualState, desiredState)
  }
  
  // 4. Wait và repeat
  sleep(30 * time.Second)
}
Ví dụ ReplicaSet Controller:
Loop iteration 1:
Desired: 3 Pods
Actual: 3 Pods
→ No action (all good!)

--- Pod 2 crashes ---

Loop iteration 2:
Desired: 3 Pods
Actual: 2 Pods (Pod 1, Pod 3)
→ Action: Create Pod 4!

Loop iteration 3:
Desired: 3 Pods
Actual: 3 Pods (Pod 1, Pod 3, Pod 4)
→ No action (recovered!)


5️⃣ Cloud Controller Manager (Optional)
Vai Trò: Cloud Integration
Cloud Controller Manager = Liaison với cloud provider
Tách cloud-specific logic khỏi core K8s:
├── Node lifecycle (tạo/xóa VMs)
├── LoadBalancer Services (provision cloud LB)
├── Routes (configure VPC routing)
└── Storage (provision cloud volumes)

Cloud-Specific Controllers
1. Node Controller (Cloud)
Nhiệm vụ:
├── Create cloud VMs for new Nodes
├── Delete cloud VMs when Nodes removed
├── Update Node labels với cloud metadata
└── Check Node existence in cloud

Example metadata:
labels:
  kubernetes.io/arch: amd64
  kubernetes.io/os: linux
  topology.kubernetes.io/region: us-central1
  topology.kubernetes.io/zone: us-central1-a
  node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: n1-standard-4

2. Route Controller
Nhiệm vụ:
Configure cloud VPC routes for Pod network

Example (GCP):
Node 1: Pod CIDR 10.244.1.0/24
Node 2: Pod CIDR 10.244.2.0/24

Cloud Controller creates routes:
├── 10.244.1.0/24 → Node 1 VM
└── 10.244.2.0/24 → Node 2 VM

→ Pods can communicate cross-node!

3. Service Controller
Nhiệm vụ:
Provision cloud LoadBalancers for Services

Example:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer  ← Cloud Controller acts!
  selector:
    app: webapp
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080

Cloud Controller:
1. Call cloud API: "Create LoadBalancer"
2. Get LoadBalancer IP
3. Update Service:
   status:
     loadBalancer:
       ingress:
       - ip: 35.xxx.xxx.xxx


🔄 Component Interaction Example
Complete Flow: Create Deployment
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as 👤 User
    participant API as 🔀 API Server
    participant ETCD as 💾 etcd
    participant DC as ⚙️ Deployment<br/>Controller
    participant RSC as ⚙️ ReplicaSet<br/>Controller
    participant S as 📋 Scheduler
    participant KL as 🔧 kubelet
    
    U->>API: kubectl create deployment nginx<br/>--image=nginx --replicas=3
    
    Note over API: Authenticate/Authorize<br/>Validate → Write to etcd
    API->>ETCD: Save Deployment
    
    Note over DC: 👁️ Watch: New Deployment!<br/>→ Create ReplicaSet
    DC->>API: Create ReplicaSet
    API->>ETCD: Save ReplicaSet
    
    Note over RSC: 👁️ Watch: New RS!<br/>replicas=3 → Create 3 Pods
    RSC->>API: Create 3 Pods
    API->>ETCD: Save 3 Pods (Pending)
    
    Note over S: 👁️ Watch: Pending Pods!<br/>Evaluate → Assign Nodes
    S->>API: Bind Pod1→Node1, Pod2→Node2,<br/>Pod3→Node1
    API->>ETCD: Update Pods (nodeName)
    
    Note over KL: [Now kubelet takes over<br/>→ see Worker Nodes section]


🎓 Kiểm Tra Hiểu Biết
Câu Hỏi Tự Kiểm Tra
1. Vì sao API Server là component duy nhất giao tiếp với etcd?

Xem đáp án
Lý do:

Security: Centralized access control
Consistency: Single source of truth
Validation: API Server validates tất cả writes
Auditing: Log mọi changes
Simplicity: Other components không cần biết etcd details

Nếu mọi component đều access etcd:

❌ Security nightmare
❌ Validation bị bypass
❌ Inconsistent data
❌ Hard to audit


2. Scheduler scoring: Node nào được chọn và tại sao?
Pod requests: CPU 1000m, RAM 2Gi
Nodes:
├── Node A: Available 2 CPU, 6Gi RAM (30% used)
├── Node B: Available 1.5 CPU, 3Gi RAM (50% used)
└── Node C: Available 0.5 CPU, 1Gi RAM (80% used)


Xem đáp án
Filter phase:

Node A: ✓ (đủ resources)
Node B: ✓ (đủ resources)
Node C: ❌ (không đủ CPU)

Scoring phase:

Node A: Score cao (nhiều available resources, balanced)
Node B: Score trung bình (adequate resources)

Winner: Node A
Lý do: Nhiều resources available nhất, balanced CPU/RAM usage

3. Controller nào responsible cho việc gì?
Match controllers với nhiệm vụ:

Node Controller
ReplicaSet Controller
Endpoints Controller
Service Controller (Cloud)

Tasks:
a. Update Service Endpoints khi Pod IP changes
b. Maintain số lượng Pod replicas
c. Provision cloud LoadBalancer
d. Monitor Node health và evict Pods

Xem đáp án

Node Controller → d. Monitor Node health
ReplicaSet Controller → b. Maintain Pod replicas
Endpoints Controller → a. Update Service Endpoints
Service Controller (Cloud) → c. Provision LoadBalancer



💪 Bài Tập Thực Hành
Bài 1: Trace Complete Flow
Scenario: Deploy webapp, 1 Pod crashes sau 5 phút
Vẽ flow chi tiết từ lúc deploy đến lúc Pod recovered:

Xem đáp án
1. kubectl create deployment webapp --replicas=2
   ↓
2. API Server: Validate, write to etcd
   ↓
3. Deployment Controller: Create ReplicaSet
   ↓
4. ReplicaSet Controller: Create 2 Pods
   ↓
5. Scheduler: Assign Pods to Nodes
   ↓
6. kubelet: Start containers
   ↓
7. Pods Running! ✅

--- 5 minutes later: Pod 1 crashes ---

8. kubelet detects crash
   ↓
9. kubelet → API Server: "Pod 1 failed"
   ↓
10. API Server → etcd: Update Pod 1 status
    ↓
11. ReplicaSet Controller watching:
    "Desired: 2, Actual: 1"
    ↓
12. ReplicaSet Controller → API Server:
    "Create new Pod"
    ↓
13. Scheduler assigns new Pod to Node
    ↓
14. kubelet starts new Pod
    ↓
15. Recovered! 2 Pods Running ✅



🎯 Key Takeaways
Ghi Nhớ 5 Điều Quan Trọng


API Server = Central Hub

Mọi interaction qua API Server
Giao tiếp duy nhất với etcd
Authentication, Authorization, Validation



etcd = Single Source of Truth

Lưu tất cả cluster state
Distributed, consistent
BACKUP REGULARLY!



Scheduler = Smart Assignment

Filter → Score → Bind
Consider resources, constraints, affinity
Optimize cluster utilization



Controllers = Reconciliation

Watch → Compare → Act
Desired state = Actual state
Self-healing automatic



Watch Pattern Everywhere

Components watch API Server
React to changes
Distributed event-driven architecture




🚀 Tiếp Theo
Bạn đã hiểu chi tiết Control Plane!
Next: 2.3. Worker Nodes →
Ở phần tiếp theo, chúng ta sẽ tìm hiểu Worker Nodes - nơi applications thực sự chạy.

02---areas/k8s/02-architecture/03-worker.content:
2.3. Worker Nodes - Nơi Chạy Applications

Deep dive vào Worker Nodes - nơi workloads thực sự chạy


🎯 Mục Tiêu Học
Sau khi học xong phần này, bạn sẽ:

✅ Hiểu chi tiết các components trên Worker Node
✅ Biết cách kubelet quản lý Pods
✅ Hiểu networking trong Node (kube-proxy)
✅ Troubleshoot được Node-level issues


👷 Worker Node Components
Tổng Quan
│  │  ││App ││  ││App ││  ││App ││           │ │
│  │  │└────┘│  │└────┘│  │└────┘│           │ │
│  │  └──────┘  └──────┘  └──────┘           │ │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  Operating System (Linux)                │ │
│  │  • Kernel                                │ │
│  │  • cgroups (resource limits)             │ │
│  │  • namespaces (isolation)                │ │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


1️⃣ kubelet - Node Agent
Vai Trò: Supervisor Của Node
kubelet = Foreman/Supervisor tại construction site
kubelet responsibilities:
├── Watch API Server for Pods assigned to this Node
├── Ensure containers are running in Pods
├── Mount volumes
├── Run health checks (liveness, readiness)
├── Report Pod & Node status to API Server
└── Execute lifecycle hooks

Kubelet Workflow
Complete lifecycle management:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant API as 🔀 API Server
    participant KL as 🔧 kubelet
    participant CR as 📦 Container Runtime
    participant REG as 🏭 Registry
    participant C as 🟢 Container
    
    Note over KL: 👁️ WATCH API SERVER
    API->>KL: New Pod assigned: webapp-abc123<br/>Image: nginx:latest
    
    KL->>KL: Check Pod not exists locally<br/>→ Need to create
    
    KL->>CR: Pull image nginx:latest
    CR->>REG: Download image layers
    REG-->>CR: Image stored
    
    KL->>CR: CreateContainer<br/>Image, Env, Volumes, Resources
    CR-->>KL: ContainerID: abc123def456
    
    KL->>CR: StartContainer(abc123)
    CR->>C: Start
    Note over C: 🟢 Container Running
    
    loop Every 10s - Health Monitoring
        KL->>C: Liveness probe: GET /health
        C-->>KL: 200 OK ✔️
        KL->>C: Readiness probe: GET /ready
        C-->>KL: 200 OK ✔️
    end
    
    KL->>API: Report status:<br/>phase=Running, Ready=True<br/>podIP=10.244.1.5
    
    Note over KL: 8. CONTINUOUS MONITORING<br/>Check running · Run probes<br/>Monitor resources · Report status

Kubelet Configuration
Key kubelet parameters:
# /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml
apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: KubeletConfiguration
 
# API Server connection
clusterDomain: cluster.local
clusterDNS:
  - 10.96.0.10
 
# Pod management
podCIDR: 10.244.1.0/24
maxPods: 110
 
# Resource management
cpuManagerPolicy: none
memoryManagerPolicy: None
 
# Health checks
nodeStatusUpdateFrequency: 10s
nodeStatusReportFrequency: 5m
 
# Eviction thresholds
evictionHard:
  memory.available: "100Mi"
  nodefs.available: "10%"
  imagefs.available: "15%"
 
# Image management
imageGCHighThresholdPercent: 85
imageGCLowThresholdPercent: 80
Kubelet Interaction với Container Runtime
CRI (Container Runtime Interface):
kubelet ←--CRI API--→ Container Runtime
                      ├── Docker (via dockershim - deprecated)
                      ├── containerd ✓ (recommended)
                      ├── CRI-O ✓
                      └── Others...

CRI Operations:
├── RunPodSandbox (create Pod network namespace)
├── CreateContainer (create container in Pod)
├── StartContainer (start container)
├── StopContainer (stop container)
├── RemoveContainer (cleanup)
└── ListContainers (list running containers)

Example: Create Pod via CRI
1. kubelet → CRI: RunPodSandbox
   Create Pod network namespace
   Assign Pod IP: 10.244.1.5
   ↓

2. kubelet → CRI: CreateContainer
   Container spec: {
     image: "nginx:latest",
     command: ["nginx"],
     env: [...],
     mounts: [...]
   }
   ↓

3. CRI → containerd: Create container
   containerd creates container
   Returns containerID: abc123
   ↓

4. kubelet → CRI: StartContainer(abc123)
   CRI → containerd: Start
   Container running!
   ↓

5. kubelet monitors container
   Continuously checks health


2️⃣ kube-proxy - Network Proxy
Vai Trò: Network Traffic Manager
kube-proxy = Traffic cop/Router trong Node
kube-proxy làm gì:
├── Maintain network rules trên Node
├── Enable Service abstraction
├── Load balance traffic to Pods
├── Implement ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer
└── Handle Pod-to-Pod communication

Service Implementation
Cách kube-proxy implement Services:
# Service definition
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  selector:
    app: webapp
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
  type: ClusterIP
kube-proxy tạo rules:
Mode 1: iptables (default, phổ biến nhất)
# kube-proxy tạo iptables rules
 
# Service ClusterIP: 10.96.100.50
# Backend Pods:
# - Pod1: 10.244.1.5:8080
# - Pod2: 10.244.2.8:8080
# - Pod3: 10.244.1.9:8080
 
# iptables rules (simplified):
iptables -A KUBE-SERVICES \
  -d 10.96.100.50/32 -p tcp --dport 80 \
  -j KUBE-SVC-WEBAPP
 
# Load balance to 3 Pods
iptables -A KUBE-SVC-WEBAPP \
  -m statistic --mode random --probability 0.33 \
  -j KUBE-SEP-POD1
 
iptables -A KUBE-SVC-WEBAPP \
  -m statistic --mode random --probability 0.50 \
  -j KUBE-SEP-POD2
 
iptables -A KUBE-SVC-WEBAPP \
  -j KUBE-SEP-POD3
 
# DNAT to actual Pod IPs
iptables -A KUBE-SEP-POD1 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.244.1.5:8080
iptables -A KUBE-SEP-POD2 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.244.2.8:8080
iptables -A KUBE-SEP-POD3 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.244.1.9:8080
Traffic flow:
flowchart LR
    APP["App calls Service<br/>curl http://webapp:80"] --> DNS["DNS resolve<br/>webapp → 10.96.100.50"]
    DNS --> IPT["Kernel iptables<br/>DNAT random"]
    IPT -->|"33%"| P1["🟢 Pod1<br/>10.244.1.5:8080"]
    IPT -->|"33%"| P2["🟢 Pod2<br/>10.244.2.8:8080"]
    IPT -->|"34%"| P3["🟢 Pod3<br/>10.244.1.9:8080"]
    P1 & P2 & P3 -->|Response| APP
    
    style APP fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:#fff
    style IPT fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff

Mode 2: IPVS (IP Virtual Server - better performance)
# kube-proxy creates IPVS virtual server
 
# Install ipvsadm to view
ipvsadm -Ln
 
# Output:
IP Virtual Server version 1.2.1
TCP  10.96.100.50:80 rr  (round-robin)
  -> 10.244.1.5:8080      Masq    1      0          0
  -> 10.244.2.8:8080      Masq    1      0          0
  -> 10.244.1.9:8080      Masq    1      0          0
 
# Load balancing algorithms:
# - rr (round-robin)
# - lc (least connection)
# - dh (destination hashing)
# - sh (source hashing)
IPVS advantages:
vs iptables:
✓ Better performance (O(1) vs O(n))
✓ More load balancing algorithms
✓ Better for large clusters (1000+ services)
✗ Requires kernel modules

NodePort Implementation
Example:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: webapp
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
    nodePort: 30080  # Exposed on all Nodes
kube-proxy rules:
# Listen on NodePort 30080 on ALL Node IPs
# Node1 IP: 192.168.1.10
# Node2 IP: 192.168.1.11
# Node3 IP: 192.168.1.12
 
# iptables rules:
iptables -A KUBE-NODEPORTS \
  -p tcp --dport 30080 \
  -j KUBE-SVC-WEBAPP
 
# Then same load balancing as ClusterIP
Traffic flow:
External user:
curl http://192.168.1.10:30080
    ↓
Hits Node1 on port 30080
    ↓
iptables DNAT to Pod IP
    ↓
Pod on ANY node (could be Node2!)
    ↓
Response back through Node1


3️⃣ Container Runtime
Vai Trò: Chạy Containers
Container Runtime = Engine chạy containers
Container Runtime options:
├── Docker (legacy, deprecated in K8s 1.24+)
├── containerd ✓ (recommended, default in many distros)
├── CRI-O ✓ (lightweight, OCI-compliant)
└── Others (kata, gVisor for security)

containerd Architecture
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              CONTAINERD                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                             │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  CRI Plugin (gRPC)                   │  │
│  │  • Implements CRI                    │  │
│  │  • Interface for kubelet             │  │
│  └────────────┬─────────────────────────┘  │
│               ↓                             │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  containerd Core                     │  │
│  │  • Image management                  │  │
│  │  • Container lifecycle               │  │
│  │  • Snapshots                         │  │
│  └────────────┬─────────────────────────┘  │
│               ↓                             │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  runc (OCI Runtime)                  │  │
│  │  • Low-level container runtime       │  │
│  │  • Create & run containers           │  │
│  │  • cgroups & namespaces              │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
         ↓
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         LINUX KERNEL                        │
│  • Namespaces (isolation)                   │
│  • cgroups (resource limits)                │
│  • Capabilities                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Container Lifecycle
From image to running container:
1. PULL IMAGE
   containerd → Registry (Docker Hub):
   "Download nginx:latest"
   ↓
   Layers downloaded:
   ├── Layer 1: base OS
   ├── Layer 2: nginx binary
   ├── Layer 3: config files
   └── Layer 4: entry point
   ↓
   Stored in: /var/lib/containerd/...
   ↓

2. CREATE CONTAINER
   containerd creates container config:
   {
     "image": "nginx:latest",
     "rootfs": "/var/lib/containerd/...",
     "env": ["PATH=/usr/bin"],
     "cmd": ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"],
     "mounts": [...],
     "namespaces": [
       {"type": "pid"},
       {"type": "network"},
       {"type": "mount"},
       {"type": "uts"}
     ],
     "cgroups": {
       "cpu": {"quota": 50000},  # 500m CPU
       "memory": {"limit": 268435456}  # 256Mi
     }
   }
   ↓

3. START CONTAINER
   runc creates:
   ├── New namespaces (isolation)
   ├── cgroups (resource limits)
   ├── Root filesystem (from image layers)
   └── Network namespace
   ↓
   Execute entrypoint: nginx -g "daemon off;"
   ↓
   Container PID: 12345
   Container running!
   ↓

4. MONITOR
   containerd monitors:
   ├── Process state (running/stopped)
   ├── Resource usage (CPU, RAM)
   └── Exit code if stopped


🔄 Node Components Interaction
Complete Flow: Pod Startup
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  POD STARTUP ON WORKER NODE                       │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

1. SCHEDULER assigns Pod to Node
   API Server: Pod.spec.nodeName = "worker-node-1"
   ↓

2. KUBELET on worker-node-1 watches API Server
   "New Pod assigned to me!"
   Pod: webapp-abc123
   ↓

3. KUBELET → CONTAINER RUNTIME (via CRI)
   "Create Pod sandbox"
   ↓
   Container Runtime:
   ├── Create network namespace
   ├── Setup Pod network (assign IP)
   ├── Pod IP: 10.244.1.5
   └── Return sandbox ID
   ↓

4. KUBELET → CONTAINER RUNTIME
   "Pull image: nginx:latest"
   ↓
   Container Runtime downloads image
   [====== Download 100% ======]
   ↓

5. KUBELET → CONTAINER RUNTIME
   "Create container in sandbox"
   ↓
   Container Runtime:
   ├── Create container from image
   ├── Mount volumes
   ├── Set environment variables
   ├── Configure resources (CPU, RAM limits)
   └── Return container ID
   ↓

6. KUBELET → CONTAINER RUNTIME
   "Start container"
   ↓
   Container Runtime starts container
   Container state: Running
   ↓

7. KUBELET configures KUBE-PROXY
   (via updating Endpoints)
   ↓

8. KUBE-PROXY updates iptables/IPVS
   Add Pod IP to Service backend pool
   Service: webapp
   Backend Pods:
   ├── 10.244.1.5:8080 ← NEW!
   ├── 10.244.2.8:8080
   └── 10.244.1.9:8080
   ↓

9. KUBELET runs health checks
   Liveness: GET http://10.244.1.5:8080/health
   Response: 200 OK ✓
   ↓
   Readiness: GET http://10.244.1.5:8080/ready  
   Response: 200 OK ✓
   ↓

10. KUBELET → API SERVER
    "Pod ready!"
    Pod status:
    ├── phase: Running
    ├── conditions: Ready=True
    ├── podIP: 10.244.1.5
    └── containerStatuses: [...ready...]
    ↓

11. Pod fully operational! ✅
    Receiving traffic from Service


🔍 Troubleshooting Worker Nodes
Common Issues & Solutions
Issue 1: Node NotReady
# Check Node status
kubectl get nodes
NAME           STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
worker-node-1  NotReady   <none>   5d    v1.28.0
 
# Describe Node
kubectl describe node worker-node-1
# Look at conditions and events
 
# Common causes:
# 1. kubelet not running
ssh worker-node-1
sudo systemctl status kubelet
sudo systemctl restart kubelet
 
# 2. Network issue
ping 8.8.8.8  # Check internet
# Check CNI plugin
 
# 3. Resource exhaustion
df -h  # Disk full?
free -m  # Memory pressure?
Issue 2: Pod Stuck in Pending
# Describe Pod
kubectl describe pod webapp-abc123
 
# Check events:
# "0/3 nodes are available: insufficient cpu"
# → Need more resources or scale cluster
 
# "0/3 nodes are available: node(s) had taints"
# → Check node taints
kubectl describe node worker-node-1 | grep Taints
# Add tolerations to Pod if needed
Issue 3: Container Keeps Crashing
# Check Pod logs
kubectl logs webapp-abc123
kubectl logs webapp-abc123 --previous  # Previous crash
 
# Check container status
kubectl describe pod webapp-abc123
# Look at: LastState, Reason (OOMKilled? CrashLoopBackOff?)
 
# Common fixes:
# - Increase memory limits (if OOMKilled)
# - Fix application errors (check logs)
# - Adjust liveness probe (if too aggressive)
Issue 4: Network Problems
# Check Pod can reach Service
kubectl exec webapp-abc123 -- curl http://backend-service
 
# Check DNS
kubectl exec webapp-abc123 -- nslookup backend-service
 
# Check kube-proxy
kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep kube-proxy
kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-proxy-xyz
 
# Check iptables rules
sudo iptables-save | grep KUBE
Debugging Commands
# Node level
kubectl get nodes
kubectl describe node <node-name>
kubectl top node <node-name>
 
# Pod level
kubectl get pods -o wide
kubectl describe pod <pod-name>
kubectl logs <pod-name>
kubectl exec -it <pod-name> -- /bin/bash
 
# Container runtime
# (SSH to node first)
sudo crictl ps  # List containers
sudo crictl logs <container-id>
sudo crictl inspect <container-id>
 
# kubelet
sudo systemctl status kubelet
sudo journalctl -u kubelet -f
 
# Network
kubectl get svc
kubectl get endpoints
sudo iptables-save | grep <service-name>

🎓 Kiểm Tra Hiểu Biết
1. kubelet làm gì khi Pod assigned to Node?

Xem đáp án

Watch API Server, detect new Pod
Pull container image (via Container Runtime)
Create Pod sandbox (network namespace)
Create container(s) from image
Start container(s)
Run health checks (liveness, readiness)
Report Pod status to API Server
Continuously monitor và restart nếu cần


2. kube-proxy implement Service như thế nào?

Xem đáp án
iptables mode (default):

Tạo iptables rules
DNAT Service ClusterIP → Pod IPs
Random load balancing giữa Pods
Update rules khi Pods thay đổi

IPVS mode:

Tạo IPVS virtual servers
Better performance (O(1) lookup)
More load balancing algorithms
Better cho large scale


3. Container Runtime nào recommended?

Xem đáp án
containerd ✓ (recommended)

Lightweight
Industry standard
Default trong nhiều distros
Good performance

CRI-O ✓ (alternative)

Lightweight
OCI-compliant
Designed specifically for K8s

Docker ❌ (deprecated)

Removed in K8s 1.24+
Too heavy for K8s
Use containerd instead



🎯 Key Takeaways


kubelet = Node Supervisor

Manage Pod lifecycle
Report to API Server
Execute health checks



kube-proxy = Network Manager

Implement Services
Load balancing
iptables or IPVS



Container Runtime = Container Engine

containerd recommended
Pull images, run containers
CRI interface với kubelet



Isolation via Linux Kernel

Namespaces (PID, Network, Mount)
cgroups (CPU, Memory limits)
Secure container isolation



Troubleshooting Workflow

Check Node status
Check Pod describe/logs
Check kubelet logs
Check network connectivity

Bạn đã hiểu các components trên Worker Node!

2.4. Component Workflows - Luồng Hoạt Động Giữa Các Thành Phần

Chi tiết cách các thành phần Kubernetes phối hợp với nhau trong mọi tình huống


🎯 Mục Tiêu Học
Sau khi học xong phần này, bạn sẽ:

✅ Hiểu luồng hoạt động end-to-end giữa tất cả components
✅ Trace được mọi workflow từ request đến kết quả
✅ Nắm rõ thứ tự tương tác giữa Control Plane và Worker Nodes
✅ Debug được issues bằng cách hiểu flow đang bị stuck ở đâu
✅ Hiểu watch mechanism và event-driven architecture


📋 Tổng Quan Communication Patterns
Nguyên Tắc Giao Tiếp Cốt Lõi


                  
                  4 Quy Tắc Vàng 
                  
                


MỌI component giao tiếp qua API Server — không ai nói chuyện trực tiếp
CHỈ API Server đọc/ghi etcd — Controllers, Scheduler, kubelet KHÔNG truy cập etcd
Components WATCH API Server cho thay đổi — event-driven, không polling
Mọi thay đổi state: Request → API Server → Validate → etcd → Notify watchers



Bản Đồ Giao Tiếp Tổng Thể
graph TD
    User["👤 User / kubectl"] -->|HTTPS REST API| API["🔀 API Server<br/><i>Central Hub</i>"]
    
    API <-->|"Read/Write"| ETCD["💾 etcd<br/><i>Cluster Database</i>"]
    
    API -->|"Watch"| SCHED["📋 Scheduler"]
    API -->|"Watch"| CM["⚙️ Controller Manager"]
    API -->|"Watch"| KL["🔧 kubelet<br/><i>trên mỗi Node</i>"]
    API -->|"Watch"| KP["🌐 kube-proxy<br/><i>trên mỗi Node</i>"]
    
    CM --> DC["Deployment<br/>Controller"]
    CM --> RSC["ReplicaSet<br/>Controller"]
    CM --> NC["Node<br/>Controller"]
    CM --> EC["Endpoints<br/>Controller"]
    CM --> JC["Job<br/>Controller"]

    KL -->|CRI| CR["📦 Container Runtime<br><i>containerd / CRI-O</i>"]
    CR --> POD1["🟢 Pod"]
    CR --> POD2["🟢 Pod"]
    
    AW["🔌 Admission Webhooks"] -->|"Mutate / Validate"| API
    CC["🧩 Custom Controllers<br/><i>Operators, CRDs</i>"] -->|"Watch + Update"| API

    style API fill:#4a90d9,stroke:#2c5f8a,color:#fff,stroke-width:3px
    style ETCD fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff
    style SCHED fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style CM fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style KL fill:#8e44ad,stroke:#6c3483,color:#fff
    style KP fill:#2980b9,stroke:#1a5276,color:#fff
    style CR fill:#95a5a6,stroke:#7f8c8d,color:#fff


🔄 Workflow 1: Tạo Deployment (Complete Flow)

Scenario: kubectl create deployment webapp --image=nginx --replicas=3

Sequence Diagram
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as 👤 User
    participant API as 🔀 API Server
    participant ETCD as 💾 etcd
    participant DC as ⚙️ Deployment<br/>Controller
    participant RSC as ⚙️ ReplicaSet<br/>Controller
    participant S as 📋 Scheduler
    participant KL as 🔧 kubelet
    participant CR as 📦 Container<br/>Runtime
    
    U->>API: POST /apis/apps/v1/.../deployments
    
    Note over API: 🔐 Authentication<br/>🛡️ Authorization (RBAC)<br/>✅ Admission Control<br/>📝 Validation
    
    API->>ETCD: Write Deployment object
    ETCD-->>API: ACK
    API-->>U: HTTP 201 Created
    
    Note over DC: 👁️ Watch: New Deployment detected!
    DC->>API: Create ReplicaSet (webapp-7d8bc4c5d)
    API->>ETCD: Write ReplicaSet
    
    Note over RSC: 👁️ Watch: New ReplicaSet detected!<br/>Desired=3, Actual=0
    RSC->>API: Create 3 Pods (status: Pending)
    API->>ETCD: Write 3 Pods
    
    Note over S: 👁️ Watch: 3 Pending Pods!<br/>Filter → Score → Bind
    S->>API: Assign Pod → Node (spec.nodeName)
    API->>ETCD: Update Pod bindings
    
    Note over KL: 👁️ Watch: Pod assigned to me!
    KL->>CR: Pull image nginx:latest
    CR-->>KL: Image ready
    KL->>CR: Create + Start container
    CR-->>KL: Container Running
    
    KL->>API: Update Pod status (Running, Ready)
    API->>ETCD: Save Pod status
    
    Note over API: Endpoints Controller:<br/>Add Pod IP to Service Endpoints<br/>kube-proxy updates iptables

Chi Tiết Từng Bước


                  
                  Bước 1-4: API Server xử lý Request 
                  
                


kubectl gửi HTTP POST đến API Server: POST /apis/apps/v1/namespaces/default/deployments
Authentication: Xác minh identity (Client cert? Bearer token? SA token?)
Authorization (RBAC): Kiểm tra quyền — Can user create deployments in default namespace?
Admission Control:

MutatingAdmissionWebhook: Add defaults, inject sidecar (Istio), set LimitRange
ValidatingAdmissionWebhook: Check PodSecurityStandard, image policy, quotas







                  
                  Bước 5-6: Lưu vào etcd và Notify 
                  
                


API Server ghi Deployment vào etcd — Key: /registry/deployments/default/webapp
API Server trả HTTP 201 Created → User thấy: deployment.apps/webapp created





                  
                  Bước 7-8: Deployment Controller tạo ReplicaSet 
                  
                


Deployment Controller (đang watch API Server) phát hiện Deployment mới

Tính toán ReplicaSet hash (pod-template-hash)
Tạo ReplicaSet webapp-7d8bc4c5d với ownerReferences → Deployment/webapp


API Server lưu ReplicaSet, notify watchers





                  
                  Bước 9-10: ReplicaSet Controller tạo Pods 
                  
                


ReplicaSet Controller: “Desired: 3, Actual: 0” → Tạo 3 Pod objects

Mỗi Pod có ownerReferences → ReplicaSet, status: Pending, spec.nodeName: ""


API Server lưu 3 Pods vào etcd (status: Pending)





                  
                  Bước 11-12: Scheduler phân công Nodes 
                  
                


Scheduler watch Pods không có nodeName:

Filtering: Node đủ CPU/RAM? Taint/toleration? NodeSelector? MaxPods?
Scoring: LeastRequested, BalancedResource, SelectorSpread, ImageLocality
Binding: Update Pod.spec.nodeName = "worker-X"


API Server cập nhật etcd — Pod vẫn Pending (container chưa running)





                  
                  Bước 13-15: kubelet khởi động Containers 
                  
                


kubelet trên Worker Node:

Init Containers (tuần tự) → Pod Sandbox (network namespace, Pod IP) → Pull image → Create + Start containers → PostStart hook


Health Checks: startupProbe → livenessProbe → readinessProbe
kubelet → API Server: Update Pod status {phase: Running, Ready: True}





                  
                  Bước 16: kube-proxy cập nhật Network Rules 
                  
                

Endpoints Controller add Pod IP vào Endpoints → kube-proxy update iptables/IPVS → Pod bắt đầu nhận traffic!



🔄 Workflow 2: Self-Healing (Pod Crash + Recovery)

Scenario: Một container crash do OOMKilled hoặc application error

flowchart TD
    CRASH["💥 Container Crashes<br/><i>OOMKilled / App Error / Liveness Fail</i>"]
    
    CRASH --> KL_DETECT["🔧 kubelet detects crash<br/>Container: Running → Terminated"]
    
    KL_DETECT --> POLICY{"restartPolicy?"}
    
    POLICY -->|"Always<br/>(Deployment default)"| RESTART["🔄 kubelet restarts container"]
    POLICY -->|"OnFailure"| CHECK_EXIT{"exit code != 0?"}
    POLICY -->|"Never"| NO_RESTART["❌ No restart"]
    
    CHECK_EXIT -->|Yes| RESTART
    CHECK_EXIT -->|No| NO_RESTART
    
    RESTART --> BACKOFF["⏱️ Exponential Backoff<br/>0s → 10s → 20s → 40s → ... → 5min max<br/><i>CrashLoopBackOff nếu liên tục fail</i>"]
    
    BACKOFF --> SUCCESS{"Container<br/>starts OK?"}
    SUCCESS -->|Yes| RUNNING["🟢 Container Running<br/>kubelet → API: Ready=True"]
    SUCCESS -->|No| BACKOFF
    
    RUNNING --> EP_ADD["Endpoints Controller:<br/>Add Pod IP back"]
    EP_ADD --> KP_ADD["kube-proxy: Update rules<br/>→ Pod nhận traffic lại ✅"]
    
    NO_RESTART --> STATUS["kubelet → API Server<br/>Update status: Failed"]
    STATUS --> RSC_CHECK["ReplicaSet Controller:<br/>Desired=3, Actual=2"]
    RSC_CHECK --> NEW_POD["Tạo Pod mới → Scheduler → kubelet"]
    
    style CRASH fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff
    style RUNNING fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style BACKOFF fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style NO_RESTART fill:#95a5a6,stroke:#7f8c8d,color:#fff



                  
                  Node Failure Recovery 
                  
                

Nếu Node chết (không phải chỉ container crash):

Node Controller detects heartbeat lost (40s) → Mark NotReady
After 5 minutes → Evict Pods, add taint unreachable:NoExecute
ReplicaSet Controller tạo Pods mới → Scheduler đưa lên Nodes khác
→ Xem chi tiết tại Workflow 5: Node Failure




🔄 Workflow 3: Rolling Update

Scenario: Update image nginx:1.19 → nginx:1.20

Orchestration Flow
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as 👤 User
    participant API as 🔀 API Server
    participant DC as ⚙️ Deployment<br/>Controller
    participant OLD as 📦 Old ReplicaSet<br/>nginx:1.19
    participant NEW as 📦 New ReplicaSet<br/>nginx:1.20
    
    U->>API: kubectl set image deployment/webapp nginx=nginx:1.20
    API->>API: Update Deployment spec → etcd
    
    Note over DC: 👁️ Template changed!<br/>Rolling update needed!
    
    DC->>API: Create NEW ReplicaSet (replicas=0)
    
    rect rgb(200, 230, 200)
        Note over DC,NEW: Round 1
        DC->>NEW: Scale UP: 0 → 1
        Note over NEW: Wait for Pod Ready... ✅
        DC->>OLD: Scale DOWN: 3 → 2
    end
    
    rect rgb(200, 220, 240)
        Note over DC,NEW: Round 2
        DC->>NEW: Scale UP: 1 → 2
        Note over NEW: Wait for Pod Ready... ✅
        DC->>OLD: Scale DOWN: 2 → 1
    end
    
    rect rgb(220, 200, 240)
        Note over DC,NEW: Round 3
        DC->>NEW: Scale UP: 2 → 3
        Note over NEW: Wait for Pod Ready... ✅
        DC->>OLD: Scale DOWN: 1 → 0
    end
    
    Note over DC: ✅ Rollout Complete!<br/>revision: 2<br/>Old RS kept (replicas=0, for rollback)

Rolling Update Progress Visualization
gantt
    title Rolling Update Progress (maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=0)
    dateFormat X
    axisFormat %s
    
    section Old RS (nginx:1.19)
    Pod A (old) :active, a1, 0, 20
    Pod B (old) :active, a2, 0, 35
    Pod C (old) :active, a3, 0, 50
    
    section New RS (nginx:1.20)
    Pod D (new) :done, b1, 5, 65
    Pod E (new) :done, b2, 20, 65
    Pod F (new) :done, b3, 35, 65



                  
                  Rollback 
                  
                

kubectl rollout undo deployment/webapp
Deployment Controller lấy ReplicaSet cũ (revision 1), scale UP old RS, scale DOWN current RS — cùng rolling process.




                  
                  Zero Downtime 
                  
                

Trong suốt quá trình rolling update:

Endpoints Controller thêm Pod mới Ready vào Service endpoints
Endpoints Controller xóa Pod cũ đang terminate
kube-proxy cập nhật iptables → Traffic luôn có healthy backends




🔄 Workflow 4: Service Discovery & Traffic Routing

Scenario: Pod A gọi Service B

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant PodA as 🟢 Pod A<br/>(caller)
    participant DNS as 🌐 CoreDNS
    participant KERNEL as 🐧 Kernel<br/>iptables/IPVS
    participant KP as kube-proxy
    participant PodB as 🟢 Pod B<br/>(backend)
    
    Note over KP: Setup phase (trước khi Pod A gọi):<br/>Watch Services + Endpoints<br/>→ Tạo iptables/IPVS rules
    
    PodA->>DNS: DNS lookup: "backend"
    DNS-->>PodA: backend.default.svc.cluster.local<br/>→ 10.96.50.100 (ClusterIP)
    
    PodA->>KERNEL: TCP connect to 10.96.50.100:80
    
    Note over KERNEL: DNAT via iptables/IPVS:<br/>10.96.50.100:80 →<br/>10.244.2.8:8080 (random Pod)
    
    KERNEL->>PodB: Packet to 10.244.2.8:8080
    PodB-->>PodA: Response (reverse path)

Traffic Routing Architecture
graph LR
    subgraph "Service: backend (ClusterIP: 10.96.50.100)"
        SVC["🔀 Service<br/>backend:80"]
    end
    
    subgraph "iptables/IPVS Rules (set by kube-proxy)"
        LB{"⚖️ Load Balance<br/>(random/round-robin)"}
    end
    
    subgraph "Backend Pods (Endpoints)"
        P1["🟢 Pod 1<br/>10.244.1.5:8080"]
        P2["🟢 Pod 2<br/>10.244.2.8:8080"]
        P3["🟢 Pod 3<br/>10.244.3.12:8080"]
    end
    
    SVC --> LB
    LB -->|"33%"| P1
    LB -->|"33%"| P2
    LB -->|"34%"| P3
    
    style SVC fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:#fff
    style LB fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style P1 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style P2 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style P3 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff



                  
                  Các bước setup Service routing 
                  
                


Service tạo → API Server lưu → ClusterIP assigned (10.96.50.100)
Endpoints Controller watch Services + Pods → tạo Endpoints object với Pod IPs
kube-proxy trên MỌI Node → tạo iptables DNAT rules hoặc IPVS virtual server
CoreDNS watch Services → tạo DNS record backend.default.svc.cluster.local
CNI Plugin routes packet: Same Node → veth pair; Different Node → overlay (VXLAN)




🔄 Workflow 5: Node Failure & Recovery

Scenario: Worker Node mất kết nối (crash, network issue)

Timeline
timeline
    title Node Failure Detection & Recovery Timeline
    
    T=0s : Node stops sending heartbeats
         : kubelet gửi heartbeat mỗi 10s qua NodeLease
    
    T=0-40s : Node Controller chờ heartbeats
            : nodeStatusUpdateFrequency 10s
            : 4 lần miss → trigger
    
    T=40s : Node marked NotReady
          : kubectl get nodes → STATUS=NotReady
          : Endpoints Controller remove Pods từ Service
          : kube-proxy remove iptables rules
    
    T=40s-5min : Grace Period
               : Pods vẫn ghi nhận trên Node cũ
               : Traffic không đến dead Node nữa
    
    T=5min : Pod Eviction
           : Taint unreachable:NoExecute added
           : Pods evicted → Terminating
           : ReplicaSet Controller tạo Pods mới
    
    T=5min+ : Recovery Complete ✅
            : New Pods on healthy Nodes
            : Endpoints + kube-proxy updated

Recovery Flow
flowchart LR
    A["💀 Node Dies"] --> B["Node Controller<br/>detects (40s)"]
    B --> C["Mark NotReady"]
    C --> D["Grace Period<br/>(5 min)"]
    D --> E["Evict Pods"]
    E --> F["RS Controller:<br/>Create new Pods"]
    F --> G["Scheduler<br/>→ healthy Nodes"]
    G --> H["kubelet starts<br/>containers"]
    H --> I["✅ Recovered"]
    
    style A fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff
    style I fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style D fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff



                  
                  Nếu Node Comeback 
                  
                


kubelet reconnect → API Server
Node status → Ready again
kubelet cleanup Pods đã bị evict (Terminating → Removed)
Node sẵn sàng nhận Pods mới




🔄 Workflow 6: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA)

Scenario: Auto-scale dựa trên CPU usage

HPA Control Loop
flowchart TD
    subgraph "Metrics Pipeline"
        CA["cAdvisor<br/><i>trên mỗi Node</i>"] -->|"container metrics"| KL["kubelet"]
        KL -->|"expose metrics"| MS["📊 Metrics Server<br/><i>kube-system</i>"]
    end
    
    subgraph "HPA Decision (mỗi 15s)"
        MS -->|"/apis/metrics.k8s.io"| HPA["📈 HPA Controller"]
        HPA --> CALC["🧮 Calculate:<br/>desiredReplicas = ⌈current × (actual/target)⌉<br/><br/>Ví dụ: ⌈3 × (84.67/50)⌉ = 6"]
        CALC --> DECISION{"Scale<br/>needed?"}
    end
    
    subgraph "Scale Action"
        DECISION -->|"Scale UP"| UP["▲ Update replicas: 3→6<br/>→ Deploy Controller → RS Controller<br/>→ Scheduler → kubelet"]
        DECISION -->|"Scale DOWN"| DOWN["▼ Stabilization 5min<br/>Gradual: 6→5→4→3→2"]
        DECISION -->|"No change"| WAIT["⏳ Wait 15s<br/>Check again"]
    end
    
    style HPA fill:#9b59b6,stroke:#8e44ad,color:#fff
    style UP fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style DOWN fill:#e67e22,stroke:#d35400,color:#fff



                  
                  Tính toán ví dụ 
                  
                


Setup: HPA min=2, max=10, targetCPU=50%, mỗi Pod request 500m CPU
Current: 3 Pods — Pod1: 450m (90%), Pod2: 400m (80%), Pod3: 420m (84%)
Average: (90 + 80 + 84) / 3 = 84.67%
Formula: ceil(3 × (84.67 / 50)) = ceil(5.08) = 6
Decision: Scale 3 → 6 Pods (trong giới hạn max=10)





                  
                  Scale Down Behavior 
                  
                


Stabilization window: 5 phút (mặc định) — chờ metrics ổn định
Gradual decrease: Không scale down đột ngột, giảm từ từ
Tránh “flapping” (scale up/down liên tục)




🔄 Workflow 7: Pod Termination (Graceful Shutdown)

Scenario: kubectl delete pod webapp-abc12

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as 👤 User
    participant API as 🔀 API Server
    participant EP as Endpoints<br/>Controller
    participant KP as kube-proxy
    participant KL as 🔧 kubelet
    participant C as 📦 Container

    U->>API: kubectl delete pod webapp-abc12
    API->>API: Set deletionTimestamp<br/>Set gracePeriod=30s<br/>Status: Terminating

    par Parallel Actions
        API->>EP: Pod has deletionTimestamp
        EP->>KP: Remove Pod IP from Endpoints
        Note over KP: iptables updated<br/>❌ No new traffic
    and
        API->>KL: Pod update notification
        KL->>C: Execute preStop hook
        Note over C: nginx -s quit
        KL->>C: Send SIGTERM (PID 1)
        Note over C: ⏳ Graceful shutdown...<br/>Close connections<br/>Finish in-flight requests<br/>Flush buffers
    end

    alt Container exits within 30s
        C-->>KL: Exit code 0
        Note over C: ✅ Clean shutdown
    else Container still running at 30s
        KL->>C: 💀 Send SIGKILL (force kill)
        Note over C: ❌ Immediate termination
    end

    KL->>API: Pod terminated
    API->>API: Remove Pod from etcd
    Note over API: Pod no longer exists



                  
                  Grace Period quan trọng! 
                  
                

preStop hook + SIGTERM chia sẻ terminationGracePeriodSeconds!
Ví dụ: gracePeriod = 30s

preStop hook mất 25s → SIGTERM chỉ còn 5s trước SIGKILL
Nếu app cần 15s để shutdown → tăng terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60




🔄 Workflow 8: Persistent Volume Provisioning

Scenario: Pod cần storage (PVC → PV → Mount)

Dynamic Provisioning Flow
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as 👤 User
    participant API as 🔀 API Server
    participant PVC as 📋 PV Controller
    participant PROV as 🔌 Provisioner<br/>(CSI Driver)
    participant S as 📋 Scheduler
    participant KL as 🔧 kubelet

    U->>API: Create PVC (10Gi, storageClass: standard)
    API->>API: Save PVC (status: Pending)
    
    Note over PVC: 👁️ Watch: New PVC!<br/>No matching PV found<br/>StorageClass has provisioner
    
    PVC->>PROV: Trigger dynamic provisioning
    PROV->>PROV: Call storage backend API<br/>(AWS EBS / GCE PD / NFS / Ceph)
    PROV->>API: Create PV object (10Gi, claimRef→PVC)
    
    PVC->>API: Bind PV ↔ PVC
    Note over API: PV: Available → Bound<br/>PVC: Pending → Bound
    
    U->>API: Create Pod with PVC reference
    
    S->>S: Check volume topology<br/>(PV zone must match Node zone)
    S->>API: Assign Pod to compatible Node
    
    KL->>KL: Attach volume to Node
    KL->>KL: Format filesystem (first time)
    KL->>KL: Mount to Pod path
    Note over KL: ✅ Container sees<br/>mounted storage



                  
                  Storage Lifecycle 
                  
                

PVC Created → PV Provisioned → Bind → Pod Mount → Pod Delete → Reclaim
                                                                   ↓
                                                         Retain / Delete / Recycle




🔄 Workflow 9: Admission Control Pipeline

Scenario: Request đi qua admission pipeline trong API Server

flowchart TD
    REQ["📨 Request arrives<br/>at API Server"] --> AUTH

    subgraph "Phase 1: Identity"
        AUTH["🔐 AUTHENTICATION<br/><i>Who are you?</i><br/>x509 cert │ Bearer token │ OIDC │ SA token"]
        AUTHZ["🛡️ AUTHORIZATION<br/><i>What can you do?</i><br/>RBAC │ ABAC │ Webhook"]
    end
    
    subgraph "Phase 2: Admission"
        MUT["✏️ MUTATING ADMISSION<br/><i>Modify the request</i><br/>DefaultStorageClass │ LimitRanger<br/>ServiceAccount │ Istio sidecar inject"]

        VAL["✅ VALIDATING ADMISSION<br/><i>Should we allow this?</i><br/>ResourceQuota │ PodSecurity<br/>OPA/Gatekeeper │ Kyverno"]
    end
    
    subgraph "Phase 3: Persist"
        SAVE["💾 PERSIST TO etcd<br/>Assign UID │ Set resourceVersion<br/>Set creationTimestamp │ Trigger watches"]
    end

    AUTH -->|"Identity verified"| AUTHZ
    AUTHZ -->|"Allowed"| MUT
    MUT -->|"Request modified"| SCHEMA
    SCHEMA -->|"Schema valid"| VAL
    VAL -->|"Admitted"| SAVE
    
    AUTH -->|"❌ 401 Unauthorized"| DENY["❌ Request Denied"]
    AUTHZ -->|"❌ 403 Forbidden"| DENY
    VAL -->|"❌ Policy violation"| DENY

🔄 Workflow 10: ConfigMap/Secret Update Propagation

Scenario: Update ConfigMap, Pods nhận thay đổi

flowchart TD
    subgraph "Volume Mount Method ✅"
        UPD1["kubectl edit configmap"] --> API1["API Server → etcd"]
        API1 --> KL1["kubelet sync<br/><i>~60s period</i>"]
        KL1 --> FILE["Update mounted file<br/>/etc/config/LOG_LEVEL<br/>info → debug"]
        FILE --> APP1{"App detects<br/>file change?"}
        APP1 -->|"inotify/fswatch"| RELOAD["✅ Auto reload"]
        APP1 -->|"No detection"| MANUAL["Need restart Pod"]
    end
    
    subgraph "Env Var Method ❌"
        UPD2["kubectl edit configmap"] --> API2["API Server → etcd"]
        API2 --> NOCHANGE["⚠️ Env vars<br/>NOT auto-updated"]
        NOCHANGE --> RESTART["kubectl rollout restart<br/>deployment/webapp"]
    end
    
    style UPD1 fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:#fff
    style UPD2 fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:#fff
    style RELOAD fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style NOCHANGE fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff



                  
                  Volume Mount vs Environment Variable 
                  
                






























MethodAuto-Update?DelayCần app support?Volume Mount✅ Có~1-2 phútCó (detect file change)Environment Variable❌ KhôngCần restartKhôngImmutable ConfigMap❌ KhôngN/ATạo ConfigMap mới



📊 Tổng Hợp: Component Responsibilities Matrix

Ownership Chain
graph LR
    DEPLOY["📦 Deployment"] -->|"owns"| RS["📋 ReplicaSet"]
    RS -->|"owns"| POD["🟢 Pod"]
    POD -->|"runs on"| NODE["🖥️ Node"]
    POD -->|"uses"| SVC["🔀 Service"]
    POD -->|"mounts"| PVC["💾 PVC"]

🎓 Kiểm Tra Hiểu Biết
Câu 1: Trace the Flow
Tình huống: Bạn chạy kubectl scale deployment webapp --replicas=5
Liệt kê THỨ TỰ các components tham gia và actions của chúng.

Xem đáp án
1. kubectl → API Server: PATCH Deployment (replicas: 5)
2. API Server: Authn → Authz → Admission → Validate
3. API Server → etcd: Update Deployment.spec.replicas = 5
4. Deployment Controller (watch): Detect replicas changed
5. Deployment Controller → API Server: Update ReplicaSet.spec.replicas = 5
6. ReplicaSet Controller (watch): "Desired: 5, Actual: 3"
7. ReplicaSet Controller → API Server: Create 2 new Pods (Pending)
8. API Server → etcd: Save 2 new Pods
9. Scheduler (watch Pending Pods): Assign Pods to Nodes
10. Scheduler → API Server: Update Pod.spec.nodeName
11. kubelet on target Nodes (watch): Pull image, create, start containers
12. kubelet → API Server: Update Pod status (Running, Ready)
13. Endpoints Controller: Add new Pod IPs to Endpoints
14. kube-proxy: Update iptables/IPVS rules
15. → 5 Pods running, receiving traffic ✅


Câu 2: Troubleshooting
Tình huống: Pod stuck ở Pending rất lâu. Dựa vào workflow knowledge, bạn sẽ debug ở đâu?

Xem đáp án
Pod Pending = stuck ở Scheduler phase. Kiểm tra:
# 1. Xem events
kubectl describe pod <pod-name>
# Events sẽ chỉ rõ lý do:
#   "0/3 nodes are available: insufficient cpu"
#   "0/3 nodes are available: node(s) had taint..."
#   "no persistent volumes available"
 
# 2. Check Node resources
kubectl top nodes
kubectl describe nodes | grep -A 5 "Allocated resources"
 
# 3. Check taints
kubectl describe nodes | grep Taints
 
# 4. Check PVC (nếu dùng storage)
kubectl get pvc
 
# 5. Check Scheduler logs
kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-scheduler-<master-node>


                  
                  Root causes phổ biến 
                  
                


Insufficient CPU/Memory trên tất cả Nodes
Node taints không có tolerations
PVC chưa bound
nodeSelector/nodeAffinity không match Node nào
Pod priority thấp hơn, bị preempted




Câu 3: Architecture Design
Tình huống: Tại sao tất cả components phải nói chuyện qua API Server thay vì trực tiếp?

Xem đáp án


                  
                  1. Security — Centralized Auth 
                  
                


✅ Một điểm authentication/authorization + audit logging
❌ Direct: Mỗi component phải tự implement auth





                  
                  2. Consistency — Single Source of Truth 
                  
                


✅ Tất cả state qua 1 gateway → etcd, optimistic concurrency
❌ Direct: Data inconsistency, race conditions, lost updates





                  
                  3. Extensibility 
                  
                


✅ Admission webhooks, custom controllers, CRDs sử dụng cùng API
❌ Direct: Hard to extend, tight coupling





                  
                  4. Watch Mechanism 
                  
                


✅ Efficient event notification, async architecture
❌ Direct: Polling overhead, missed events





🚀 Tiếp Theo
Bạn đã hiểu chi tiết cách các components phối hợp với nhau!
Next: Phần 3: Core Concepts →
Ở phần tiếp theo, chúng ta sẽ bắt tay vào hands-on với Pods, Namespaces, và Labels.

⬅️ 2.3. Worker Nodes | 🏠 Mục Lục Chính | 📂 Phần 2: Architecture | ➡️ Phần 3: Core Concepts

02---areas/k8s/02-architecture/readme.content:
📘 Phần 2: Architecture - Kiến Trúc Kubernetes

Hiểu sâu cách Kubernetes hoạt động bên trong


🎯 Mục Tiêu Phần Này
Sau khi hoàn thành Phần 2, bạn sẽ:
✅ Hiểu kiến trúc tổng thể của Kubernetes Cluster
✅ Nắm rõ vai trò của từng component
✅ Biết cách components tương tác với nhau
✅ Troubleshoot được architecture-level issues
✅ Có foundation vững để làm việc với K8s

📚 Nội Dung
2.1. Tổng Quan Kiến Trúc ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Thời gian: 45-60 phút
Nội dung:

Kubernetes Cluster là gì
Big picture: Control Plane + Worker Nodes
Kiến trúc tổng thể (detailed diagram)
Control Plane vs Worker Nodes
Communication flow overview
Design principles (tại sao kiến trúc này?)

Key Concepts:
✓ Cluster = Control Plane + Worker Nodes
✓ Separation of concerns (brain vs workers)
✓ Declarative API pattern
✓ Watch & reconciliation loop
✓ API-driven architecture

Bài Tập:

Identify components (Control Plane hay Worker?)
Vẽ flow: kubectl create deployment
Trace self-healing workflow

🎯 Key Takeaways - Phần 2
10 Điều Quan Trọng Nhất
1. Cluster Architecture
Cluster = Control Plane (brain) + Worker Nodes (workers)
Separation of concerns = Scalable + Maintainable

2. API Server = Central Hub
All communication goes through API Server
Only component talking to etcd
Authentication, Authorization, Validation

3. etcd = Critical Database
Stores ALL cluster state
Distributed, consistent
MUST backup regularly!

4. Scheduler = Smart Placement
Filter (can run?) → Score (best fit?) → Bind
Consider: resources, constraints, affinity
Optimize cluster utilization

5. Controllers = Self-Healing
Watch loop: Desired vs Actual
Automatic reconciliation
Multiple controllers for different resources

6. kubelet = Pod Manager
Agent on each Node
Manages Pod lifecycle
Reports status to API Server

7. kube-proxy = Service Implementation
Maintains network rules (iptables/IPVS)
Enables Service abstraction
Load balances to Pods

8. Container Runtime
containerd recommended (not Docker!)
CRI interface với kubelet
Manages container lifecycle

9. Watch Pattern Everywhere
Components watch API Server for changes
Event-driven architecture
React to state changes

10. Declarative API
Describe desired state
K8s makes it happen
Reconciliation = continuous convergence

❓ FAQs
Q: Có thể có nhiều Control Plane nodes không?
A: Có! (High Availability setup)
- Multiple API Server instances (load balanced)
- Multiple Controller Manager (leader election)
- Multiple Scheduler (leader election)
- etcd cluster (3 or 5 nodes)

→ Survive Control Plane node failures!

Q: Worker Node có thể là Control Plane không?
A: Technically yes, nhưng NOT recommended production

Single-node cluster:
✓ Learning/development (minikube, kind)
✗ Production

Separation Control Plane + Workers:
✓ Better resource allocation
✓ Better security
✓ Better scaling

Q: Tại sao không let components talk to etcd directly?
A: Security và consistency!

If direct access:
❌ No validation
❌ No authorization  
❌ Inconsistent updates
❌ Hard to audit

Via API Server:
✓ Centralized validation
✓ Fine-grained RBAC
✓ Audit logging
✓ Consistent interface

Q: iptables vs IPVS - nên dùng gì?
A: Depends on scale

iptables (default):
✓ Stable, mature
✓ Good < 1000 services
✗ Performance degrades với nhiều services

IPVS:
✓ Better performance (O(1))
✓ More load balancing algorithms
✓ Good for large scale (1000+ services)
✗ Requires kernel modules

Q: Có thể thay đổi Scheduler logic không?
A: Có! Multiple options:

1. Custom Scheduler
   - Viết scheduler riêng
   - Deploy alongside default
   - Specify trong Pod: schedulerName: custom

2. Scheduler Extenders
   - Extend default scheduler
   - Add custom filter/score logic

3. Scheduler Framework
   - Plugin architecture (K8s 1.15+)
   - Write plugins for custom logic

🏢 Cluster Là Gì?
Định Nghĩa
Kubernetes Cluster = Tập hợp servers (Nodes) làm việc cùng nhau như một hệ thống thống nhất.

Cluster giống như một tòa nhà văn phòng:

│   ├── CFO Office (etcd)
│   ├── HR Office (Scheduler)
│   └── Operations Office (Controllers)
│
└── 👷 Các Tầng Làm Việc (Worker Nodes)
    ├── Tầng 2: Developer teams
    ├── Tầng 3: QA teams
    ├── Tầng 4: DevOps teams
    └── Tầng 5+: More teams...

🖥️ Node Là Gì?
Định Nghĩa
Node = Một server (physical hoặc virtual) trong Kubernetes Cluster.
Loại Nodes
1. Master Node (Control Plane Node)
Vai trò: Điều khiển và quản lý cluster
Chạy: Control Plane components
  ├── kube-apiserver
  ├── etcd
  ├── kube-scheduler
  └── kube-controller-manager

Số lượng: 
├── 1 node: OK cho dev/test
├── 3 nodes: Recommended cho production (HA)
└── 5 nodes: Large production clusters

Tài nguyên: Ít hơn Workers (không chạy apps)

2. Worker Node
Vai trò: Chạy application workloads
Chạy: Node components + Application Pods
  ├── kubelet
  ├── kube-proxy
  ├── Container Runtime
  └── Application Pods

Số lượng: Nhiều (10, 100, 1000+ nodes)
Tài nguyên: Nhiều CPU/RAM cho applications

🚀 Setup Local Cluster
Option 1: Minikube (Recommended cho beginners)
Install Minikube:

brew install minikube
 
# Linux
curl -LO storage.googleapis.com/minikube/releases/latest/minikube-linux-amd64
sudo install minikube-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/minikube
 
# Windows (with Chocolatey)
choco install minikube
 
# Verify installation
minikube version
Start Cluster:
# Start với default settings
minikube start

Option 2: kind (Kubernetes in Docker)
Install kind:
# macOS/Linux
brew install kind
 
# Linux (binary)
curl -Lo ./kind kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/v0.20.0/kind-linux-amd64
chmod +x ./kind
sudo mv ./kind /usr/local/bin/kind
 
# Verify
kind version
Create Cluster:
# Simple single-node cluster
kind create cluster
 
# Multi-node cluster
cat <<EOF | kind create cluster --config=-
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
nodes:
- role: control-plane
- role: worker
- role: worker
- role: worker
EOF
 
# List clusters
kind get clusters
 
# Get cluster info
kubectl cluster-info --context kind-kind
 
# Delete cluster
kind delete cluster

Option 3: Docker Desktop (Easiest cho Windows/Mac)
1. Install Docker Desktop
2. Settings → Kubernetes → Enable Kubernetes
3. Apply & Restart
