02---areas/k8s/05-networking/03-pod-netw.content:
5.3. Pod Networking - Network Fundamentals

Hiểu cách Pods communicate trong Kubernetes


🎯 Mục Tiêu Học
Sau khi học xong phần này, bạn sẽ:

✅ Hiểu Pod network model trong K8s
✅ Biết CNI (Container Network Interface) là gì
✅ Understand Pod-to-Pod communication
✅ Hiểu Network Policies cho security
✅ Troubleshoot network connectivity
✅ Choose CNI plugin phù hợp


📦 Kubernetes Network Model
K8s Network Requirements
Kubernetes imposes 3 fundamental requirements:
1. PODS CAN COMMUNICATE với tất cả Pods khác
   - Without NAT (no address translation)
   - Direct Pod-to-Pod communication
   - Across any Nodes

2. NODES CAN COMMUNICATE với tất cả Pods
   - kubelet, system daemons can reach Pods
   - No NAT required

3. POD'S IP = IP OTHERS SEE IT AS
   - Pod sees itself với same IP others see
   - No NAT, no port mapping
   - Transparent networking

Giải Thích Bằng Ví Dụ
Traditional VM/Docker networking:
Host 1 (IP: 192.168.1.10)
├── Container A (IP: 172.17.0.2)  ← Private IP
├── Container B (IP: 172.17.0.3)  ← Private IP
└── NAT to communicate outside

Container A → Container B on Host 2:
❌ Can't reach directly (private IPs)
✓ Must go through Host IP + port mapping
✓ Complex NAT và routing

Kubernetes networking:
Node 1 (IP: 192.168.1.10)
├── Pod A (IP: 10.244.1.5)  ← Cluster-wide routable
├── Pod B (IP: 10.244.1.6)  ← Cluster-wide routable
└── No NAT required

Node 2 (IP: 192.168.1.11)
├── Pod C (IP: 10.244.2.5)  ← Cluster-wide routable
└── Pod D (IP: 10.244.2.6)  ← Cluster-wide routable

Pod A → Pod C:
✓ Direct communication (10.244.1.5 → 10.244.2.5)
✓ No NAT, no port mapping
✓ Simple, flat network


🌐 CNI (Container Network Interface)
Định Nghĩa
CNI = Specification và libraries để configure network interfaces trong Linux containers.
Vai Trò
CNI Plugin responsibilities:
├── Assign IP address to Pod
├── Setup network interface trong Pod
├── Configure routes
├── Setup network policies
└── Enable Pod-to-Pod communication

Kubernetes → CNI Plugin → Network configured

Popular CNI Plugins
1. Calico
Features:
✓ Network policies (security)
✓ BGP routing
✓ IPAM (IP Address Management)
✓ Encryption (WireGuard)
✓ Performance (no overlay needed)

Use cases:
- Production clusters
- Need network policies
- Performance critical
- Large scale (1000+ nodes)

2. Flannel
Features:
✓ Simple setup
✓ VXLAN overlay
✓ Minimal config
✗ No network policies

Use cases:
- Development clusters
- Simple networking needs
- Learning K8s

3. Cilium
Features:
✓ eBPF-based (kernel-level)
✓ Network policies (L3-L7)
✓ Service mesh features
✓ Observability
✓ High performance

Use cases:
- Modern infrastructure
- Need advanced features
- Security-focused
- Observability needs

4. Weave Net
Features:
✓ Automatic setup
✓ Encryption
✓ Multicast support
✓ Simple operation

Use cases:
- Quick setup
- Encryption needed
- Cross-cloud networking


🔄 Pod-to-Pod Communication
Same Node Communication
┌────────────────────────────────────┐
│         NODE 1                     │
│                                    │
│  ┌─────────┐      ┌─────────┐    │
│  │ Pod A   │      │ Pod B   │    │
│  │ 10.244.1.5     │ 10.244.1.6    │
│  └────┬────┘      └────┬────┘    │
│       │                 │         │
│       └────────┬────────┘         │
│                │                   │
│          [Linux Bridge]           │
│                │                   │
│          [Node NIC]               │
└────────────────────────────────────┘

Flow: Pod A → Pod B (same Node)
1. Packet from Pod A (10.244.1.5)
2. Goes to Linux bridge (virtual switch)
3. Bridge forwards to Pod B (10.244.1.6)
4. Direct L2 communication (fast!)

Cross-Node Communication
┌──────────────────────┐       ┌──────────────────────┐
│     NODE 1           │       │     NODE 2           │
│                      │       │                      │
│  ┌─────────┐        │       │  ┌─────────┐        │
│  │ Pod A   │        │       │  │ Pod C   │        │
│  │ 10.244.1.5       │       │  │ 10.244.2.5       │
│  └────┬────┘        │       │  └────┬────┘        │
│       │              │       │       │              │
│  [Linux Bridge]     │       │  [Linux Bridge]     │
│       │              │       │       │              │
│  [Node NIC]         │       │  [Node NIC]         │
│  192.168.1.10       │       │  192.168.1.11       │
└──────┼──────────────┘       └──────┼──────────────┘
       │                              │
       └──────────[Network]──────────┘

Flow: Pod A → Pod C (different Node)
1. Packet from Pod A (10.244.1.5 → 10.244.2.5)
2. Goes to Linux bridge
3. Bridge sees destination on different Node
4. Routes via Node network (192.168.1.10 → 192.168.1.11)
5. Node 2 receives, forwards to Pod C
6. Pod C receives packet

CNI Plugin handles:
- Routing between Node networks
- Encapsulation (if overlay network)
- Route tables configuration


🔒 Network Policies
Định Nghĩa
Network Policy = Firewall rules cho Pods, control ingress và egress traffic.
Default Behavior (No NetworkPolicies)
Without Network Policies:
├── ALL Pods can communicate với ALL Pods
├── ALL Pods can reach external internet
├── ALL external traffic can reach Pods (if exposed)
└── No restrictions (open network)

→ Not secure for production!

Tại Sao Cần Network Policies?
Scenario: Microservices Application

┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐
│  Frontend   │────→│   Backend   │────→│  Database   │
│   Pods      │     │    Pods     │     │    Pods     │
└─────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └─────────────┘

Without Network Policies:
❌ Frontend can directly access Database (security risk!)
❌ Database accepts traffic from any Pod
❌ No segmentation
❌ Lateral movement if compromised

With Network Policies:
✓ Frontend can ONLY access Backend
✓ Backend can ONLY access Database
✓ Database accepts ONLY from Backend
✓ Network segmentation
✓ Reduced blast radius


Network Policy Example
Deny All Ingress (Default Deny)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-all-ingress
  namespace: production
spec:
  podSelector: {}  # Apply to ALL Pods in namespace
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  # No ingress rules = deny all
Allow Specific Ingress
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-frontend-to-backend
  namespace: production
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend  # Apply to backend Pods
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: frontend  # Allow from frontend Pods only
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080  # Allow only port 8080
Traffic flow:
Frontend Pod (app=frontend)
  ↓ ALLOWED (matches rule)
Backend Pod (app=backend, port 8080)

Database Pod (app=database)
  ↓ DENIED (no rule)
Backend Pod


Allow from Specific Namespace
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-from-monitoring
  namespace: production
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web  # Apply to web Pods
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: monitoring  # Allow from monitoring namespace
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 9090  # Metrics port

Egress Policy (Control Outbound)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-egress-to-database
  namespace: production
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: database  # Can only reach database Pods
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
  - to:  # Allow DNS (required!)
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: kube-system
    ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53

🎮 Hands-On: Network Policies
Scenario: 3-Tier Application
# 1. Create namespaces
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: app
  labels:
    name: app
 
---
# 2. Frontend Deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend
      tier: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frontend
        tier: frontend
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
 
---
# 3. Backend Deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: backend
  namespace: app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
      tier: backend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: backend
        tier: backend
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: hashicorp/http-echo
        args: ["-text=Backend API"]
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5678
 
---
# 4. Database Deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: database
  namespace: app
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: database
      tier: database
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: database
        tier: database
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: postgres
        image: postgres:14
        env:
        - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          value: password
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5432
 
---
# 5. Network Policy: Frontend can only access Backend
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: backend-policy
  namespace: app
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      tier: backend
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tier: frontend  # Only frontend Pods
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5678
 
---
# 6. Network Policy: Database can only be accessed by Backend
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: database-policy
  namespace: app
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      tier: database
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tier: backend  # Only backend Pods
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
Test Network Policies:
# Apply all
kubectl apply -f network-policies.yaml
 
# Get Pods
kubectl get pods -n app -o wide
 
# Test: Frontend → Backend (SHOULD WORK)
kubectl exec -n app -it frontend-xxx -- curl backend-service:5678
# Success!
 
# Test: Frontend → Database (SHOULD FAIL)
kubectl exec -n app -it frontend-xxx -- nc -zv database-service 5432
# Connection refused (blocked by Network Policy)
 
# Test: Backend → Database (SHOULD WORK)
kubectl exec -n app -it backend-xxx -- nc -zv database-service 5432
# Connection succeeded

🐛 Troubleshooting Networking
Issue 1: Pod Can’t Reach Another Pod
# Symptoms
$ kubectl exec pod-a -- curl http://pod-b-ip
# Connection timeout
 
# Debug steps:
 
# 1. Check Pod IPs
$ kubectl get pods -o wide
# Verify IPs assigned
 
# 2. Check CNI plugin running
$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep -E 'calico|flannel|weave'
# Should be Running
 
# 3. Ping test (if allowed)
$ kubectl exec pod-a -- ping pod-b-ip
# Tests L3 connectivity
 
# 4. Check Network Policies
$ kubectl get networkpolicy -A
# Any policies blocking traffic?
 
$ kubectl describe networkpolicy <policy-name>
# Check if pods match selectors
 
# 5. Check routes on Node
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide
# SSH to Node, check routes
ip route show
 
# 6. Check iptables (if using kube-proxy iptables)
sudo iptables-save | grep <service-name>

Issue 2: Service Not Reachable
# Service exists but can't reach
$ kubectl get service api
# Exists
 
$ kubectl exec test-pod -- curl http://api
# Connection refused
 
# Debug:
 
# 1. Check Endpoints
$ kubectl get endpoints api
# Should list Pod IPs
# If empty → No Pods match Service selector
 
# 2. Check Service ports
$ kubectl describe service api
# Verify Port and TargetPort correct
 
# 3. Test direct Pod access
$ kubectl get pods -l app=api -o wide
# Get Pod IP
 
$ kubectl exec test-pod -- curl http://<pod-ip>:<pod-port>
# If works → Service config issue
# If fails → Pod issue
 
# 4. Check kube-proxy
$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep kube-proxy
# Should be Running on all Nodes
 
$ kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-proxy-xxx
# Check for errors

Issue 3: External Traffic Can’t Reach NodePort
# NodePort Service exists
$ kubectl get service webapp
# TYPE: NodePort, PORT: 80:30080/TCP
 
# But can't access from external
$ curl http://<node-ip>:30080
# Connection refused
 
# Debug:
 
# 1. Check firewall on Nodes
# Ensure port 30080 open
 
# 2. Check Service Endpoints
$ kubectl get endpoints webapp
# Should have Pod IPs
 
# 3. Test from within Node
$ ssh node-ip
$ curl http://localhost:30080
# If works → Firewall issue
# If fails → Service/Pod issue
 
# 4. Check Node IP is correct
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide
# Use INTERNAL-IP or EXTERNAL-IP
 
# 5. For cloud providers, check Security Groups
# AWS: Security Group rules
# GCP: Firewall rules
# Azure: NSG rules

💡 Best Practices
1. Implement Network Policies
# Start with default deny
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-all
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
 
# Then whitelist specific traffic
2. Separate Namespaces
# Don't put everything in 'default'
kubectl create namespace frontend
kubectl create namespace backend
kubectl create namespace database
 
# Use namespace isolation
3. Label Everything
metadata:
  labels:
    app: webapp
    tier: frontend
    environment: production
    version: v1.0
 
# Makes Network Policy selectors easier
4. Test Network Policies
# Before applying to production:
# 1. Test in staging
# 2. Monitor for deniedpackets
# 3. Gradually roll out
# 4. Have rollback plan

🎓 Kiểm Tra Hiểu Biết
1. CNI Plugin làm gì?

Xem đáp án
CNI Plugin configures network cho Pods:

Assigns IP address
Creates network interface
Configures routes
Enables Pod-to-Pod communication
Implements network policies

Examples: Calico, Flannel, Cilium, Weave
K8s delegates networking to CNI plugins!

2. Network Policy: podSelector: {} nghĩa là gì?

Xem đáp án
Empty podSelector = ALL Pods trong namespace
spec:
  podSelector: {}  # Matches ALL Pods
 
vs
 
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend  # Matches only app=backend Pods
Use empty selector cho default deny policies.

3. Làm sao test Network Policy đang block traffic?

Xem đáp án
# Method 1: Direct test
kubectl exec source-pod -- curl http://destination-pod-ip
# If denied → Network Policy blocking
 
# Method 2: Check CNI logs (Calico example)
kubectl logs -n kube-system calico-node-xxx | grep denied
 
# Method 3: Temporarily delete policy
kubectl delete networkpolicy <policy-name>
# Test again
# If works → Policy was blocking
 
# Method 4: Describe policy
kubectl describe networkpolicy <policy-name>
# Check selectors match correctly


🎯 Key Takeaways


K8s Network Model

Pod-to-Pod communication without NAT
Flat network (all Pods can reach each other)
CNI plugins implement networking



CNI Plugins

Calico: Production, policies
Flannel: Simple, dev
Cilium: Modern, eBPF
Weave: Encryption



Network Policies = Firewall

Control ingress/egress traffic
Pod-level segmentation
Requires CNI support (not all plugins support)



Default: No Restrictions

Without Network Policies: Open
Implement default deny + whitelist
Security best practice



Troubleshooting Order

Check Pod IPs assigned
Check CNI plugin running
Check Network Policies
Check Service/Endpoints
Check kube-proxy




🚀 Hoàn Thành Phần 5!
Networking fundamentals mastered!
Next: Phần 6: Configuration →
Learn về ConfigMaps, Secrets, và configuration management!

⬅️ 5.2. Ingress | 🏠 Mục Lục | 📂 Phần 5: Networking | ➡️ Phần 6: Configuration

02---areas/k8s/05-networking/04-networki.content:
5.4. Networking Workflows - Luồng Traffic End-to-End

Chi tiết cách traffic di chuyển qua mọi tầng network trong Kubernetes


🎯 Mục Tiêu Học
Sau khi học xong phần này, bạn sẽ:

✅ Trace được packet journey từ client đến Pod
✅ Hiểu iptables/IPVS DNAT hoạt động ra sao
✅ Phân biệt traffic flow giữa 4 Service types
✅ Nắm rõ DNS resolution pipeline trong cluster
✅ Hiểu Pod-to-Pod communication qua CNI


🎨 Quy Tắc Màu Sắc Diagram


                  
                  Quy tắc màu nhất quán 
                  
                


💙 Xanh dương #3498db — Service, Ingress (network entry point)
💚 Xanh lá #27ae60 — Pod healthy, traffic delivered
🧡 Cam #f39c12 — Load Balancer, routing decision
❤️ Đỏ #e74c3c — Denied, dropped
💜 Tím #9b59b6 — DNS, advanced routing
⬜ Xám #95a5a6 — Infrastructure (Nodes, kernel)




🔄 Workflow 1: ClusterIP Full Flow

Scenario: Pod A (frontend) gọi Service B (backend) bên trong cluster

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant PodA as 🟢 Pod A<br/>frontend<br/>10.244.1.5
    participant DNS as 🌐 CoreDNS<br/>kube-system
    participant KERN as 🐧 Kernel<br/>iptables
    participant KP as ⚙️ kube-proxy<br/>(setup phase)
    participant EP as Endpoints<br/>Controller
    participant PodB as 🟢 Pod B<br/>backend<br/>10.244.2.8

    Note over KP,EP: 🔧 SETUP PHASE (trước khi traffic xảy ra)
    EP->>EP: Watch Service + Pods<br/>→ Create Endpoints object
    KP->>KP: Watch Services + Endpoints<br/>→ Create iptables rules

    Note over PodA,PodB: 📡 REQUEST PHASE

    PodA->>DNS: DNS query: "backend-svc"
    Note over DNS: Search order:<br/>1. backend-svc.default.svc.cluster.local<br/>2. backend-svc.default.svc<br/>3. backend-svc.default<br/>4. backend-svc
    DNS-->>PodA: A record: 10.96.50.100<br/>(ClusterIP)

    PodA->>KERN: TCP SYN to 10.96.50.100:80

    Note over KERN: 🔀 iptables DNAT chains:<br/>KUBE-SERVICES → KUBE-SVC-xxx<br/>→ random KUBE-SEP-yyy<br/><br/>10.96.50.100:80 →<br/>10.244.2.8:8080 (Pod B)

    KERN->>PodB: Packet dest rewritten<br/>→ 10.244.2.8:8080

    PodB-->>PodA: Response (SNAT reverse path)

    Note over PodA: ✅ Got response!<br/>Pod A sees it came from<br/>10.96.50.100 (Service IP)

iptables Chain Detail
graph TD
    PKT["📨 Packet arrives<br/>dst: 10.96.50.100:80"] --> PREROUTING["PREROUTING chain"]
    PREROUTING --> KUBE_SVC["KUBE-SERVICES chain<br/><i>Match Service ClusterIP</i>"]

    KUBE_SVC --> SVC_MATCH["KUBE-SVC-XXXX<br/>Service: backend-svc<br/>ClusterIP: 10.96.50.100"]

    SVC_MATCH --> PROB{"Random<br/>probability"}
    PROB -->|"33%"| SEP1["KUBE-SEP-AAA<br/>DNAT → 10.244.1.10:8080<br/>(Pod 1)"]
    PROB -->|"33%"| SEP2["KUBE-SEP-BBB<br/>DNAT → 10.244.2.8:8080<br/>(Pod 2)"]
    PROB -->|"34%"| SEP3["KUBE-SEP-CCC<br/>DNAT → 10.244.3.5:8080<br/>(Pod 3)"]

    SEP1 --> ROUTING["Routing Decision<br/>→ CNI forward"]
    SEP2 --> ROUTING
    SEP3 --> ROUTING

    style PKT fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:#fff
    style SVC_MATCH fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style SEP1 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style SEP2 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style SEP3 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff



                  
                  ClusterIP chỉ là Virtual IP 
                  
                


ClusterIP không tồn tại trên bất kỳ interface nào
Nó chỉ là entry trong iptables → DNAT thành Pod IP thật
Không thể ping ClusterIP (ICMP không qua iptables DNAT)
Nhưng TCP/UDP connections hoạt động bình thường!





                  
                  kube-proxy Modes 
                  
                






























ModeMechanismPerformanceFeatureiptables (default)Kernel iptables rules⭐⭐⭐Random LB onlyIPVSLinux Virtual Server⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐rr, lc, wrr, sh, dh, sednftables (K8s 1.29+)nftables (successor of iptables)⭐⭐⭐⭐Modern replacement
Production large clusters (≥500 Services): Consider IPVS mode for better performance.



🔄 Workflow 2: NodePort Traffic Path

Scenario: External client → NodePort 30080 → Pod

graph LR
    CLIENT["🌍 External Client<br/>Browser / curl"] -->|"HTTP request<br/>192.168.1.100:30080"| NODE1

    subgraph "Cluster"
        subgraph NODE1["🖥️ Node 1 (192.168.1.100)"]
            NP1["NodePort :30080<br/>kube-proxy listens"]
        end

        subgraph NODE2["🖥️ Node 2 (192.168.1.101)"]
            NP2["NodePort :30080<br/>kube-proxy listens"]
        end

        NP1 --> IPTABLES{"⚖️ iptables<br/>DNAT + LB"}
        NP2 --> IPTABLES2{"⚖️ iptables<br/>DNAT + LB"}

        IPTABLES -->|"random"| POD1["🟢 Pod 1<br/>10.244.1.5:8080<br/><i>on Node 1</i>"]
        IPTABLES -->|"random"| POD2["🟢 Pod 2<br/>10.244.2.8:8080<br/><i>on Node 2</i>"]
        IPTABLES2 -->|"random"| POD1
        IPTABLES2 -->|"random"| POD2
    end

    style CLIENT fill:#9b59b6,stroke:#8e44ad,color:#fff
    style NP1 fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style NP2 fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style POD1 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style POD2 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff



                  
                  NodePort Cross-Node Routing 
                  
                

Traffic đến Node 1 có thể route đến Pod trên Node 2!

Packet: Client → Node 1:30080 → DNAT → Pod on Node 2
Extra network hop + SNAT → source IP bị mất
Fix: externalTrafficPolicy: Local (chỉ route đến Pods trên cùng Node)

spec:
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local  # Giữ source IP, giảm latency
  # Nhưng: Nếu Node không có Pod → connection refused!



🔄 Workflow 3: LoadBalancer Complete Flow

Scenario: Internet → Cloud LB → Nodes → Pods

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as 🌍 Internet User
    participant CLB as ☁️ Cloud Load<br/>Balancer<br/>35.x.x.x
    participant N1 as 🖥️ Node 1<br/>:31234
    participant N2 as 🖥️ Node 2<br/>:31234
    participant N3 as 🖥️ Node 3<br/>:31234
    participant P as 🟢 Pod<br/>10.244.x.x:8080

    Note over CLB: SETUP PHASE:<br/>Cloud Controller Manager<br/>→ Provisions LB<br/>→ Assigns External IP<br/>→ Health checks Nodes

    U->>CLB: GET myapp.com
    Note over CLB: DNS: myapp.com → 35.x.x.x

    CLB->>CLB: Health check:<br/>Node 1 ✅ Node 2 ✅ Node 3 ❌
    CLB->>N1: Forward to healthy Node<br/>(round-robin)

    Note over N1: NodePort :31234<br/>→ iptables DNAT

    N1->>P: Route to Pod<br/>(same or different Node)
    P-->>N1: Response
    N1-->>CLB: Response
    CLB-->>U: HTTP 200 OK

    Note over U: ✅ User doesn't know<br/>about Nodes or Pods!

Double Load Balancing Architecture
graph TD
    INTERNET["🌍 Internet"] --> LB["☁️ Cloud Load Balancer<br/>35.x.x.x:443<br/><i>Layer 4 (TCP) or Layer 7 (HTTP)</i>"]

    LB -->|"LB Decision<br/>(round-robin)"| N1["🖥️ Node 1<br/>:31234"]
    LB -->|"LB Decision"| N2["🖥️ Node 2<br/>:31234"]
    LB -.->|"unhealthy"| N3["🖥️ Node 3 ❌<br/>:31234"]

    N1 -->|"iptables<br/>DNAT"| IPTABLES1{"⚖️ kube-proxy<br/>LB"}
    N2 -->|"iptables<br/>DNAT"| IPTABLES2{"⚖️ kube-proxy<br/>LB"}

    IPTABLES1 --> P1["🟢 Pod 1"] & P2["🟢 Pod 2"]
    IPTABLES2 --> P1 & P3["🟢 Pod 3"]

    style LB fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style N1 fill:#95a5a6,stroke:#7f8c8d,color:#fff
    style N2 fill:#95a5a6,stroke:#7f8c8d,color:#fff
    style N3 fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff
    style P1 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style P2 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style P3 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff



                  
                  LoadBalancer = NodePort + Cloud LB 
                  
                

LoadBalancer Service tự động tạo NodePort bên dưới:
Service type: LoadBalancer
├── ClusterIP: 10.96.x.x (internal)
├── NodePort: 31234 (on all Nodes)
└── External IP: 35.x.x.x (cloud provisioned)

→ Mỗi tầng thêm 1 layer abstraction!



🔄 Workflow 4: Ingress Routing

Scenario: 1 Ingress Controller route traffic cho nhiều Services

Host-based + Path-based Routing
graph TD
    CLIENT["🌍 Client Request"] --> ING_CTRL

    subgraph "Ingress Controller (NGINX/Traefik)"
        ING_CTRL["🔀 Ingress Controller Pod<br/>NodePort/LoadBalancer<br/><i>Reverse Proxy</i>"]

        ING_CTRL --> RULES{"Match Ingress Rules"}

        RULES -->|"Host: shop.example.com<br/>Path: /api/*"| SVC_API
        RULES -->|"Host: shop.example.com<br/>Path: /static/*"| SVC_STATIC
        RULES -->|"Host: blog.example.com<br/>Path: /*"| SVC_BLOG
        RULES -->|"No match"| DEFAULT["Default Backend<br/>404 Not Found"]
    end

    SVC_API["🔀 Service: api-svc<br/>ClusterIP:80"] --> API1["🟢 api-pod-1"]
    SVC_API --> API2["🟢 api-pod-2"]

    SVC_STATIC["🔀 Service: static-svc<br/>ClusterIP:80"] --> STATIC1["🟢 static-pod-1"]

    SVC_BLOG["🔀 Service: blog-svc<br/>ClusterIP:80"] --> BLOG1["🟢 blog-pod-1"]
    SVC_BLOG --> BLOG2["🟢 blog-pod-2"]

    style ING_CTRL fill:#9b59b6,stroke:#8e44ad,color:#fff
    style SVC_API fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:#fff
    style SVC_STATIC fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:#fff
    style SVC_BLOG fill:#3498db,stroke:#2980b9,color:#fff
    style API1 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style API2 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style STATIC1 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style BLOG1 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style BLOG2 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style DEFAULT fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff

Ingress vs LoadBalancer Service
graph LR
    subgraph "Without Ingress (1 LB per Service = $$$)"
        LB1["☁️ LB $15/mo<br/>35.1.x.x"] --> S1["Service A"]
        LB2["☁️ LB $15/mo<br/>35.2.x.x"] --> S2["Service B"]
        LB3["☁️ LB $15/mo<br/>35.3.x.x"] --> S3["Service C"]
    end

    subgraph "With Ingress (1 LB, multiple routes = $)"
        LB_ONE["☁️ LB $15/mo<br/>35.0.x.x"] --> ING["🔀 Ingress<br/>Controller"]
        ING -->|"/api"| SA["Service A"]
        ING -->|"/web"| SB["Service B"]
        ING -->|"/blog"| SC["Service C"]
    end

    style LB1 fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff
    style LB2 fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff
    style LB3 fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#c0392b,color:#fff
    style LB_ONE fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style ING fill:#9b59b6,stroke:#8e44ad,color:#fff



                  
                  Ingress hoạt động ở Layer 7 (HTTP) 
                  
                


Hiểu Host header, URL path, HTTP methods
Có thể terminate TLS/SSL
Có thể rewrite URLs, add headers
Cần Ingress Controller (NGINX, Traefik, HAProxy) chạy trong cluster

Service (NodePort/LB) hoạt động ở Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) — không hiểu HTTP



🔄 Workflow 5: Pod-to-Pod Communication

Scenario: Pod trên Node 1 nói chuyện với Pod trên Node 2

Same Node vs Cross-Node
graph TD
    subgraph NODE1["🖥️ Node 1"]
        subgraph "Pod Network (veth pairs)"
            PodA["🟢 Pod A<br/>10.244.1.5"]
            PodB["🟢 Pod B<br/>10.244.1.8"]
        end
        BRIDGE1["🌉 cbr0 / cni0<br/>Linux Bridge<br/>10.244.1.0/24"]
        PodA -.->|"veth pair"| BRIDGE1
        PodB -.->|"veth pair"| BRIDGE1
    end

    subgraph NODE2["🖥️ Node 2"]
        subgraph "Pod Network"
            PodC["🟢 Pod C<br/>10.244.2.10"]
        end
        BRIDGE2["🌉 cbr0 / cni0<br/>Linux Bridge<br/>10.244.2.0/24"]
        PodC -.->|"veth pair"| BRIDGE2
    end

    BRIDGE1 <-->|"VXLAN / Host routing<br/>via CNI Plugin<br/>(Calico, Flannel, Cilium)"| BRIDGE2

    PodA -->|"Same Node:<br/>Bridge forward<br/>(fast!)"| PodB
    PodA -->|"Cross-Node:<br/>Encapsulate + Route<br/>(extra hop)"| PodC

    style PodA fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style PodB fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style PodC fill:#27ae60,stroke:#1e8449,color:#fff
    style BRIDGE1 fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff
    style BRIDGE2 fill:#f39c12,stroke:#d68910,color:#fff



                  
                  Kubernetes Network Model — 3 Rules 
                  
                


Every Pod gets its own IP — không share, không NAT giữa Pods
All Pods can communicate with each other without NAT
Node can communicate with all Pods without NAT

→ CNI Plugin (Calico, Flannel, Cilium) implement these rules



🔄 Workflow 6: DNS Resolution Pipeline

Scenario: Pod dùng short name backend → resolve đầy đủ

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant App as 📦 App trong Pod
    participant Resolver as 📄 /etc/resolv.conf<br/>trong Pod
    participant CoreDNS as 🌐 CoreDNS<br/>kube-system

    App->>Resolver: Resolve "backend"

    Note over Resolver: ndots: 5 (default)<br/>"backend" has 0 dots (< 5)<br/>→ Try search domains first!

    Resolver->>CoreDNS: backend.default.svc.cluster.local
    Note over CoreDNS: ✅ FOUND! Service "backend"<br/>in namespace "default"
    CoreDNS-->>App: A 10.96.50.100

    Note over App: Nếu KHÔNG tìm thấy ở domain đầu tiên,<br/>tiếp tục thử các search domains khác:

    Resolver->>CoreDNS: backend.default.svc.cluster.local
    Note over CoreDNS: ❌ NOT FOUND (giả sử)
    Resolver->>CoreDNS: backend.svc.cluster.local

Common Issues & Solutions

🎓 Kiểm Tra Hiểu Biết
Câu 1: Trace the Packet
Tình huống: User truy cập shop.example.com/api/products. Cluster dùng Ingress Controller + ClusterIP Services. Trace packet journey.

Xem đáp án
1. DNS: shop.example.com → 35.x.x.x (Cloud LB IP)
2. Client → Cloud LB (35.x.x.x:443)
3. Cloud LB → Node (random):NodePort
4. NodePort → kube-proxy → Ingress Controller Pod
5. Ingress Controller:
   - Match rule: Host=shop.example.com, Path=/api/*
   - TLS termination (decrypt HTTPS)
   - Forward to Service: api-svc:80
6. api-svc (ClusterIP) → iptables DNAT
7. iptables → random Pod IP (10.244.x.x:8080)
8. Pod processes request → Response reverse path

Tổng cộng: 7 hops! (Client → LB → Node → Ingress → Service → iptables → Pod)

Câu 2: DNS Troubleshooting
Tình huống: Pod trong namespace staging không thể resolve backend (Service ở namespace production). Tại sao?

Xem đáp án
Short name backend sẽ search theo thứ tự:

backend.staging.svc.cluster.local → ❌ (Service không có trong staging)
backend.svc.cluster.local → ❌
backend.cluster.local → ❌
backend. → ❌

Fix: Phải dùng full name bao gồm namespace:
curl backend.production
# hoặc FQDN
curl backend.production.svc.cluster.local

Cross-namespace: PHẢI specify namespace trong DNS name!


Câu 3: externalTrafficPolicy
Tình huống: NodePort Service có externalTrafficPolicy: Local. Node 1 có 2 Pods, Node 2 có 0 Pods. Client gửi request đến Node 2. Chuyện gì xảy ra?

Xem đáp án
Connection refused / timeout!
Với externalTrafficPolicy: Local:

Node 2 KHÔNG forward traffic đến Pods trên Node 1
Vì không có Pod nào trên Node 2 → request dropped
Health check của LB sẽ mark Node 2 là unhealthy

Giải pháp:

Dùng externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster (default) — nhưng mất source IP
Đảm bảo mỗi Node có ít nhất 1 Pod (dùng DaemonSet hoặc pod topology spread)
Dùng Cloud LB health check → tự skip Node không có Pods



🚀 Tiếp Theo
Bạn đã hiểu traffic flow qua mọi tầng network!

02---areas/k8s/05-networking/readme.content:
📘 Phần 5: Networking - Kết Nối Ứng Dụng

Service discovery, load balancing, và network policies


🎯 Mục Tiêu Phần Này
Sau khi hoàn thành Phần 5, bạn sẽ:
✅ Expose applications với Services
✅ HTTP routing với Ingress
✅ Understand Pod networking fundamentals
✅ Implement network security với Network Policies
✅ Troubleshoot network connectivity
✅ Production-ready networking setup

📚 Nội Dung
5.1. Services - Service Discovery ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Thời gian: 75-90 phút (QUAN TRỌNG!)
Nội dung:

Service là gì và TẠI SAO cần
4 Service types: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName
Service discovery và DNS
Load balancing automatic
Endpoints tracking
Troubleshooting Services

Key Concepts:
✓ Service = Stable endpoint cho Pods
✓ ClusterIP: Internal only (default)
✓ NodePort: External via Node IP:Port
✓ LoadBalancer: External via Cloud LB
✓ DNS automatic: service.namespace.svc.cluster.local
✓ Endpoints = Pod IPs

Use Cases:

ClusterIP: Internal microservices
NodePort: Development, simple external access
LoadBalancer: Production external services
ExternalName: External service alias

Commands:
# Create Service
kubectl expose deployment app --port=80 --type=ClusterIP
 
# Get Services
kubectl get service
kubectl get endpoints
 
# Test connectivity
kubectl run curl --image=curlimages/curl -it --rm -- curl http://service-name

5.2. Ingress - HTTP Routing ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Thời gian: 75-90 phút (QUAN TRỌNG!)
Nội dung:

Ingress là gì và TẠI SAO cần
Ingress Controller setup (NGINX, Traefik)
Path-based routing
Host-based routing (virtual hosting)
TLS/SSL termination
Annotations và advanced features

Key Concepts:
✓ Ingress = Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) load balancer
✓ One LoadBalancer cho many Services
✓ Path routing: /api → api-service
✓ Host routing: api.example.com → api-service
✓ TLS termination centralized
✓ Cost-effective vs multiple LoadBalancers

Traffic Flow:
Internet → Ingress Controller (LB)
  → Ingress rules (path/host matching)
    → Backend Services (ClusterIP)
      → Pods

Commands:
# Install Ingress Controller
helm install nginx-ingress ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx
 
# Create Ingress
kubectl apply -f ingress.yaml
 
# Get Ingress
kubectl get ingress
kubectl describe ingress <name>

5.3. Pod Networking - Fundamentals ⭐⭐⭐⭐
Thời gian: 60-75 phút

5.4. Networking Workflows - Luồng Traffic End-to-End 🆕
Thời gian: 45-60 phút
Nội dung:

ClusterIP full flow (DNS → iptables → Pod)
NodePort traffic path (External → Node → Pod)
LoadBalancer complete flow (Internet → Cloud LB → Node → Pod)
Ingress routing (Host/Path-based, L7 routing)
Pod-to-Pod communication (Same Node vs Cross-Node via CNI)
DNS Resolution Pipeline (search domains, ndots)

Key Concepts:
✓ Trace packet journey qua mọi tầng
✓ iptables chain detail (KUBE-SERVICES → KUBE-SEP)
✓ Service types comparison matrix
✓ Câu hỏi debug thực tế

Nội dung:

K8s network model
CNI (Container Network Interface)
Pod-to-Pod communication (same Node, cross-Node)
Network Policies (firewall rules)
Security segmentation
CNI plugins comparison (Calico, Flannel, Cilium)

Key Concepts:
✓ K8s network model: No NAT, flat network
✓ CNI plugin handles networking
✓ Pod IPs routable cluster-wide
✓ Network Policies = Pod-level firewall
✓ Default: No restrictions (open network)
✓ Security: Implement default deny + whitelist

Network Requirements:

Pods can communicate với all Pods (no NAT)
Nodes can communicate với all Pods
Pod’s IP = IP others see it as

Commands:
# Check CNI plugin
kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep -E 'calico|flannel'
 
# Get Pod IPs
kubectl get pods -o wide
 
# Network Policies
kubectl get networkpolicy
kubectl describe networkpolicy <name>
 
# Test connectivity
kubectl exec pod-a -- curl http://pod-b-ip

    Q3 -->|"YES"| ING["✅ Ingress\n(cost-effective)"]

💪 Consolidated Exercises
Exercise 1: Complete 3-Tier Application
# 1. Database (StatefulSet + ClusterIP + Headless Service)
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: postgres
spec:
  clusterIP: None  # Headless
  selector:
    app: postgres
  ports:
  - port: 5432
 
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: postgres
spec:
  serviceName: postgres
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: postgres
        tier: database
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: postgres
        image: postgres:14
        env:
        - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          value: password
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5432
 
---
# 2. Backend API (Deployment + ClusterIP Service)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: backend
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: backend
        tier: backend
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: api-server:v1
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
 
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: backend-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: backend
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
 
---
# 3. Frontend (Deployment + ClusterIP Service)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frontend
        tier: frontend
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
 
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: frontend-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: frontend
  ports:
  - port: 80
 
---
# 4. Ingress (External access)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: main-ingress
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
  - host: myapp.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /api
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: backend-service
            port:
              number: 80
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: frontend-service
            port:
              number: 80
 
---
# 5. Network Policies (Security)
# Backend can only be accessed by Frontend
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: backend-policy
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      tier: backend
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tier: frontend
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
 
---
# Database can only be accessed by Backend
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: database-policy
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      tier: database
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tier: backend
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
# Deploy all
kubectl apply -f complete-app.yaml
 
# Verify Services
kubectl get services
 
# Verify Ingress
kubectl get ingress
 
# Test external access
curl myapp.example.com/api
curl myapp.example.com/
 
# Test Network Policies
# Frontend → Backend (should work)
kubectl exec -it frontend-xxx -- curl backend-service
 
# Frontend → Database (should fail)
kubectl exec -it frontend-xxx -- nc -zv postgres 5432

Exercise 2: Multi-Domain Ingress
# Host-based routing cho multiple apps
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: multi-domain-ingress
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - app1.example.com
    - app2.example.com
    secretName: multi-domain-tls
  rules:
  - host: app1.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: app1-service
            port:
              number: 80
  - host: app2.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: app2-service
            port:
              number: 80
  - host: api.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: api-service
            port:
              number: 80

🎯 Key Takeaways - Phần 5
10 Điều Quan Trọng Nhất
1. Service = Stable Endpoint
Pod IPs change → Service IP stable
DNS name stable
Load balancing automatic

2. 4 Service Types
ClusterIP: Internal (default)
NodePort: External via Node
LoadBalancer: External via Cloud LB
ExternalName: DNS alias

3. Ingress = HTTP Router
One LoadBalancer for many Services
Path routing: /api, /web
Host routing: api.example.com
TLS termination centralized
Cost-effective

4. Ingress Requires Controller
NGINX, Traefik, HAProxy
Deploy controller first
One controller handles multiple Ingresses

5. DNS Automatic
service-name (same namespace)
service-name.namespace (cross-namespace)
service-name.namespace.svc.cluster.local (FQDN)

6. K8s Network Model
Pod-to-Pod without NAT
Flat network (all Pods can communicate)
CNI plugin implements networking

7. CNI Plugins
Calico: Production, Network Policies
Flannel: Simple, development
Cilium: Modern, eBPF
Choose based on requirements

8. Network Policies = Firewall
Control Pod traffic (ingress/egress)
Default: No restrictions (open)
Security: Default deny + whitelist

9. Troubleshooting Order
1. Check Service/Endpoints
2. Check Pod IPs và status
3. Check Network Policies
4. Check CNI plugin
5. Check kube-proxy

10. Production Setup
✓ Use Ingress for HTTP services
✓ Implement Network Policies
✓ Monitor networking metrics
✓ Plan IP address space (CIDR)
✓ TLS termination at Ingress


📚 Commands Cheat Sheet
Services
# Create
kubectl expose deployment app --port=80 --type=ClusterIP
kubectl create service clusterip app --tcp=80:8080
 
# Get
kubectl get services
kubectl get endpoints
kubectl describe service <name>
 
# Test
kubectl run curl --image=curlimages/curl -it --rm -- curl http://service-name
 
# Delete
kubectl delete service <name>
Ingress
# Install Controller
helm install nginx-ingress ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx
 
# Get
kubectl get ingress
kubectl describe ingress <name>
 
# Get Ingress IP
kubectl get ingress <name> -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].ip}'
 
# Test
curl http://<ingress-ip>/<path>
Networking
# Get Pod IPs
kubectl get pods -o wide
 
# Network Policies
kubectl get networkpolicy
kubectl describe networkpolicy <name>
 
# Test connectivity
kubectl exec pod-a -- curl http://pod-b-ip
kubectl exec pod-a -- nc -zv service-name port
 
# Check CNI
kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep -E 'calico|flannel|cilium'

❓ FAQs
Q: Service ClusterIP vs Headless Service?
ClusterIP (normal):
- Has ClusterIP assigned
- Load balances to Pods
- DNS resolves to ClusterIP

Headless (clusterIP: None):
- No ClusterIP assigned
- DNS resolves to individual Pod IPs
- Use for: StatefulSets, direct Pod access

Q: Ingress vs LoadBalancer Service - khi nào dùng gì?
Use Ingress when:
✓ HTTP/HTTPS services
✓ Multiple services (cost-effective)
✓ Need path/host routing
✓ TLS termination centralized

Use LoadBalancer when:
✓ Non-HTTP (TCP/UDP)
✓ Single service external access
✓ Simple setup

Q: Network Policy không work - tại sao?
Reasons:
1. CNI plugin doesn't support Network Policies
   - Flannel: No support
   - Calico, Cilium, Weave: Support

2. Policy selectors don't match Pods
   - Check labels match

3. Forgot to allow DNS
   - Must allow port 53 UDP to kube-system

Check: kubectl get networkpolicy -A

Q: Pod-to-Pod same Node vs cross-Node - khác nhau không?
Same Node:
- Direct L2 communication (fast)
- Via Linux bridge

Cross-Node:
- Via Node network
- May use overlay (VXLAN)
- Slightly higher latency

Both use same Pod IPs (no NAT)
Transparent to applications

02---areas/k8s/06-configuration/01-confi.content:
6.1. ConfigMaps - External Configuration

Tách biệt configuration khỏi application code — nguyên tắc 12-Factor App


🎯 Mục Tiêu Học
Sau khi học xong phần này, bạn sẽ:

✅ Hiểu ConfigMap là gì và TẠI SAO cần tách config khỏi code
✅ Tạo ConfigMaps từ literals, files, directories, YAML
✅ Consume ConfigMaps as env vars, volumes, command args
✅ Hiểu hot-reload mechanism và immutable ConfigMaps
✅ Biết cách dùng SubPath mount và specific key projection
✅ Best practices và troubleshoot ConfigMap issues


📦 ConfigMap Là Gì?
Định Nghĩa
ConfigMap = Kubernetes object lưu trữ non-sensitive configuration data dưới dạng key-value pairs, cho phép tách biệt configuration khỏi container images.
Giải Thích Bằng Ví Dụ Thực Tế
ConfigMap giống như bảng cấu hình trung tâm của công ty:
🏢 CÔNG TY CÓ 3 CHI NHÁNH

Bảng cấu hình trung tâm (ConfigMap):
├── Giờ làm việc: 8:00 - 17:00
├── Số lượng nhân viên tối đa: 100
├── Chính sách nghỉ phép: 12 ngày/năm
└── Log level: info

Chi nhánh HN (Pod 1): Đọc cùng bảng cấu hình
Chi nhánh HCM (Pod 2): Đọc cùng bảng cấu hình
Chi nhánh ĐN (Pod 3): Đọc cùng bảng cấu hình

→ Thay đổi cấu hình 1 lần = Apply cho tất cả chi nhánh!
→ Không cần "xây lại" chi nhánh (rebuild image)!


🤔 TẠI SAO Cần ConfigMap?
Problem: Config Hardcoded Trong Image
# ❌ Bad: Config baked into image
FROM node:18
ENV DATABASE_HOST=postgres.prod.internal
ENV DATABASE_PORT=5432
ENV MAX_CONNECTIONS=100
ENV LOG_LEVEL=info
ENV FEATURE_FLAG_NEW_UI=true
 
# Problems:
# 1. Cần rebuild image mỗi khi thay đổi config
# 2. dev/staging/prod dùng chung image nhưng khác config → impossible
# 3. Config thay đổi frequently → CI/CD pipeline chạy liên tục
# 4. Không thể thay đổi config at runtime
Solution: ConfigMap
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 SAME IMAGE: myapp:v1               │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                    │
│  Development:                                      │
│  ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────────────┐    │
│  │ Pod (myapp)  │ ←  │ dev-config           │    │
│  │              │    │ DB_HOST=localhost     │    │
│  │              │    │ LOG_LEVEL=debug       │    │
│  └──────────────┘    └──────────────────────┘    │
│                                                    │
│  Production:                                       │
│  ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────────────┐    │
│  │ Pod (myapp)  │ ←  │ prod-config          │    │
│  │              │    │ DB_HOST=postgres.prod │    │
│  │              │    │ LOG_LEVEL=warn        │    │
│  └──────────────┘    └──────────────────────┘    │
│                                                    │
│  ✓ Same image, different configs!                  │
│  ✓ Change config without rebuild!                  │
│  ✓ Environment-specific settings!                  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


📝 Create ConfigMaps
Method 1: From Literals
# Tạo ConfigMap từ command line
kubectl create configmap app-config \
  --from-literal=DATABASE_HOST=postgres.default.svc.cluster.local \
  --from-literal=DATABASE_PORT=5432 \
  --from-literal=MAX_CONNECTIONS=100 \
  --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info
 
# Verify
kubectl get configmap app-config -o yaml
 
# Output:
# apiVersion: v1
# kind: ConfigMap
# metadata:
#   name: app-config
# data:
#   DATABASE_HOST: postgres.default.svc.cluster.local
#   DATABASE_PORT: "5432"
#   MAX_CONNECTIONS: "100"
#   LOG_LEVEL: info
⚠️ Lưu ý: Tất cả values trong ConfigMap đều là string. Số 5432 sẽ stored as "5432".
Method 2: From File
# Tạo file config
cat > app.properties << 'EOF'
database.host=postgres.default.svc.cluster.local
database.port=5432
max.connections=100
log.level=info
cache.ttl=3600
EOF
 
# Tạo ConfigMap từ file
kubectl create configmap app-config --from-file=app.properties
 
# Key = filename, Value = file content
# data:
#   app.properties: |
#     database.host=postgres.default.svc.cluster.local
#     database.port=5432
#     ...
 
# Specify custom key name
kubectl create configmap app-config --from-file=config=app.properties
# Key = "config" thay vì "app.properties"
Method 3: From Directory
# Thư mục chứa nhiều config files
# configs/
# ├── database.conf
# ├── cache.conf
# └── logging.conf
 
kubectl create configmap app-config --from-file=configs/
 
# Mỗi file trở thành 1 key:
# data:
#   database.conf: |
#     host=postgres
#     port=5432
#   cache.conf: |
#     host=redis
#     port=6379
#   logging.conf: |
#     level=info
#     format=json
Method 4: YAML Manifest (Recommended)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app: webapp
    env: production
data:
  # Simple key-value pairs
  DATABASE_HOST: "postgres.default.svc.cluster.local"
  DATABASE_PORT: "5432"
  MAX_CONNECTIONS: "100"
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  FEATURE_NEW_UI: "true"
 
  # Multi-line value (config file nội dung)
  nginx.conf: |
    server {
      listen 80;
      server_name example.com;
 
      location / {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8080;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
      }
 
      location /static {
        root /var/www/static;
        expires 30d;
      }
    }
 
  # Application config file
  app.yaml: |
    database:
      host: postgres
      port: 5432
      name: myapp_db
    cache:
      host: redis
      port: 6379
      ttl: 3600
    logging:
      level: info
      format: json
# Apply
kubectl apply -f configmap.yaml
 
# Verify
kubectl describe configmap app-config

🎮 Consume ConfigMaps
Pattern 1: Environment Variables (Single Key)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: myapp:v1
    env:
    # Lấy từng key riêng lẻ
    - name: DB_HOST            # Env var name trong container
      valueFrom:
        configMapKeyRef:
          name: app-config     # ConfigMap name
          key: DATABASE_HOST   # Key trong ConfigMap
    - name: DB_PORT
      valueFrom:
        configMapKeyRef:
          name: app-config
          key: DATABASE_PORT
    - name: LOG_LEVEL
      valueFrom:
        configMapKeyRef:
          name: app-config
          key: LOG_LEVEL
          optional: true       # Pod vẫn start nếu key không tồn tại
Pattern 2: Environment Variables (All Keys)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: myapp:v1
    envFrom:
    # Import TẤT CẢ keys từ ConfigMap thành env vars
    - configMapRef:
        name: app-config
    # Thêm prefix cho env vars (tránh conflict)
    - configMapRef:
        name: app-config
        prefix: APP_          # DATABASE_HOST → APP_DATABASE_HOST
envFrom vs env:
envFrom (tất cả keys):
├── Tiện lợi, ít code
├── Khó control
└── Dùng khi ConfigMap chỉ chứa env vars

env (từng key):
├── Precise control
├── Rename keys (DB_HOST ≠ DATABASE_HOST)
├── Optional keys
└── Dùng khi cần chọn lọc

Pattern 3: Volume Mount (Tất cả keys thành files)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: myapp:v1
    volumeMounts:
    - name: config-volume
      mountPath: /etc/config    # Thư mục mount
      readOnly: true
  volumes:
  - name: config-volume
    configMap:
      name: app-config
Kết quả trong container:
$ ls /etc/config/
DATABASE_HOST    DATABASE_PORT    LOG_LEVEL    MAX_CONNECTIONS    nginx.conf
 
$ cat /etc/config/DATABASE_HOST
postgres.default.svc.cluster.local
 
$ cat /etc/config/nginx.conf
server {
  listen 80;
  server_name example.com;
  ...
}
Pattern 4: Volume Mount (Specific keys)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:latest
    volumeMounts:
    - name: nginx-config
      mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d
      readOnly: true
  volumes:
  - name: nginx-config
    configMap:
      name: app-config
      items:
      # Chỉ mount key cụ thể
      - key: nginx.conf          # Key trong ConfigMap
        path: default.conf       # Tên file trong mount path
Kết quả:
# Chỉ có 1 file, không phải tất cả keys
$ ls /etc/nginx/conf.d/
default.conf                    # Content = value của key "nginx.conf"
Pattern 5: SubPath Mount (Không overwrite directory)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: myapp:v1
    volumeMounts:
    # KHÔNG dùng SubPath: Mount vào /etc/config → overwrite TOÀN BỘ /etc/config
    # - name: config
    #   mountPath: /etc/config
 
    # Dùng SubPath: Chỉ thêm 1 file, KHÔNG overwrite directory
    - name: config
      mountPath: /etc/config/app.yaml    # File cụ thể
      subPath: app.yaml                  # Key trong ConfigMap
  volumes:
  - name: config
    configMap:
      name: app-config
⚠️ Quan trọng: SubPath mount KHÔNG support hot-reload! File sẽ KHÔNG tự cập nhật khi ConfigMap thay đổi.
Pattern 6: Command Arguments
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: myapp:v1
    command: ["./app"]
    args:
    - "--db-host=$(DB_HOST)"
    - "--log-level=$(LOG_LEVEL)"
    env:
    - name: DB_HOST
      valueFrom:
        configMapKeyRef:
          name: app-config
          key: DATABASE_HOST
    - name: LOG_LEVEL
      valueFrom:
        configMapKeyRef:
          name: app-config
          key: LOG_LEVEL

🔄 Hot-Reload: Tự Động Cập Nhật
Volume Mount = Hot-Reload ✅
# Update ConfigMap
kubectl edit configmap app-config
# Hoặc
kubectl apply -f updated-configmap.yaml
 
# Files trong volume mount TỰ ĐỘNG cập nhật!
# Delay: ~30-60 giây (kubelet sync period)
ConfigMap thay đổi
    ↓ (~30-60s)
kubelet phát hiện
    ↓
Files trong mounted volume được update
    ↓
Application cần WATCH file changes để reload
(K8s KHÔNG tự restart Pod!)

Environment Variables = KHÔNG Hot-Reload ❌
ConfigMap thay đổi
    ↓
Env vars trong container KHÔNG đổi!
    ↓
Cần restart Pod để nhận config mới:
kubectl rollout restart deployment/webapp

So Sánh Methods



































MethodHot-ReloadSubPath SupportUse CaseEnv vars❌ NoN/ASimple configsVolume mount✅ Yes (~60s)❌ No hot-reloadConfig filesVolume + SubPath❌ No✅ No overwriteSingle file injectCommand args❌ NoN/ACLI flags

🔒 Immutable ConfigMaps
Tại Sao Cần?
# K8s 1.21+ (stable)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config-v1
immutable: true               # ← Không cho phép sửa đổi!
data:
  DATABASE_HOST: "postgres.prod"
  LOG_LEVEL: "warn"
Lợi ích:
✓ Bảo vệ khỏi thay đổi ngẫu nhiên (accidental changes)
✓ Performance tốt hơn (kubelet không cần watch)
✓ Giảm load trên API Server
✓ Cluster có >10,000 ConfigMaps → performance impact nếu không immutable

Strategy:
├── Tạo ConfigMap với version trong tên: app-config-v1
├── Cần update? Tạo mới: app-config-v2
├── Update Deployment reference → triggers rolling update
└── Delete old ConfigMap khi không còn dùng

Update workflow:
# 1. Tạo ConfigMap mới
kubectl create configmap app-config-v2 \
  --from-literal=DATABASE_HOST=new-postgres.prod \
  --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info
 
# Đánh dấu immutable
kubectl patch configmap app-config-v2 -p '{"immutable": true}'
 
# 2. Update Deployment
kubectl set env deployment/webapp --from=configmap/app-config-v2
 
# 3. Xóa ConfigMap cũ
kubectl delete configmap app-config-v1

💡 Best Practices
1. Naming Convention
# ✅ Good: Descriptive, versioned
metadata:
  name: webapp-config               # App-specific
  name: shared-nginx-config         # Shared config
  name: webapp-config-v2            # Versioned
 
# ❌ Bad: Generic
  name: config                      # What config?
  name: cm1                         # Meaningless
2. Labeling
metadata:
  labels:
    app: webapp
    component: backend
    env: production
    managed-by: helm
3. Separate ConfigMaps per Concern
# ✅ Good: Separated
configmap/app-settings        # App config
configmap/nginx-config         # Nginx config
configmap/feature-flags        # Feature flags
 
# ❌ Bad: Everything in one
configmap/all-config           # Mọi thứ lẫn lộn
4. Sensitive Data → Use Secrets!
# ❌ NEVER put in ConfigMap
data:
  DB_PASSWORD: "P@ssw0rd"     # → Dùng Secret!
  API_KEY: "sk-123456"        # → Dùng Secret!
 
# ✅ ConfigMap chỉ cho non-sensitive data
data:
  DB_HOST: "postgres"         # OK
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"           # OK
5. Size Limit
ConfigMap size limit: 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes)

Nếu config lớn hơn:
├── Tách thành nhiều ConfigMaps
├── Dùng init container download từ external source
└── Dùng Persistent Volume mount


🐛 Troubleshooting
Issue 1: Pod Không Start — ConfigMap Not Found
$ kubectl get pods
NAME     READY   STATUS                       RESTARTS   AGE
webapp   0/1     CreateContainerConfigError   0          5m
 
$ kubectl describe pod webapp
# Events:
# Error: configmap "app-config" not found
 
# Fix: Tạo ConfigMap TRƯỚC khi tạo Pod
kubectl create configmap app-config --from-literal=KEY=value
Issue 2: Config Không Update Sau Khi Sửa ConfigMap
# Nguyên nhân 1: Dùng env vars (không hot-reload)
# Fix: Restart Pod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/webapp
 
# Nguyên nhân 2: Dùng SubPath mount (không hot-reload)
# Fix: Restart Pod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/webapp
 
# Nguyên nhân 3: Dùng volume mount nhưng chưa đủ thời gian
# Fix: Đợi ~60 giây, kubelet cần sync
Issue 3: Immutable ConfigMap Cannot Be Updated
$ kubectl edit configmap app-config-v1
# Error: configmaps "app-config-v1" is immutable
 
# Fix: Tạo ConfigMap mới với tên mới
kubectl create configmap app-config-v2 --from-literal=KEY=new-value
# Update references trong Deployment
Issue 4: Volume Mount Overwrite Existing Files
# Vấn đề: mountPath=/etc/config → toàn bộ /etc/config bị overwrite
# Fix: Dùng SubPath cho single file
volumeMounts:
- name: config
  mountPath: /etc/config/app.yaml
  subPath: app.yaml

🎓 Kiểm Tra Hiểu Biết
Câu Hỏi Tự Kiểm Tra
1. ConfigMap và Secret khác nhau thế nào?

Xem đáp án

ConfigMap: Non-sensitive data, plain text, không mã hóa
Secret: Sensitive data (passwords, tokens), base64-encoded, có thể encrypted at rest
Rule: Không bao giờ đặt passwords/tokens vào ConfigMap!


2. Hot-reload hoạt động với pattern nào?

Xem đáp án

✅ Volume mount (không SubPath) → Hot-reload sau ~60 giây
❌ Environment variables → Cần restart Pod
❌ SubPath mount → Cần restart Pod
❌ Command arguments → Cần restart Pod


3. Khi nào nên dùng immutable ConfigMap?

Xem đáp án

Cluster có nhiều ConfigMaps (>1000) → Performance improvement
Config KHÔNG thay đổi frequently
Muốn bảo vệ khỏi accidental changes
Strategy: Version trong tên (app-config-v1, v2, v3)


4. SubPath mount giải quyết vấn đề gì?

Xem đáp án
Volume mount bình thường sẽ overwrite toàn bộ directory. SubPath cho phép mount 1 file cụ thể mà không ảnh hưởng các files khác trong directory. Nhưng trade-off: mất hot-reload capability.


🎯 Key Takeaways
Ghi Nhớ 5 Điều Quan Trọng


ConfigMap = External, Non-Sensitive Config

Tách config khỏi code
Same image, different configs per environment
12-Factor App principle



4 Cách Tạo: Literals, Files, Directories, YAML

Production: Luôn dùng YAML manifest (declarative, version control)



3 Cách Consume: Env Vars, Volumes, Args

Env vars: Đơn giản nhưng không hot-reload
Volumes: Hot-reload nhưng phải watch file changes
SubPath: Không overwrite nhưng không hot-reload



Hot-Reload chỉ với Volume Mount (không SubPath)

Delay ~60 giây
App cần tự detect file changes



Immutable ConfigMaps cho production

Performance improvement
Prevent accidental changes
Versioned naming strategy




📚 Thuật Ngữ Cần Nhớ

































Thuật NgữÝ NghĩaConfigMapK8s object lưu non-sensitive config dataenvFromImport tất cả keys từ ConfigMap thành env varsvalueFromLấy 1 key cụ thể từ ConfigMapSubPathMount 1 file cụ thể, không overwrite directoryImmutableConfigMap không cho phép sửa đổi sau khi tạoHot-reloadTự động cập nhật config mà không cần restart

🚀 Tiếp Theo

Ở phần tiếp theo, chúng ta sẽ học cách quản lý passwords, tokens, và sensitive data an toàn trong Kubernetes.
