02---areas/k8s/labs/03-core-objects/06-n.title: Lab 06: Namespaces & Context
02---areas/k8s/labs/03-core-objects/06-n.content:
Lab 06: Namespaces & Context

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch03 Core Concepts | ⬅️ Lab 05


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Tạo Namespaces cho nhiều environments
Switch context giữa namespaces
Cross-namespace access


Bước 1: Namespaces Mặc Định
kubectl get namespaces
# default          — mặc định khi không chỉ định
# kube-system      — system components
# kube-public      — public resources
# kube-node-lease  — node heartbeat
 
# Pods trong kube-system
kubectl get pods -n kube-system
✅ Checkpoint

 4 default namespaces, biết mục đích mỗi namespace


Bước 2: Tạo Project Namespaces
# Tạo environments
kubectl create namespace dev
kubectl create namespace staging
kubectl create namespace production
 
# Di chuyển podinfo deployment sang namespace dev
kubectl delete deployment podinfo --ignore-not-found
 
kubectl create deployment podinfo \
  --image=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1 \
  --replicas=2 \
  --port=9898 \
  -n dev
 
# Deploy thêm ứng dụng vào production
kubectl run nginx --image=nginx:1.27-alpine -n production
 
# List — mỗi namespace tách biệt
kubectl get pods              # default → empty
kubectl get pods -n dev       # podinfo pods
kubectl get pods -n production # nginx pod
 
# List TẤT CẢ
kubectl get pods -A
✅ Checkpoint

 Tạo 3 namespaces: dev, staging, production
 podinfo chạy trong dev


Bước 3: Switch Default Namespace
# Mệt mỏi gõ -n dev mỗi lần? Set default!
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=dev
 
# Giờ không cần -n
kubectl get pods           # → Pods trong dev
kubectl get deployments    # → Deployments trong dev
 
# Verify
kubectl config view --minify | grep namespace
 
# Reset về default
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=default

💡 Namespace KHÔNG isolation:
Pods trong dev mặc định VẪN nói chuyện được với production.
Namespace = logical isolation. Network isolation cần NetworkPolicy (Lab 27).

✅ Checkpoint

 Switch default namespace, không cần -n flag


Bước 4: Cross-Namespace Access
# Expose podinfo trong dev
kubectl expose deployment podinfo -n dev --port=80 --target-port=9898
 
# Từ default namespace — access dev namespace
kubectl run test --image=busybox:1.36 --rm -it -- sh
 
# DNS cross-namespace:
# <service>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local
wget -qO- podinfo.dev.svc.cluster.local
# → JSON response từ podinfo trong dev namespace!
exit
✅ Checkpoint

 Cross-namespace access qua FQDN <svc>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete namespace staging production
# GIỮ namespace dev + deployment podinfo cho labs tiếp
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=dev

🎤 Interview Questions

Namespace isolation gì? → Logical: resource scoping, RBAC boundary. KHÔNG network isolation (cần NetworkPolicy).
DNS cross-namespace? → <service>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local. Cùng namespace chỉ cần <service>.
ResourceQuota vs LimitRange? → Quota = tổng namespace. LimitRange = per-Pod/Container defaults. (Chi tiết Lab 08)


Tiếp: Lab 07: Labels, Selectors & Annotations →
⬅️ Lab 05 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/03-core-objects/07-l.title: Lab 07: Labels, Selectors & Annotations
02---areas/k8s/labs/03-core-objects/07-l.content:
Lab 07: Labels, Selectors & Annotations

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch03 Core Concepts | ⬅️ Lab 06


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Gán labels taxonomy cho resources
Query bằng equality-based và set-based selectors
Annotations cho metadata (Prometheus, CI/CD)
Thêm/xóa labels on-the-fly


Bước 1: Labels Taxonomy
# Thêm labels chuẩn cho podinfo deployment
kubectl label deployment podinfo \
  tier=frontend \
  version=v6.7.1 \
  team=platform
 
# Verify
kubectl get deployment podinfo --show-labels
 
# Tạo thêm backend deployment
kubectl create deployment backend \
  --image=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1 --replicas=2
 
kubectl label deployment backend \
  tier=backend \
  version=v6.7.1 \
  team=platform
 
# Tạo redis cache
kubectl run redis --image=redis:7-alpine --labels="app=redis,tier=cache,team=platform"
✅ Checkpoint

 3 resources có labels tier, version, team


Bước 2: Selectors
kubectl get pods --show-labels
 
# Equality-based
kubectl get pods -l tier=frontend
kubectl get pods -l tier=backend
kubectl get pods -l team=platform
 
# Set-based (mạnh hơn)
kubectl get pods -l 'tier in (frontend,backend)'
kubectl get pods -l 'tier!=cache'
kubectl get pods -l 'tier notin (cache)'
kubectl get pods -l 'app=podinfo,tier=frontend'  # AND

💡 Labels là nền tảng K8s:

Service → selector để tìm Pods (Lab 14)
Deployment → selector để quản lý Pods (Lab 09)
NetworkPolicy → labels để define rules (Lab 27)
HPA → target Deployment qua labels (Lab 24)


✅ Checkpoint

 Filter bằng equality-based và set-based selectors


Bước 3: Thêm/Xóa Labels On-the-fly
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
 
# Thêm label
kubectl label pod $POD environment=development
 
# Verify
kubectl get pod $POD --show-labels
 
# Overwrite
kubectl label pod $POD environment=dev --overwrite
 
# Xóa label (dấu - ở cuối)
kubectl label pod $POD environment-
✅ Checkpoint

 Thêm/overwrite/xóa labels on-the-fly


Bước 4: Annotations
# Annotations = metadata cho external tools, KHÔNG dùng để query
kubectl annotate deployment podinfo \
  prometheus.io/scrape="true" \
  prometheus.io/port="9898" \
  prometheus.io/path="/metrics" \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by="kubectl" \
  description="Main frontend service"
 
# Xem
kubectl describe deployment podinfo | grep -A 10 "Annotations"
 
# Thêm on-the-fly
kubectl annotate deployment podinfo deployed-by="anhminh"
 
# Xóa
kubectl annotate deployment podinfo deployed-by-

💡 Labels vs Annotations:






























LabelsAnnotationsSelect/Query✅ -l key=value❌Size63 chars maxLớn hơn nhiềuDùng bởiK8s selectorsExternal tools (Prometheus, Ingress)Ví dụapp: podinfoprometheus.io/scrape: "true"

✅ Checkpoint

 Annotations cho Prometheus scraping
 Hiểu Labels (select) vs Annotations (metadata)


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete deployment backend
kubectl delete pod redis
# Giữ deployment podinfo

🎤 Interview Questions

Labels vs Annotations? → Labels: identify/select, queryable, K8s dùng. Annotations: metadata cho tools, không query được.
Set-based selector in hoạt động? → tier in (frontend,backend) = match tier=frontend HOẶC tier=backend.
Recommended labels? → app.kubernetes.io/name, app.kubernetes.io/version, app.kubernetes.io/component, app.kubernetes.io/managed-by.


Tiếp: Lab 08: Multi-Container & Init Container →
⬅️ Lab 06 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/03-core-objects/08-m.title: Lab 08: Multi-Container & Init Container
02---areas/k8s/labs/03-core-objects/08-m.content:
Lab 08: Multi-Container & Init Container

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch03 Core Concepts | ⬅️ Lab 07


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Tạo Multi-container Pod (sidecar pattern)
Tạo Init Container (wait-for-dependency)
ResourceQuota + LimitRange cho namespace


Bước 1: Sidecar Pattern
cat > sidecar-pod.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app-with-sidecar
  labels:
    app: podinfo
    pattern: sidecar
spec:
  volumes:
  - name: shared-logs
    emptyDir: {}
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
    ports:
    - containerPort: 9898
    volumeMounts:
    - name: shared-logs
      mountPath: /var/log/app
  - name: log-sidecar
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'while true; do echo "[sidecar] $(date) watching..."; ls /var/log/app/ 2>/dev/null; sleep 10; done']
    volumeMounts:
    - name: shared-logs
      mountPath: /var/log/app
      readOnly: true
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f sidecar-pod.yaml
 
kubectl get pods app-with-sidecar
# READY: 2/2
 
# Logs từng container
kubectl logs app-with-sidecar -c app
kubectl logs app-with-sidecar -c log-sidecar
 
# Test shared volume
kubectl exec app-with-sidecar -c app -- sh -c 'echo "test data" > /var/log/app/test.log'
kubectl exec app-with-sidecar -c log-sidecar -- cat /var/log/app/test.log
# test data ← Shared!

💡 Multi-Container Patterns:

























PatternVí dụMô tảSidecarLog shipper, Envoy proxyBổ sung chức năng cho appAmbassadorRedis proxyProxy connectionsAdapterLog formatterTransform output
Containers trong Pod share: Network (localhost), Volumes, IPC namespace.

✅ Checkpoint

 Pod 2/2 Running, share volume thành công


Bước 2: Init Container
cat > init-pod.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app-with-init
  labels:
    app: podinfo
    pattern: init-container
spec:
  initContainers:
  - name: wait-for-dependency
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "Checking deps..."; sleep 5; echo "Ready!"']
  - name: setup-config
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "Generated at $(date)" > /config/app.conf']
    volumeMounts:
    - name: config
      mountPath: /config
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
    ports:
    - containerPort: 9898
    volumeMounts:
    - name: config
      mountPath: /etc/app-config
      readOnly: true
  volumes:
  - name: config
    emptyDir: {}
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f init-pod.yaml
 
# Watch: Init:0/2 → Init:1/2 → PodInitializing → Running
kubectl get pod app-with-init -w &
sleep 15
kill %1 2>/dev/null
 
# Logs từ init containers
kubectl logs app-with-init -c wait-for-dependency
kubectl logs app-with-init -c setup-config
 
# Verify config
kubectl exec app-with-init -- cat /etc/app-config/app.conf

💡 Init Container Rules:

Chạy tuần tự (1 xong → 2 chạy)
Fail → Pod restart, init chạy lại từ đầu
KHÔNG có liveness/readiness probes
Use case: wait for DB, download config, setup permissions


✅ Checkpoint

 Init chạy tuần tự trước main container
 Config từ init available cho main container


Bước 3: ResourceQuota & LimitRange
# ResourceQuota = giới hạn TỔNG namespace
cat > quota.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: dev-quota
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "4"
    requests.memory: 4Gi
    limits.cpu: "8"
    limits.memory: 8Gi
    pods: "20"
---
# LimitRange = default/min/max per Pod
apiVersion: v1
kind: LimitRange
metadata:
  name: default-limits
spec:
  limits:
  - type: Container
    default:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 128Mi
    defaultRequest:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 64Mi
    max:
      cpu: "1"
      memory: 1Gi
    min:
      cpu: 50m
      memory: 32Mi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f quota.yaml
 
# Verify
kubectl describe resourcequota dev-quota
kubectl describe limitrange default-limits
 
# Test: Pod không set resources → LimitRange auto-apply
kubectl run no-resources --image=busybox:1.36 --command -- sleep 3600
kubectl describe pod no-resources | grep -A 4 "Requests\|Limits"
# Requests: cpu=100m, memory=64Mi ← từ LimitRange!
 
kubectl delete pod no-resources

💡 ResourceQuota vs LimitRange:

























ResourceQuotaLimitRangeScopeTổng namespacePer Pod/ContainerMục đíchCap toàn namespaceDefault + min/maxKhi nàoMulti-tenant clustersNgăn Pods quên set resources

✅ Checkpoint

 Quota + LimitRange tạo thành công
 LimitRange auto-apply defaults


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete pod app-with-sidecar app-with-init
rm -f sidecar-pod.yaml init-pod.yaml quota.yaml
# Giữ deployment podinfo, namespace dev, quota/limitrange

🎤 Interview Questions

Init Container fail? → Pod restart, init chạy lại TỪ ĐẦU. Main containers KHÔNG start cho đến khi TẤT CẢ init succeed.
Multi-container Pod share gì? → Network (localhost, same IP), Volumes, IPC. KHÔNG share filesystem (cần explicit volume mount).
ResourceQuota vs LimitRange? → Quota: tổng cho namespace (prevent noisy neighbor). LimitRange: per-Pod defaults + min/max.


Tiếp: Lab 09: Deployment Basics →
⬅️ Lab 07 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/09-depl.title: Lab 09: Deployment Basics
02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/09-depl.content:
Lab 09: Deployment Basics

🕐 30 phút | 📖 Ch04 Workloads | ⬅️ Lab 08


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Hiểu ReplicaSet và tại sao không dùng trực tiếp
Viết Deployment spec production-grade
Deployment → ReplicaSet → Pods hierarchy
RollingUpdate vs Recreate strategy


Bước 1: ReplicaSet — Hiểu Hạn Chế
cat > rs-demo.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ReplicaSet
metadata:
  name: podinfo-rs
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: podinfo-rs-demo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: podinfo-rs-demo
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: podinfo
        image: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.6.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9898
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 32Mi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f rs-demo.yaml
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo-rs-demo
 
# Self-healing works
POD=$(kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo-rs-demo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl delete pod $POD
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo-rs-demo
# Pod mới tạo ngay!
 
# THỬ update image → RS KHÔNG rolling update!
kubectl set image replicaset/podinfo-rs podinfo=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo-rs-demo -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}{end}'
# Vẫn 6.6.0! RS chỉ update template, KHÔNG recreate existing Pods
 
kubectl delete replicaset podinfo-rs
rm -f rs-demo.yaml

💡 RS Limitations:
✅ Self-healing (maintain replicas) | ❌ NO rolling update | ❌ NO rollback
→ Rule: KHÔNG BAO GIỜ tạo ReplicaSet trực tiếp. Luôn dùng Deployment.

✅ Checkpoint

 RS self-heal nhưng KHÔNG rolling update
 Hiểu tại sao cần Deployment


Bước 2: Production Deployment Spec
kubectl delete deployment podinfo --ignore-not-found
 
cat > podinfo-deployment.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: podinfo
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/change-cause: "Initial deployment v6.6.0"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: podinfo
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1          # Tối đa 1 Pod dư khi update
      maxUnavailable: 0    # Không bao giờ giảm dưới desired → zero downtime
  minReadySeconds: 5       # Pod phải Ready 5s mới tính available
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: podinfo
        version: "6.6.0"
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: podinfo
        image: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.6.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9898
          name: http
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 128Mi
        env:
        - name: PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE
          value: "Podinfo v6.6.0"
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f podinfo-deployment.yaml
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
✅ Checkpoint

 Deployment tạo 3 Pods


Bước 3: Hierarchy — Deployment → RS → Pods
# Xem relationship
kubectl get deployment podinfo
kubectl get replicaset -l app=podinfo
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo
 
# Naming convention:
# podinfo → podinfo-7d8f9c6b5f → podinfo-7d8f9c6b5f-x2k4j
#  (deploy)     (replicaset+hash)      (pod+random)
 
kubectl get rs -l app=podinfo -o custom-columns=\
NAME:.metadata.name,\
DESIRED:.spec.replicas,\
READY:.status.readyReplicas,\
OWNER:.metadata.ownerReferences[0].name

💡 Architecture:
Deployment (strategy, rollback history, version management)
  └── ReplicaSet (replica count, Pod template hash)
        ├── Pod 1
        ├── Pod 2
        └── Pod 3

Khi update → Deployment tạo NEW ReplicaSet, scale up new, scale down old.

✅ Checkpoint

 Hiểu 3-layer hierarchy và naming convention


Bước 4: Recreate vs RollingUpdate
# Demo Recreate strategy
cat > recreate-demo.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: recreate-demo
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: recreate-demo
  strategy:
    type: Recreate    # Kill ALL → Create ALL
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: recreate-demo
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.6.0
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 32Mi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f recreate-demo.yaml
kubectl rollout status deployment/recreate-demo
 
# Watch + update
kubectl get pods -l app=recreate-demo -w &
kubectl set image deployment/recreate-demo app=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
# ALL old Terminating → ALL new Creating → CÓ DOWNTIME!
sleep 15
kill %1 2>/dev/null
 
kubectl delete deployment recreate-demo
rm -f recreate-demo.yaml

💡 Strategy Comparison:

























RollingUpdateRecreateDowntime❌ Zero✅ YesConcurrent versions2 versions tạm thời1 versionUse caseProduction APIsDB migrations, dev

✅ Checkpoint

 Recreate → downtime, RollingUpdate → zero downtime
 Hiểu maxSurge + maxUnavailable


🧹 Cleanup
# GIỮ podinfo deployment cho Lab 10

🎤 Interview Questions

Deployment → RS → Pods? → Deployment quản lý RS (strategy, rollback). RS quản lý Pods (replica count). RS KHÔNG dùng trực tiếp.
maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=0, replicas=3? → Tối đa 4 Pods tạm thời, không bao giờ dưới 3. Zero downtime.
Recreate khi nào? → App không support 2 versions (DB schema migration), dev environment. Production → luôn RollingUpdate.


Tiếp: Lab 10: Rolling Update & Rollback →
⬅️ Lab 08 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/10-roll.title: Lab 10: Rolling Update & Rollback
02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/10-roll.content:
Lab 10: Rolling Update & Rollback

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch04 Workloads | ⬅️ Lab 09


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Thực hiện rolling update, watch realtime
Rollback khi deploy lỗi
Pause/resume rollout
Quản lý rollout history


Bước 1: Rolling Update
# Watch Pods
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo -w &
 
# Update: 6.6.0 → 6.7.1
kubectl set image deployment/podinfo podinfo=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
kubectl annotate deployment/podinfo kubernetes.io/change-cause="Upgrade to v6.7.1" --overwrite
 
# Watch rollout
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
 
kill %1 2>/dev/null
 
# Verify
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}{end}'
# 6.7.1 ✓
 
# 2 ReplicaSets giờ
kubectl get rs -l app=podinfo
# New RS: 3 replicas | Old RS: 0 replicas (kept for rollback)

💡 Rolling Update Process (maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=0):
[OLD OLD OLD] + [NEW]     → surge +1
[OLD OLD] + [NEW NEW]     → new ready, old -1  
[OLD] + [NEW NEW NEW]     → new ready, old -1
[NEW NEW NEW]             → done!


✅ Checkpoint

 Rolling update zero downtime
 Old RS kept (replicas=0) cho rollback


Bước 2: Rollback — Bad Deploy
# Deploy bad image
kubectl set image deployment/podinfo podinfo=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:99.99.99
kubectl annotate deployment/podinfo kubernetes.io/change-cause="BAD: nonexistent" --overwrite
 
sleep 10
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo
# New Pod: ImagePullBackOff | Old Pods: Running (maxUnavailable=0 bảo vệ!)
 
# Rollback
kubectl rollout undo deployment/podinfo
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
 
# Verify
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}{end}'
# 6.7.1 ← quay về version trước!
 
# History
kubectl rollout history deployment/podinfo
✅ Checkpoint

 Bad deploy → old Pods vẫn serving
 rollout undo quay về version trước


Bước 3: Rollback Tới Revision Cụ Thể
# Xem history
kubectl rollout history deployment/podinfo
# REVISION  CHANGE-CAUSE
# 1         Initial deployment v6.6.0
# 3         BAD: nonexistent
# 4         Upgrade to v6.7.1
 
# Rollback về revision 1 (v6.6.0)
kubectl rollout undo deployment/podinfo --to-revision=1
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
 
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}{end}'
# 6.6.0!
 
# Quay lại 6.7.1
kubectl set image deployment/podinfo podinfo=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
kubectl annotate deployment/podinfo kubernetes.io/change-cause="Restore v6.7.1" --overwrite
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
✅ Checkpoint

 --to-revision=N rollback chính xác


Bước 4: Pause/Resume — Batch Changes
# Pause → thay đổi nhiều thứ → Resume = 1 rollout duy nhất
kubectl rollout pause deployment/podinfo
 
kubectl set resources deployment/podinfo \
  -c podinfo --requests=cpu=150m,memory=96Mi --limits=cpu=300m,memory=192Mi
 
kubectl set env deployment/podinfo PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE="Updated config"
 
# Chưa rollout! Pods cũ vẫn chạy
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo
 
# Resume — apply tất cả cùng lúc
kubectl rollout resume deployment/podinfo
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo

💡 Pause/Resume: Tránh 5 rollouts liên tiếp khi thay đổi nhiều fields.
pause → set image → set resources → set env → resume = 1 rollout duy nhất.

✅ Checkpoint

 Pause → multiple changes → Resume → 1 rollout


Bước 5: Scale
kubectl scale deployment podinfo --replicas=5
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo
# 5 Pods
 
kubectl scale deployment podinfo --replicas=3
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo
# 3 Pods (2 terminated)
✅ Checkpoint

 Scale up/down thành công


🧹 Cleanup
# Giữ deployment podinfo

🎤 Interview Questions

rollout undo internals? → Deployment rollback bằng cách scale up old ReplicaSet, scale down current RS. Thực chất là “create new revision” pointing to old RS template.
change-cause annotation? → Giúp track lý do mỗi revision trong rollout history. Không ảnh hưởng functionality.
Pause/Resume dùng khi nào? → Batch multiple config changes thành 1 rollout. CI/CD pipeline thường dùng.


Tiếp: Lab 11: StatefulSet — Redis →
⬅️ Lab 09 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/11-stat.title: Lab 11: StatefulSet — Redis
02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/11-stat.content:
Lab 11: StatefulSet — Redis

🕐 30 phút | 📖 Ch04 StatefulSet | ⬅️ Lab 10


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Tạo StatefulSet với stable identity
Headless Service → per-Pod DNS
Ordered creation/deletion
Hiểu khi nào dùng StatefulSet vs Deployment


Bước 1: Headless Service + StatefulSet
cat > redis-statefulset.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-headless
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: redis
  ports:
  - port: 6379
    name: redis
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis
spec:
  serviceName: redis-headless
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: redis
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 6379
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 128Mi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f redis-statefulset.yaml
 
# Watch ordered creation: 0 → 1 → 2
kubectl get pods -w -l app=redis &
sleep 30
kill %1 2>/dev/null
 
kubectl get pods -l app=redis
# redis-0   1/1   Running
# redis-1   1/1   Running
# redis-2   1/1   Running ← Tên CỐ ĐỊNH, CÓ THỨ TỰ!
✅ Checkpoint

 Pods tên: redis-0, redis-1, redis-2
 Tạo tuần tự (0 trước, rồi 1, rồi 2)


Bước 2: Stable DNS Identity
kubectl run dns-test --image=busybox:1.36 --rm -it -- sh
 
# Headless Service → trả TẤT CẢ Pod IPs
nslookup redis-headless
# 3 Pod IP addresses
 
# Mỗi Pod có DNS riêng!
nslookup redis-0.redis-headless
nslookup redis-1.redis-headless
nslookup redis-2.redis-headless
# Format: <pod-name>.<headless-svc>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local
 
exit

💡 Tại sao Stable Identity quan trọng?
Databases cần biết nhau: redis-0 = master, redis-1,2 = replicas.
Delete redis-1 → Pod mới VẪN tên redis-1, VẪN cùng DNS, VẪN cùng PVC.

✅ Checkpoint

 Per-Pod DNS: redis-0.redis-headless
 Headless → trả tất cả Pod IPs (khác ClusterIP)


Bước 3: Ordered Operations
# Scale down: 2 → 1 → 0 (reverse order!)
kubectl scale statefulset redis --replicas=1
kubectl get pods -l app=redis -w &
sleep 15
kill %1 2>/dev/null
# redis-2 Terminating → redis-1 Terminating → redis-0 Running
 
kubectl scale statefulset redis --replicas=3
sleep 20
kubectl get pods -l app=redis
 
# Delete Pod → recreated with SAME name
kubectl delete pod redis-1
kubectl get pods -l app=redis
# redis-1 recreated!
✅ Checkpoint

 Scale down: 2→1→0 (reverse). Scale up: 0→1→2
 Delete Pod → same name, same DNS


Bước 4: Test Redis Data
# Write data to redis-0
kubectl exec redis-0 -- redis-cli SET mykey "hello-from-redis-0"
kubectl exec redis-0 -- redis-cli GET mykey
# "hello-from-redis-0"
 
# redis-1 has SEPARATE data
kubectl exec redis-1 -- redis-cli GET mykey
# (nil) ← separate instance!
 
kubectl exec redis-1 -- redis-cli SET anotherkey "data-on-redis-1"
 
# 💡 Mỗi StatefulSet Pod là instance riêng biệt
# Cluster replication (Redis Sentinel/Cluster) là application-level, không phải K8s level
✅ Checkpoint

 Mỗi Pod có data riêng biệt


🧹 Cleanup
# GIỮ redis StatefulSet + headless Service → dùng Lab 14-15, Lab 22

🎤 Interview Questions

StatefulSet vs Deployment? → StatefulSet: stable names (redis-0), ordered ops, per-Pod PVC/DNS. Deployment: random names, parallel ops, stateless.
Headless Service là gì? → clusterIP: None. DNS trả per-Pod IPs thay vì single VIP. Required cho StatefulSet.
Scale down StatefulSet? → Reverse order (N-1 → N-2 → … → 0). Graceful, ordinal đảm bảo data safe.


Tiếp: Lab 12: DaemonSet — Node Agent →
⬅️ Lab 10 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/12-daem.title: Lab 12: DaemonSet — Node Agent
02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/12-daem.content:
Lab 12: DaemonSet — Node Agent

🕐 20 phút | 📖 Ch04 DaemonSet | ⬅️ Lab 11


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Deploy DaemonSet — 1 Pod per Node
Tolerations cho master nodes
Xem DaemonSets hệ thống


Bước 1: Tạo DaemonSet
cat > node-monitor.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: node-monitor
  labels:
    app: node-monitor
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: node-monitor
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: node-monitor
    spec:
      tolerations:
      - key: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane
        operator: Exists
        effect: NoSchedule
      containers:
      - name: monitor
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ['sh', '-c', 'while true; do echo "[$(date)] Node: $(hostname) — Load: $(cat /proc/loadavg | cut -d" " -f1-3)"; sleep 30; done']
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 32Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f node-monitor.yaml
 
# 1 Pod per Node!
kubectl get pods -l app=node-monitor -o wide
kubectl get daemonset node-monitor
# DESIRED = CURRENT = READY = Số Nodes
✅ Checkpoint

 Số Pods = Số Nodes


Bước 2: DaemonSets Hệ Thống
# Real-world DaemonSets:
kubectl get daemonsets -n kube-system
# kube-proxy     — network rules trên mọi Node
# calico-node    — CNI plugin
# Nếu có monitoring: node-exporter, fluentd
 
# Logs DaemonSet Pod
kubectl logs -l app=node-monitor --max-log-requests=10 | tail -5
 
# Update DaemonSet → rolling update per Node
kubectl set image daemonset/node-monitor monitor=busybox:1.36
kubectl rollout status daemonset/node-monitor

💡 Deployment vs StatefulSet vs DaemonSet:



































DeploymentStatefulSetDaemonSetIdentityRandomStable orderedPer-nodeReplicas0-N0-N ordered1 per Node (auto)StorageSharedPer-Pod PVChostPathUse caseStateless appsDatabasesAgents, collectors

✅ Checkpoint

 kube-proxy là DaemonSet
 Hiểu khi nào dùng DaemonSet


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete daemonset node-monitor
rm -f node-monitor.yaml

🎤 Interview Questions

DaemonSet replicas? → Bằng số Nodes. Auto scale khi thêm/xóa Node.
Toleration trong DaemonSet? → Cho phép chạy trên tainted Nodes (master/control-plane). Cần thiết cho monitoring agents.
Delete DaemonSet? → Tất cả Pods bị xóa. Tạo lại → Pods mới tạo trên mọi Node.


Tiếp: Lab 13: Jobs & CronJobs →
⬅️ Lab 11 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/13-jobs.title: Lab 13: Jobs & CronJobs
02---areas/k8s/labs/04-workloads/13-jobs.content:
Lab 13: Jobs & CronJobs

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch04 Jobs | ⬅️ Lab 12


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Job one-shot và parallel
backoffLimit, activeDeadlineSeconds
CronJob scheduling, concurrencyPolicy
TTL auto-cleanup


Bước 1: One-shot Job
cat > migration-job.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: db-migration
spec:
  backoffLimit: 3
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: migrate
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "Running migration..."; sleep 5; echo "Done!"']
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 32Mi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f migration-job.yaml
sleep 8
 
kubectl get jobs
# COMPLETIONS: 1/1
 
kubectl get pods -l job-name=db-migration
# STATUS: Completed
 
kubectl logs -l job-name=db-migration

💡 Job vs Deployment: Job chạy đến completion rồi dừng. Deployment giữ Pods chạy mãi.
restartPolicy: Never (tạo Pod mới khi fail) hoặc OnFailure (restart container). KHÔNG Always.

✅ Checkpoint

 Job completed, Pod ở Completed status


Bước 2: Parallel Jobs
cat > parallel-job.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: batch-process
spec:
  completions: 5
  parallelism: 3
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: worker
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "Worker $(hostname)"; sleep $(shuf -i 2-5 -n1); echo "Done"']
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 32Mi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f parallel-job.yaml
sleep 15
 
kubectl get job batch-process
# COMPLETIONS: 5/5
 
kubectl get pods -l job-name=batch-process
# 5 Completed Pods
✅ Checkpoint

 3 Pods chạy đồng thời, tổng 5 completions


Bước 3: CronJob
cat > backup-cronjob.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: backup
spec:
  schedule: "*/2 * * * *"        # Mỗi 2 phút
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid      # Không 2 Jobs đồng thời
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 2
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 100
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
          - name: backup
            image: busybox:1.36
            command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "Backup at $(date)"; sleep 3; echo "Complete"']
            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 50m
                memory: 32Mi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f backup-cronjob.yaml
 
kubectl get cronjobs
# SCHEDULE: */2 * * * *
 
# Wait 2 phút cho lần chạy đầu
echo "Waiting for first run..."
sleep 130
kubectl get jobs
kubectl logs -l job-name --tail=5
 
# Trigger thủ công
kubectl create job manual-backup --from=cronjob/backup
 
# Suspend/Resume
kubectl patch cronjob backup -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'
kubectl get cronjobs   # SUSPEND: True
kubectl patch cronjob backup -p '{"spec":{"suspend":false}}'
 
# TTL auto-cleanup
cat > ttl-job.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: auto-clean
spec:
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 30
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: task
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "Quick task"; exit 0']
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 32Mi
EOF
kubectl apply -f ttl-job.yaml
sleep 40
kubectl get job auto-clean 2>&1
# Not found → auto-deleted!

💡 concurrencyPolicy:

Allow — chạy đồng thời (default)
Forbid — skip nếu Job trước chưa xong ← dùng cho backup
Replace — cancel Job cũ, chạy Job mới


✅ Checkpoint

 CronJob tạo Jobs theo schedule
 Manual trigger, suspend/resume
 TTL auto-cleanup


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete cronjob backup
kubectl delete job db-migration batch-process manual-backup 2>/dev/null
rm -f migration-job.yaml parallel-job.yaml backup-cronjob.yaml ttl-job.yaml

🎤 Interview Questions

restartPolicy cho Job? → Never (tạo Pod mới) hoặc OnFailure (restart container). KHÔNG Always.
concurrencyPolicy Forbid? → Skip CronJob run nếu Job trước chưa xong. Tránh 2 backups chạy đồng thời.
Trigger CronJob ngay? → kubectl create job <name> --from=cronjob/<cronjob>.


Tiếp: Lab 14: ClusterIP & DNS →
⬅️ Lab 12 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/05-networking/14-clu.title: Lab 14: ClusterIP & Service Discovery
02---areas/k8s/labs/05-networking/14-clu.content:
Lab 14: ClusterIP & Service Discovery

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch05 Services | ⬅️ Lab 13


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Tạo ClusterIP Service
Test DNS service discovery
Verify load balancing giữa Pods
Hiểu Endpoints


Bước 1: Tạo Service Cho podinfo
# Tạo Service nếu chưa có
kubectl expose deployment podinfo --port=80 --target-port=9898 --name=podinfo-svc 2>/dev/null || true
 
kubectl get svc podinfo-svc
# TYPE: ClusterIP, PORT: 80/TCP
 
# Xem Endpoints
kubectl get endpoints podinfo-svc
# 3 Pod IPs
 
kubectl describe svc podinfo-svc

💡 Service flow: Client → ClusterIP (VIP) → iptables (kube-proxy) → Pod IP
Service KHÔNG proxy. Nó config iptables rules trên mỗi Node.

✅ Checkpoint

 Service tạo, có ClusterIP
 Endpoints = 3 Pod IPs


Bước 2: DNS Service Discovery
kubectl run curl-test --image=curlimages/curl --rm -it -- sh
 
# Short name (cùng namespace)
curl http://podinfo-svc
# JSON response!
 
# FQDN
curl podinfo-svc.dev.svc.cluster.local
 
# DNS resolution
nslookup podinfo-svc
nslookup podinfo-svc.dev.svc.cluster.local
# → 1 ClusterIP address
 
exit

💡 DNS Formats:
<service>                              ← cùng namespace
<service>.<namespace>                  ← cross-namespace
<service>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local ← FQDN

CoreDNS (kube-system) auto-config /etc/resolv.conf trong mỗi Pod.

✅ Checkpoint

 DNS resolve: podinfo-svc → ClusterIP
 FQDN hoạt động


Bước 3: Load Balancing
kubectl run lb-test --image=curlimages/curl --rm -it -- sh
 
# Request nhiều lần → hostname thay đổi!
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  curl -s http://podinfo-svc | grep -o '"hostname":"[^"]*"'
done
# "hostname":"podinfo-xxxxx"  ← thay đổi!
# "hostname":"podinfo-yyyyy"
# "hostname":"podinfo-xxxxx"
 
exit
✅ Checkpoint

 Requests phân phối giữa 3 Pods


Bước 4: Tạo Service Cho Redis
# Redis cần ClusterIP Service cho podinfo kết nối
kubectl expose statefulset redis --port=6379 --target-port=6379 --name=redis-svc 2>/dev/null || true
 
kubectl get svc redis-svc
kubectl get endpoints redis-svc
 
# Test kết nối
kubectl run redis-test --image=redis:7-alpine --rm -it -- redis-cli -h redis-svc PING
# PONG ← connected!
✅ Checkpoint

 Redis Service hoạt động, PING → PONG


🧹 Cleanup
# Giữ Services cho labs tiếp

🎤 Interview Questions

Service discovery? → CoreDNS: <svc> → ClusterIP → kube-proxy → Pod. Mọi Pod auto-configured resolv.conf.
Endpoint ? → Selector không match bất kỳ Pod nào. Fix: check labels. (Debug chi tiết Lab 15)
Service load balancing algorithm? → Default: random (iptables). IPVS mode: round-robin, least-connections.


Tiếp: Lab 15: NodePort & Headless Service →
⬅️ Lab 13 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/05-networking/15-nod.title: Lab 15: NodePort & Headless Service
02---areas/k8s/labs/05-networking/15-nod.content:
Lab 15: NodePort & Headless Service

🕐 20 phút | 📖 Ch05 Services | ⬅️ Lab 14


🎯 Mục Tiêu

NodePort — external access
Headless Service — per-Pod DNS
Debug Service selector mismatch


Bước 1: NodePort
cat > nodeport-svc.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: podinfo-nodeport
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: podinfo
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 9898
    nodePort: 30080
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f nodeport-svc.yaml
 
NODE_IP=$(kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.addresses[?(@.type=="InternalIP")].address}')
echo "Access: http://$NODE_IP:30080"
 
# Test
curl http://$NODE_IP:30080

💡 Service Types:





























TypeAccessPort RangeProductionClusterIPInternalAnyMicroservicesNodePortExternal via NodeIP30000-32767Dev, bare-metalLoadBalancerExternal via cloud LBAnyCloud (AWS/GCP)

✅ Checkpoint

 Access podinfo từ bên ngoài cluster qua NodePort


Bước 2: Headless Service (Review)
# Redis headless đã tạo ở Lab 11
kubectl get svc redis-headless
# CLUSTER-IP: None
 
kubectl run dns-cmp --image=busybox:1.36 --rm -it -- sh
 
# ClusterIP Service → 1 VIP
nslookup podinfo-svc
 
# Headless Service → từng Pod IP
nslookup redis-headless
# Address 1: 10.244.x.x redis-0.redis-headless...
# Address 2: 10.244.x.x redis-1.redis-headless...
# Address 3: 10.244.x.x redis-2.redis-headless...
 
exit

💡 ClusterIP vs Headless:

























ClusterIPHeadlessDNS trả về1 VIPTất cả Pod IPsLoad balancekube-proxyClient-sideUse caseStateless appsStatefulSet, gRPC

✅ Checkpoint

 So sánh DNS results: ClusterIP (1 IP) vs Headless (N IPs)


Bước 3: Debug — Selector Mismatch
# Tạo Service sai selector
cat > broken-svc.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: broken-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: wrong-label
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 9898
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f broken-svc.yaml
 
# Endpoints → <none>!
kubectl get endpoints broken-svc
# ENDPOINTS: <none>
 
# Debug flow:
kubectl describe svc broken-svc | grep Selector
# app=wrong-label
 
kubectl get pods --show-labels | grep podinfo
# app=podinfo (selector không match!)
 
# Fix
kubectl patch svc broken-svc -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"podinfo"}}}'
kubectl get endpoints broken-svc
# Now has Pod IPs!
 
kubectl delete svc broken-svc
rm -f broken-svc.yaml

💡 Service Debug Checklist:
No endpoints?
├── kubectl describe svc → check Selector
├── kubectl get pods --show-labels → match?
├── Readiness probe failing? → Pod not Ready = removed
└── Wrong namespace?


✅ Checkpoint

 Debug selector mismatch: no endpoints → fix selector


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete svc podinfo-nodeport
rm -f nodeport-svc.yaml
# Giữ podinfo-svc, redis-svc, redis-headless

🎤 Interview Questions

NodePort range? → 30000-32767. Port mở trên TẤT CẢ Nodes.
Headless Service dùng khi nào? → StatefulSet (per-Pod DNS), client-side LB, gRPC.
Endpoints  — fix? → Compare service selector vs pod labels. Hoặc check readiness probe.


Tiếp: Lab 16: Ingress Routing →
⬅️ Lab 14 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/05-networking/16-ing.title: Lab 16: Ingress Routing
02---areas/k8s/labs/05-networking/16-ing.content:
Lab 16: Ingress Routing

🕐 30 phút | 📖 Ch05 Ingress | ⬅️ Lab 15


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Install nginx Ingress Controller
Tạo Ingress với host/path routing
Multi-service routing


Bước 1: Install Ingress Controller
helm repo add ingress-nginx kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx
helm repo update
 
helm install ingress-nginx ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx \
  --namespace ingress-nginx --create-namespace \
  --set controller.service.type=NodePort \
  --set controller.service.nodePorts.http=30080 \
  --wait --timeout 3m
 
kubectl get pods -n ingress-nginx
# ingress-nginx-controller-xxx   1/1   Running
✅ Checkpoint

 Ingress Controller running


Bước 2: Deploy Backend App
# Tạo backend riêng biệt
kubectl create deployment backend \
  --image=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1 --replicas=2
 
kubectl set env deployment/backend PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE="Backend API" PODINFO_UI_COLOR="#FF5722"
kubectl expose deployment backend --port=80 --target-port=9898 --name=backend-svc
✅ Checkpoint

 backend deployment + Service ready


Bước 3: Tạo Ingress Resource
cat > app-ingress.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: app-ingress
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
  - host: app.lab.local
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: podinfo-svc
            port:
              number: 80
      - path: /api
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: backend-svc
            port:
              number: 80
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f app-ingress.yaml
kubectl get ingress
✅ Checkpoint

 Ingress created


Bước 4: Test Routing
NODE_IP=$(kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.addresses[?(@.type=="InternalIP")].address}')
INGRESS_PORT=$(kubectl get svc ingress-nginx-controller -n ingress-nginx -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[?(@.name=="http")].nodePort}')
 
# Path routing
curl -H "Host: app.lab.local" http://$NODE_IP:$INGRESS_PORT/
# → Frontend (podinfo)
 
curl -H "Host: app.lab.local" http://$NODE_IP:$INGRESS_PORT/api
# → Backend API

💡 Ingress Flow:
Client → DNS → Ingress Controller (nginx Pod)
  → /     → podinfo-svc → podinfo Pods
  → /api  → backend-svc → backend Pods

Ingress = K8s resource (rules). Ingress Controller = implementation (nginx, traefik).

✅ Checkpoint

 / → podinfo, /api → backend


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete ingress app-ingress
kubectl delete deployment backend
kubectl delete svc backend-svc
rm -f app-ingress.yaml
# Giữ ingress-nginx cho production lab

🎤 Interview Questions

Ingress vs Ingress Controller? → Ingress: K8s resource (routing rules). Controller: actual implementation (nginx/traefik). Không có Controller → Ingress không hoạt động.
ingressClassName? → Chỉ định Ingress Controller class. Cluster có thể có nhiều Controllers.
Ingress vs LoadBalancer Service? → Ingress: L7 (HTTP routing, host/path). LoadBalancer: L4 (TCP/UDP, no routing). Ingress hiệu quả hơn (1 LB cho nhiều Services).

⬅️ Lab 15 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/06-configuration/17-.title: Lab 17: ConfigMap & Environment
02---areas/k8s/labs/06-configuration/17-.content:
Lab 17: ConfigMap & Environment

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch06 Configuration | ⬅️ Lab 16


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Tạo ConfigMap (env vars + volume mount)
Test hot-reload (volume auto-update)
Immutable ConfigMap


Bước 1: Tạo ConfigMap
cat > podinfo-config.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: podinfo-config
data:
  PODINFO_UI_COLOR: "#2196F3"
  PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE: "Configured via ConfigMap!"
  app-settings.yaml: |
    database:
      host: postgres
      port: 5432
    cache:
      host: redis-svc
      port: 6379
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f podinfo-config.yaml
✅ Checkpoint

 ConfigMap tạo với key-value + file content


Bước 2: Inject Vào Deployment
kubectl set env deployment/podinfo --from=configmap/podinfo-config
 
# Verify
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl exec $POD -- env | grep PODINFO
 
# Mount file config
kubectl patch deployment podinfo --type=json -p='[
  {"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/volumes","value":[{"name":"config","configMap":{"name":"podinfo-config","items":[{"key":"app-settings.yaml","path":"settings.yaml"}]}}]},
  {"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/volumeMounts","value":[{"name":"config","mountPath":"/etc/podinfo-config","readOnly":true}]}
]'
 
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl exec $POD -- cat /etc/podinfo-config/settings.yaml
✅ Checkpoint

 Env vars injected, file mounted


Bước 3: Hot-Reload
# Update ConfigMap
kubectl patch configmap podinfo-config --type merge \
  -p '{"data":{"app-settings.yaml":"database:\n  host: postgres-new\n  port: 5432\ncache:\n  host: redis-svc\n  port: 6379\n"}}'
 
echo "Waiting 60s for kubelet sync..."
sleep 60
 
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
# Volume mount → UPDATED!
kubectl exec $POD -- cat /etc/podinfo-config/settings.yaml
# host: postgres-new ✓
 
# Env vars → NOT updated (cần restart)
kubectl exec $POD -- env | grep PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE
# Vẫn cũ!
 
kubectl rollout restart deployment/podinfo

💡 Update Behavior:

























MethodAuto-update?DelayenvFrom / env.valueFrom❌—Volume mount✅30-60sVolume mount + subPath❌—

✅ Checkpoint

 Volume auto-update, env vars KHÔNG auto-update


Bước 4: Immutable ConfigMap
cat > immutable-cm.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: immutable-config
data:
  VERSION: "2.0.0"
immutable: true
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f immutable-cm.yaml
 
# Thử update → REJECTED!
kubectl patch configmap immutable-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"VERSION":"3.0.0"}}' 2>&1
# Error: immutable field
 
kubectl delete configmap immutable-config
rm -f immutable-cm.yaml
✅ Checkpoint

 Immutable → cannot modify after creation


🧹 Cleanup
rm -f podinfo-config.yaml
# Giữ ConfigMap, deployment cho labs tiếp

🎤 Interview Questions

ConfigMap update → Pod auto-reload? → Volume: yes (30-60s). Env vars: no (restart needed). subPath: no.
Immutable ConfigMap? → Locked, performance boost (kubelet skip watch), safety.
ConfigMap vs Secret? → ConfigMap: clear text, non-sensitive. Secret: base64, sensitive (nhưng NOT encrypted). Inject giống nhau.
