02---areas/k8s/labs/06-configuration/18-.title: Lab 18: Secrets Management
02---areas/k8s/labs/06-configuration/18-.content:
Lab 18: Secrets Management

🕐 20 phút | 📖 Ch06 Configuration | ⬅️ Lab 17


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Tạo Secret (Opaque, TLS, docker-registry)
Inject vào Pod
Base64 ≠ encryption


Bước 1: Tạo Secret
kubectl create secret generic db-credentials \
  --from-literal=DB_USER=podinfo_admin \
  --from-literal=DB_PASSWORD='S3cur3P@ss!'
 
# Xem (base64)
kubectl get secret db-credentials -o yaml | grep -A 5 "data:"
 
# Decode
kubectl get secret db-credentials -o jsonpath='{.data.DB_PASSWORD}' | base64 -d
echo
# S3cur3P@ss! ← Ai có RBAC read → xem được!

⚠️ base64 ≠ encryption. Production cần: Sealed Secrets, HashiCorp Vault, External Secrets Operator.

✅ Checkpoint

 Secret tạo, base64 decode thành công


Bước 2: Secret Types
# Opaque (generic)
kubectl create secret generic app-secret --from-literal=API_KEY=abc123 --dry-run=client -o yaml | head -8
# type: Opaque
 
# TLS
kubectl create secret tls my-tls --cert=/dev/null --key=/dev/null --dry-run=client -o yaml | head -8
# type: kubernetes.io/tls
 
# Docker Registry
kubectl create secret docker-registry my-reg \
  --docker-server=registry.example.com \
  --docker-username=user --docker-password=pass \
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | head -8
# type: kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson

💡 Secret Types:

























TypeDùng choOpaqueGeneric key-valuekubernetes.io/tlsTLS certificateskubernetes.io/dockerconfigjsonPrivate registrieskubernetes.io/service-account-tokenSA tokens (auto)

✅ Checkpoint

 3+ Secret types


Bước 3: Inject Secret Vào Pod
kubectl set env deployment/podinfo \
  --from=secret/db-credentials \
  --prefix=DB_
 
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
 
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl exec $POD -- env | grep DB_
# DB_DB_USER=podinfo_admin
# DB_DB_PASSWORD=S3cur3P@ss!
✅ Checkpoint

 Secret injected thành env vars


🧹 Cleanup
# Giữ secrets cho labs tiếp

🎤 Interview Questions

Secret base64 an toàn? → KHÔNG! Encoding, không phải encryption. RBAC read = decode được. Cần thêm tools.
Secret vs ConfigMap? → Secret: base64, sensitive data. ConfigMap: clear text, non-sensitive. Inject cùng cách.
docker-registry Secret? → imagePullSecrets trong Pod spec. Dùng khi pull từ private registry.


Tiếp: Lab 19: Resource Limits & OOMKill →
⬅️ Lab 17 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/06-configuration/19-.title: Lab 19: Resource Limits & OOMKill
02---areas/k8s/labs/06-configuration/19-.content:
Lab 19: Resource Limits & OOMKill

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch06 Configuration | ⬅️ Lab 18


🎯 Mục Tiêu

requests vs limits behaviour
CPU throttle vs Memory OOMKill
LimitRange namespace defaults


Bước 1: OOMKill Demo
cat > stress-test.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: stress-test
spec:
  containers:
  - name: stress
    image: polinux/stress
    command: ["stress"]
    args: ["--vm", "1", "--vm-bytes", "200M", "--vm-hang", "1"]
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 50Mi
      limits:
        memory: 100Mi    # Limit 100Mi, stress dùng 200Mi → OOMKill!
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f stress-test.yaml
sleep 15
 
kubectl get pod stress-test
# OOMKilled hoặc CrashLoopBackOff
 
kubectl describe pod stress-test | grep -A 3 "Last State"
# Reason: OOMKilled, Exit Code: 137
 
kubectl delete pod stress-test
rm -f stress-test.yaml

💡 CPU vs Memory Exceed Limit:




















ResourceExceed behaviorImpactCPUThrottledChậm lại, KHÔNG killMemoryOOMKilledContainer bị KILL (exit 137)
→ Memory limit critical. CPU limit optional (có thể throttle không cần thiết).

✅ Checkpoint

 OOMKilled exit 137


Bước 2: LimitRange
# Verify LimitRange từ Lab 08
kubectl describe limitrange default-limits
 
# Tạo Pod KHÔNG set resources
kubectl run no-res --image=busybox:1.36 --command -- sleep 3600
kubectl describe pod no-res | grep -A 4 "Requests\|Limits"
# Requests/Limits auto-applied từ LimitRange!
 
kubectl delete pod no-res

💡 Resource Best Practices:

requests = guaranteed (Scheduler dùng). Set based on profiling.
limits = maximum. Memory limits quan trọng (OOMKill). CPU limits gây throttle.
LimitRange = safety net cho Pods quên set resources.
ResourceQuota = cap tổng namespace (prevent noisy neighbor).


✅ Checkpoint

 LimitRange auto-apply defaults


🧹 Cleanup
# Giữ deployment podinfo

🎤 Interview Questions

Exit code 137? → 128+9 = SIGKILL. OOMKilled (memory vượt limit).
requests vs limits? → requests: min guaranteed, Scheduler dùng. limits: max allowed, exceed memory → kill, exceed CPU → throttle.
LimitRange vs ResourceQuota? → LimitRange: per-Pod defaults+min/max. ResourceQuota: tổng namespace.


Tiếp: Lab 20: Ephemeral vs Persistent Storage →
⬅️ Lab 18 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/07-storage/20-epheme.title: Lab 20: Ephemeral vs Persistent Storage
02---areas/k8s/labs/07-storage/20-epheme.content:
Lab 20: Ephemeral vs Persistent Storage

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch07 Storage | ⬅️ Lab 19


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Chứng minh container filesystem là ephemeral
Static PV/PVC provisioning
Deploy PostgreSQL với persistent data


Bước 1: Chứng Minh Data Loss
kubectl run postgres-test --image=postgres:16-alpine \
  --env=POSTGRES_PASSWORD=testpass --env=POSTGRES_DB=testdb
 
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/postgres-test --timeout=60s
 
# Insert data
kubectl exec postgres-test -- psql -U postgres -d testdb -c "
CREATE TABLE messages (id SERIAL, content TEXT);
INSERT INTO messages (content) VALUES ('This will disappear!');
SELECT * FROM messages;
"
 
# Delete + recreate
kubectl delete pod postgres-test
kubectl run postgres-test --image=postgres:16-alpine \
  --env=POSTGRES_PASSWORD=testpass --env=POSTGRES_DB=testdb
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/postgres-test --timeout=60s
 
kubectl exec postgres-test -- psql -U postgres -d testdb -c "SELECT * FROM messages;" 2>&1
# ERROR: relation "messages" does not exist → DATA MẤT!
 
kubectl delete pod postgres-test
✅ Checkpoint

 Data mất sau Pod restart


Bước 2: PV/PVC (Static Provisioning)
cat > pv-pvc.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: postgres-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 1Gi
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  hostPath:
    path: /tmp/k8s-postgres
    type: DirectoryOrCreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: postgres-pvc
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f pv-pvc.yaml
 
kubectl get pv
# STATUS: Bound
kubectl get pvc postgres-pvc
# STATUS: Bound

💡 PV = cluster-scoped (admin tạo). PVC = namespace-scoped (dev tạo).
K8s match PVC→PV dựa trên: accessModes + capacity + storageClassName.

✅ Checkpoint

 PV + PVC bound


Bước 3: PostgreSQL Persistent
cat > postgres-persistent.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: postgres
  labels:
    app: postgres
spec:
  containers:
  - name: postgres
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    env:
    - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
      value: "testpass"
    - name: POSTGRES_DB
      value: "testdb"
    - name: PGDATA
      value: "/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata"
    ports:
    - containerPort: 5432
    volumeMounts:
    - name: data
      mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
  volumes:
  - name: data
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: postgres-pvc
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f postgres-persistent.yaml
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/postgres --timeout=60s
 
# Insert data
kubectl exec postgres -- psql -U postgres -d testdb -c "
CREATE TABLE messages (id SERIAL, content TEXT);
INSERT INTO messages (content) VALUES ('PERSISTENT data!');
SELECT * FROM messages;
"
 
# Delete + recreate
kubectl delete pod postgres
kubectl apply -f postgres-persistent.yaml
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/postgres --timeout=60s
 
kubectl exec postgres -- psql -U postgres -d testdb -c "SELECT * FROM messages;"
# DATA VẪN CÒN! ✅
✅ Checkpoint

 Delete/recreate → data persists


🧹 Cleanup
rm -f pv-pvc.yaml
# GIỮ postgres Pod + PV/PVC cho Lab 21

🎤 Interview Questions

PV vs PVC? → PV: admin tạo, cluster-scoped, physical storage. PVC: dev tạo, namespace-scoped, request storage.
Access Modes? → RWO (ReadWriteOnce = 1 Node). ROX (ReadOnlyMany). RWX (ReadWriteMany). Không phải all storage support all modes.
PVC Pending? → Không có PV match: capacity, accessMode, storageClassName. describe pvc → Events.


Tiếp: Lab 21: StorageClass & Dynamic Provisioning →
⬅️ Lab 19 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/07-storage/21-storag.title: Lab 21: StorageClass & Dynamic Provisioning
02---areas/k8s/labs/07-storage/21-storag.content:
Lab 21: StorageClass & Dynamic Provisioning

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch07 StorageClass | ⬅️ Lab 20


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Install StorageClass (local-path-provisioner)
Dynamic provisioning: PVC → auto PV
Reclaim Policy: Retain vs Delete


Bước 1: Install StorageClass
kubectl apply -f raw.githubusercontent.com/rancher/local-path-provisioner/v0.0.30/deploy/local-path-storage.yaml
 
kubectl get pods -n local-path-storage
# local-path-provisioner-xxx   Running
 
kubectl get storageclass
# local-path   rancher.io/local-path   Delete
 
# Set default
kubectl patch storageclass local-path \
  -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class":"true"}}}'
✅ Checkpoint

 StorageClass installed, default set


Bước 2: Dynamic Provisioning
cat > dynamic-pvc.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: dynamic-pvc
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  storageClassName: local-path
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 2Gi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f dynamic-pvc.yaml
 
# PV tạo TỰ ĐỘNG!
kubectl get pvc dynamic-pvc
# Bound!
 
kubectl get pv | grep dynamic
# pvc-<uuid>   2Gi   RWO   Delete   Bound
 
# Test
kubectl run dyn-test --image=busybox:1.36 --command -- sh -c \
  'echo "Dynamic PV works!" > /data/test.txt && cat /data/test.txt && sleep 3600' \
  --overrides='{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"dyn-test","command":["sh","-c","echo Dynamic PV works > /data/test.txt && cat /data/test.txt && sleep 3600"],"volumeMounts":[{"name":"data","mountPath":"/data"}]}],"volumes":[{"name":"data","persistentVolumeClaim":{"claimName":"dynamic-pvc"}}]}}'
 
sleep 5
kubectl logs dyn-test
# Dynamic PV works!
 
kubectl delete pod dyn-test

💡 Static vs Dynamic:

























StaticDynamicPV creationAdmin thủ côngStorageClass tự độngScalable❌ Admin bottleneck✅ Self-serviceUse caseBare-metal NFSCloud, local-path

✅ Checkpoint

 PVC → PV auto-created


Bước 3: Reclaim Policy
# Delete policy: PVC xóa → PV + data bị xóa
kubectl delete pvc dynamic-pvc
kubectl get pv | grep dynamic
# (gone!) → Data deleted
 
# Retain policy: PVC xóa → PV Released → data giữ
kubectl get pv postgres-pv
# persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
 
# 💡 Production databases: luôn dùng Retain
# Dev/test: Delete OK (auto cleanup)
 
rm -f dynamic-pvc.yaml

💡 Reclaim Policies:




















PolicyPVC xóa →Use caseDeletePV + data xóaDev, cloudRetainPV Released, data giữProduction DBs

✅ Checkpoint

 Delete → data gone. Retain → data kept.


🧹 Cleanup
# Giữ StorageClass, postgres cho Lab 22

🎤 Interview Questions

Dynamic provisioning? → PVC tạo → StorageClass provision PV tự động. Không cần admin tạo PV.
Retain vs Delete? → Retain: PVC xóa, PV + data giữ (Released status). Delete: PV + data xóa.
Default StorageClass? → Annotation storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true". PVC không chỉ định → dùng default.


Tiếp: Lab 22: StatefulSet With Storage →
⬅️ Lab 20 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/07-storage/22-statef.title: Lab 22: StatefulSet With Storage
02---areas/k8s/labs/07-storage/22-statef.content:
Lab 22: StatefulSet With Storage

🕐 20 phút | 📖 Ch07 Storage | ⬅️ Lab 21


🎯 Mục Tiêu

volumeClaimTemplates — auto PVC per replica
Data persistence qua Pod delete
PVC lifecycle khi scale


Bước 1: Upgrade Redis Với Storage
# Delete Redis cũ (Lab 11)
kubectl delete statefulset redis --ignore-not-found
 
cat > redis-storage.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis
spec:
  serviceName: redis-headless
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: redis
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 6379
        volumeMounts:
        - name: redis-data
          mountPath: /data
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: redis-data
    spec:
      accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
      storageClassName: local-path
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 1Gi
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f redis-storage.yaml
sleep 30
 
# Mỗi Pod có PVC riêng!
kubectl get pvc
# redis-data-redis-0   Bound
# redis-data-redis-1   Bound
# redis-data-redis-2   Bound
✅ Checkpoint

 PVC naming: <template>-<pod> = redis-data-redis-0


Bước 2: Data Persistence
# Write data
kubectl exec redis-0 -- redis-cli SET mykey "persistent-data"
kubectl exec redis-0 -- redis-cli GET mykey
 
# Delete Pod
kubectl delete pod redis-0
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/redis-0 --timeout=60s
 
# Data vẫn còn!
kubectl exec redis-0 -- redis-cli GET mykey
# "persistent-data" ✅
 
# Mỗi Pod có data riêng
kubectl exec redis-1 -- redis-cli GET mykey
# (nil) ← riêng biệt
✅ Checkpoint

 Delete Pod → PVC re-attach → data intact


Bước 3: Scale & PVC
# Scale down
kubectl scale statefulset redis --replicas=1
sleep 10
 
# PVC KHÔNG xóa! (data protection)
kubectl get pvc
# redis-data-redis-0   Bound
# redis-data-redis-1   Bound   ← vẫn còn!
# redis-data-redis-2   Bound   ← vẫn còn!
 
# Scale up → re-attach PVCs cũ!
kubectl scale statefulset redis --replicas=3
sleep 20

💡 PVC lifecycle: Scale down → PVC giữ. Scale up → re-attach PVC cũ → data recovered!
Xóa PVC thủ công: kubectl delete pvc redis-data-redis-2

✅ Checkpoint

 Scale down: PVC giữ. Scale up: re-attach.


🧹 Cleanup
rm -f redis-storage.yaml
# Giữ redis, postgres cho labs tiếp

🎤 Interview Questions

volumeClaimTemplates? → Auto-create PVC per StatefulSet replica. Naming: <template>-<pod-name>.
PVC khi StatefulSet delete? → KHÔNG xóa. Data protection by design. Cần kubectl delete pvc thủ công.
Scale down → data? → PVC giữ. Scale up lại → PVC re-attach. Data safe.


Tiếp: Lab 23: Liveness, Readiness & Startup →
⬅️ Lab 21 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/08-ha-scaling/23-liv.title: Lab 23: Liveness, Readiness & Startup Probes
02---areas/k8s/labs/08-ha-scaling/23-liv.content:
Lab 23: Liveness, Readiness & Startup Probes

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch08 HA | ⬅️ Lab 22


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Implement 3 probe types
Test self-healing khi probe fail
Service endpoint impact


Bước 1: Thêm Probes Cho podinfo
kubectl patch deployment podinfo --type=json -p='[
  {"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe","value":{"httpGet":{"path":"/healthz","port":9898},"initialDelaySeconds":1,"periodSeconds":3,"failureThreshold":10}},
  {"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe","value":{"httpGet":{"path":"/healthz","port":9898},"initialDelaySeconds":5,"periodSeconds":10,"failureThreshold":3,"timeoutSeconds":3}},
  {"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe","value":{"httpGet":{"path":"/readyz","port":9898},"initialDelaySeconds":3,"periodSeconds":5,"failureThreshold":2,"successThreshold":1,"timeoutSeconds":2}}
]'
 
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
 
kubectl describe deployment podinfo | grep -A 3 "Startup\|Liveness\|Readiness"

💡 3 Probe Types:

























ProbeFail → ActionUse caseStartupKill containerSlow-starting apps (Java)LivenessRestart containerDeadlock, hung processReadinessRemove from ServiceLoading data, warming cache
Startup pass → enable Liveness + Readiness

✅ Checkpoint

 3 probes configured


Bước 2: Test Readiness → Service Impact
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
 
# Disable readiness
kubectl exec $POD -- wget -qO- --post-data="" http://localhost:9898/readyz/disable
 
sleep 15
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo
# Pod: READY 0/1 → removed from Service!
 
kubectl get endpoints podinfo-svc
# Missing 1 Pod IP (not ready)
 
# Re-enable
kubectl exec $POD -- wget -qO- --post-data="" http://localhost:9898/readyz/enable
sleep 10
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo
# READY 1/1 → back in Service
✅ Checkpoint

 Not Ready → removed from endpoints → no traffic
 Ready again → back in endpoints


🧹 Cleanup
# Probes giữ cho production

🎤 Interview Questions

Liveness vs Readiness? → Liveness fail: RESTART. Readiness fail: REMOVE from Service. Actions khác nhau!
Startup probe tại sao? → Chống liveness kill Pod đang khởi động. Java/Spring mất 30-60s start.
Tất cả Pods not Ready? → Service endpoints empty → 503. Cần debug readiness endpoint/dependencies.


Tiếp: Lab 24: HPA Autoscaling →
⬅️ Lab 22 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/08-ha-scaling/24-hpa.title: Lab 24: HPA Autoscaling
02---areas/k8s/labs/08-ha-scaling/24-hpa.content:
Lab 24: HPA Autoscaling

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch08 HA | ⬅️ Lab 23


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Tạo HPA dựa trên CPU
Load test → watch scale up
Scale down stabilization


Bước 1: Tạo HPA
cat > podinfo-hpa.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: podinfo-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: podinfo
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 50
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 0
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f podinfo-hpa.yaml
 
kubectl get hpa
# TARGETS: xx%/50%   MINPODS: 2   MAXPODS: 10

💡 HPA Formula: desiredReplicas = ceil(currentReplicas × currentMetric/targetMetric)
Ví dụ: 2 Pods × (80%/50%) = 3.2 → 4 Pods

✅ Checkpoint

 HPA configured, targets visible


Bước 2: Load Test
# Watch
kubectl get hpa -w &
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo -w &
 
# Generate load
kubectl run loadtest --image=busybox:1.36 --rm -i -- sh -c '
  echo "Starting load..."
  while true; do
    wget -qO- http://podinfo-svc > /dev/null 2>&1 &
    wget -qO- http://podinfo-svc > /dev/null 2>&1 &
    wget -qO- http://podinfo-svc > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  done
'
# Ctrl+C sau 2-3 phút
 
# Watch: CPU > 50% → scale up!
sleep 10
kill %1 %2 2>/dev/null
 
# After load stops → wait 60s stabilization → scale down
kubectl get hpa
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo
✅ Checkpoint

 Load → scale up tự động
 Load dừng → scale down sau stabilization


🧹 Cleanup
rm -f podinfo-hpa.yaml
# Giữ HPA

🎤 Interview Questions

HPA TARGETS <unknown>? → Metrics Server missing, hoặc Pod không set resource requests.
HPA check frequency? → Default 15 giây. Config: --horizontal-pod-autoscaler-sync-period.
Stabilization window? → Chống flapping. Scale down chờ N giây sau khi metric giảm. Tránh scale up/down liên tục.


Tiếp: Lab 25: PDB & Topology Spread →
⬅️ Lab 23 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/08-ha-scaling/25-pdb.title: Lab 25: PDB & Topology Spread
02---areas/k8s/labs/08-ha-scaling/25-pdb.content:
Lab 25: PDB & Topology Spread

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch08 HA | ⬅️ Lab 24


🎯 Mục Tiêu

PDB bảo vệ availability khi drain
Topology Spread phân bố Pods đều


Bước 1: PodDisruptionBudget
cat > podinfo-pdb.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: podinfo-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: podinfo
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f podinfo-pdb.yaml
 
kubectl get pdb
# MIN AVAILABLE: 2   ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS: N
 
# Test: drain → PDB bảo vệ
WORKER=$(kubectl get nodes --selector='!node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane' -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl drain $WORKER --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data 2>&1 | head -10
# PDB sẽ rate-limit eviction: luôn giữ ≥2 Pods
 
kubectl uncordon $WORKER

💡 PDB chỉ protect voluntary disruptions: drain, kubectl delete (eviction API).
KHÔNG protect: node crash, OOMKill, liveness fail.

✅ Checkpoint

 PDB limits evictions during drain


Bước 2: Topology Spread
kubectl patch deployment podinfo --type=json -p='[
  {"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/topologySpreadConstraints","value":[{"maxSkew":1,"topologyKey":"kubernetes.io/hostname","whenUnsatisfiable":"DoNotSchedule","labelSelector":{"matchLabels":{"app":"podinfo"}}}]}
]'
 
kubectl rollout status deployment/podinfo
 
# Verify Pods spread đều
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo -o wide
kubectl get pods -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.nodeName}{"\n"}{end}' | sort | uniq -c
# Balanced across Nodes ✓

💡 maxSkew=1: Chênh lệch tối đa 1 Pod giữa Nodes. Node crash → chỉ mất ~50% Pods.

✅ Checkpoint

 Pods balanced across Nodes


🧹 Cleanup
rm -f podinfo-pdb.yaml
# Giữ PDB + topology spread

🎤 Interview Questions

PDB minAvailable vs maxUnavailable? → minAvailable: luôn giữ ≥N. maxUnavailable: cho phép ≤N down. Cùng effect, cách diễn đạt khác.
maxSkew=1? → Max 1 Pod chênh lệch giữa 2 topology domains. Đảm bảo balanced distribution.
whenUnsatisfiable? → DoNotSchedule: Pending nếu không spread được (strict). ScheduleAnyway: try nhưng không guarantee (soft).


Tiếp: Lab 26: RBAC & ServiceAccount →
⬅️ Lab 24 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/09-security/26-rbac-.title: Lab 26: RBAC & ServiceAccount
02---areas/k8s/labs/09-security/26-rbac-.content:
Lab 26: RBAC & ServiceAccount

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch09 Security | ⬅️ Lab 25


🎯 Mục Tiêu

ServiceAccount + Role + RoleBinding
ClusterRole + ClusterRoleBinding
kubectl auth can-i
Disable token auto-mount


Bước 1: Namespace RBAC
cat > rbac.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: dev-user
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: developer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods", "pods/log"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch"]
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["services"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: dev-binding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: dev-user
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: developer
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f rbac.yaml
 
# Test
kubectl auth can-i get pods --as system:serviceaccount:dev:dev-user        # yes
kubectl auth can-i create deployments --as system:serviceaccount:dev:dev-user # yes
kubectl auth can-i delete pods --as system:serviceaccount:dev:dev-user      # no
kubectl auth can-i get secrets --as system:serviceaccount:dev:dev-user      # no
kubectl auth can-i get pods -n default --as system:serviceaccount:dev:dev-user # no (khác namespace!)

💡 RBAC: WHO (Subject) → WHAT (Role rules) → WHERE (Binding scope)

✅ Checkpoint

 dev-user: get pods ✅, delete pods ❌, get secrets ❌


Bước 2: ClusterRole
cat > cluster-rbac.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: cluster-viewer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods", "services", "nodes", "namespaces"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments", "statefulsets", "daemonsets"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: viewer-binding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: dev-user
  namespace: dev
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: cluster-viewer
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f cluster-rbac.yaml
 
kubectl auth can-i get nodes --as system:serviceaccount:dev:dev-user  # yes!
kubectl auth can-i get pods -n default --as system:serviceaccount:dev:dev-user  # yes!
kubectl auth can-i create pods -n default --as system:serviceaccount:dev:dev-user  # no (read only)

💡 Role vs ClusterRole:




















RoleClusterRoleScope1 namespaceEntire clusterCluster resources❌✅ (nodes, PVs)

✅ Checkpoint

 ClusterRole: xem across namespaces + nodes


Bước 3: Disable Token Auto-Mount
# Pods không cần API access → disable token
kubectl run secure-pod --image=busybox:1.36 --command -- sleep 3600 \
  --overrides='{"spec":{"automountServiceAccountToken":false}}'
 
kubectl exec secure-pod -- ls /var/run/secrets/ 2>&1
# No such file → No token! ✅
 
kubectl delete pod secure-pod
✅ Checkpoint

 automountServiceAccountToken: false → no token mounted


🧹 Cleanup
rm -f rbac.yaml cluster-rbac.yaml
# Giữ RBAC resources

🎤 Interview Questions

Role vs ClusterRole? → Role: 1 namespace. ClusterRole: cluster-wide + cluster resources (nodes, PVs).
Debug RBAC 403? → kubectl auth can-i <verb> <resource> --as <sa> → find missing rule → add to Role.
automountServiceAccountToken? → Disable cho Pods không cần K8s API access. Least privilege principle.


Tiếp: Lab 27: Network Policies →
⬅️ Lab 25 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/09-security/27-netwo.title: Lab 27: Network Policies
02---areas/k8s/labs/09-security/27-netwo.content:
Lab 27: Network Policies

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch09 Security | ⬅️ Lab 26


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Default deny all traffic
Allow specific ingress/egress
DNS exception


Prerequisites

⚠️ NetworkPolicy cần CNI support: Calico ✅, Cilium ✅, Flannel ❌


Bước 1: Test Trước NetworkPolicy
# Tạo backend test
kubectl create deployment backend --image=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1 --replicas=1
kubectl expose deployment backend --port=80 --target-port=9898 --name=backend-svc
 
# Ai cũng access được!
kubectl run test --image=curlimages/curl --rm -it -- \
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://backend-svc
# 200 OK → INSECURE!
✅ Checkpoint

 Trước policy: mọi Pod access backend


Bước 2: Default Deny + Allow Rules
cat > netpol.yaml << 'EOF'
# Default deny ALL ingress
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-ingress
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
---
# Default deny ALL egress (nhưng allow DNS!)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-egress
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector: {}
    ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 53
---
# Allow podinfo → backend trên port 9898
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-podinfo-to-backend
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: podinfo
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 9898
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f netpol.yaml
✅ Checkpoint

 Policies created


Bước 3: Test
# Random Pod → backend → DENIED!
kubectl run test --image=curlimages/curl --rm -it -- \
  curl -s --connect-timeout 3 http://backend-svc 2>&1
# Timeout!
 
# podinfo → backend → ALLOWED!
PODINFO_POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl exec $PODINFO_POD -- wget -qO- --timeout=3 http://backend-svc
# 200 OK ✓

💡 Zero Trust Pattern:
1. Default deny ALL
2. Allow DNS (essential)
3. Allow specific: frontend→backend, backend→database


✅ Checkpoint

 Random Pod: DENIED. podinfo: ALLOWED.


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete deployment backend
kubectl delete svc backend-svc
kubectl delete networkpolicy --all
rm -f netpol.yaml

🎤 Interview Questions

Default behavior? → No NetworkPolicy = all traffic allowed. First policy on a Pod → implicit deny for unmatched.
DNS exception? → Egress deny blocks DNS too! Must allow UDP/TCP 53 to kube-dns.
NetworkPolicy CNI? → Needs CNI support. Calico, Cilium: ✅. Flannel: ❌.


Tiếp: Lab 28: Pod Security Standards →
⬅️ Lab 26 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/09-security/28-pod-s.title: Lab 28: Pod Security Standards
02---areas/k8s/labs/09-security/28-pod-s.content:
Lab 28: Pod Security Standards

🕐 20 phút | 📖 Ch09 Security | ⬅️ Lab 27


🎯 Mục Tiêu

3 PSS levels: Privileged, Baseline, Restricted
Enforce restricted namespace
Secure Pod template


Bước 1: Restricted Namespace
cat > restricted-ns.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: restricted-test
  labels:
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f restricted-ns.yaml
 
# Insecure Pod → REJECTED!
kubectl run insecure --image=nginx -n restricted-test 2>&1
# Error: violate PodSecurity "restricted"
✅ Checkpoint

 Restricted namespace rejects insecure Pods


Bước 2: Secure Pod Template
cat > secure-pod.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: secure-pod
  namespace: restricted-test
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 1000
    runAsGroup: 1000
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
  containers:
  - name: podinfo
    image: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
    ports:
    - containerPort: 9898
    securityContext:
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      capabilities:
        drop: ["ALL"]
    volumeMounts:
    - name: tmp
      mountPath: /tmp
  volumes:
  - name: tmp
    emptyDir: {}
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f secure-pod.yaml
kubectl get pod secure-pod -n restricted-test
# Running ✓

💡 PSS Levels:

























LevelRestrictionsUse casePrivilegedNoneSystem (DaemonSets)BaselineBlock dangerousDefault appsRestrictedFull hardeningSensitive workloads
Restricted requires: runAsNonRoot, no privilege escalation, drop ALL caps, seccomp, readOnlyRootFilesystem.

✅ Checkpoint

 Secure Pod passes restricted enforcement


🧹 Cleanup
kubectl delete namespace restricted-test
rm -f restricted-ns.yaml secure-pod.yaml

🎤 Interview Questions

3 PSS levels? → Privileged (no restrictions), Baseline (block known dangerous), Restricted (full hardening).
enforce vs warn vs audit? → enforce: block. warn: allow + warn message. audit: allow + log.
readOnlyRootFilesystem? → Container cannot write to filesystem. Need emptyDir for /tmp, /var.


Tiếp: Lab 29: Prometheus & Grafana →
⬅️ Lab 27 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/10-observability/29-.title: Lab 29: Prometheus & Grafana
02---areas/k8s/labs/10-observability/29-.content:
Lab 29: Prometheus & Grafana

🕐 30 phút | 📖 Ch10 Observability | ⬅️ Lab 28


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Deploy kube-prometheus-stack (Helm)
ServiceMonitor cho podinfo
Grafana dashboards
kubectl logs patterns


Bước 1: Install Monitoring Stack
helm repo add prometheus-community prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
helm repo update
 
helm install monitoring prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack \
  --namespace monitoring --create-namespace \
  --set grafana.adminPassword=admin123 \
  --set prometheus.prometheusSpec.serviceMonitorSelectorNilUsesHelmValues=false \
  --wait --timeout 5m
 
kubectl get pods -n monitoring
# prometheus, grafana, alertmanager, node-exporter, kube-state-metrics

💡 Stack Components:





























ComponentVai tròPrometheusScrape & store metricsGrafanaDashboardsAlertManagerAlert routingkube-state-metricsK8s object metricsnode-exporterNode metrics (per-Node DaemonSet)

✅ Checkpoint

 Tất cả Pods running trong monitoring namespace


Bước 2: ServiceMonitor
cat > podinfo-monitor.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: podinfo
  namespace: dev
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: podinfo
  endpoints:
  - port: http
    path: /metrics
    interval: 15s
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f podinfo-monitor.yaml
 
# Verify metrics
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl exec $POD -- wget -qO- localhost:9898/metrics | head -10
✅ Checkpoint

 ServiceMonitor tạo, podinfo expose /metrics


Bước 3: Access Grafana
kubectl port-forward svc/monitoring-grafana -n monitoring 3000:80 &
echo "Grafana: http://localhost:3000 (admin/admin123)"
 
# Pre-loaded dashboards:
# - Kubernetes / Compute Resources / Cluster
# - Kubernetes / Compute Resources / Namespace (Pods)
# - Node Exporter / Nodes
 
kill %1 2>/dev/null
✅ Checkpoint

 Grafana accessible, dashboards visible


Bước 4: kubectl logs Patterns
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=podinfo -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
 
kubectl logs $POD                    # All logs
kubectl logs $POD --tail=20          # Last 20 lines
kubectl logs $POD --since=10m        # Last 10 min
kubectl logs $POD -f                 # Follow (Ctrl+C)
kubectl logs $POD --previous         # Previous container (crash)
kubectl logs -l app=podinfo --max-log-requests=10  # All Pods by label
kubectl logs -l app=podinfo --prefix # With Pod name prefix
 
# Events
kubectl get events --sort-by='.lastTimestamp'
kubectl get events --field-selector type=Warning
✅ Checkpoint

 Log patterns: —tail, —since, —previous, -l selector


🧹 Cleanup
rm -f podinfo-monitor.yaml
# Giữ monitoring stack

🎤 Interview Questions

Prometheus scrape vs push? → Prometheus PULL từ targets (scrape /metrics). ServiceMonitor auto-configure targets.
Previous container logs? → kubectl logs --previous cho lần crash gần nhất. Production: ship logs tới ELK/Loki trước khi mất.
Metrics Server vs Prometheus? → Metrics Server: basic CPU/Memory cho HPA + kubectl top. Prometheus: full metrics, PromQL, long-term storage.


Tiếp: Lab 30: PromQL & Custom Alerts →
⬅️ Lab 28 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/10-observability/30-.title: Lab 30: PromQL & Custom Alerts
02---areas/k8s/labs/10-observability/30-.content:
Lab 30: PromQL & Custom Alerts

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch10 Observability | ⬅️ Lab 29


🎯 Mục Tiêu

PromQL queries thực hành
Tạo custom PrometheusRule
Hiểu alert lifecycle


Bước 1: PromQL Queries
kubectl port-forward svc/prometheus-operated -n monitoring 9090:9090 &
echo "Prometheus: http://localhost:9090"
Queries thực hành tại Prometheus UI:
# 1. Raw counter
http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="dev"}
 
# 2. Rate (requests/second)
rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="dev"}[5m])
 
# 3. Sum across Pods
sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="dev"}[5m]))
 
# 4. P95 latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="dev"}[5m]))
 
# 5. Memory usage
container_memory_usage_bytes{namespace="dev", container="podinfo"}
 
# 6. CPU usage
rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="dev", container="podinfo"}[5m])
 
# 7. Pod restarts
kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="dev"}
 
# 8. Available replicas
kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="dev"}
 
# 9. Sum by Pod
sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="dev"}[5m])) by (pod)
 
# 10. Total requests last hour
increase(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="dev"}[1h])

💡 PromQL Cheat Sheet:





























FunctionDùng khirate()Per-second rate (counters)increase()Total increase in windowsum()Aggregate across labelshistogram_quantile()Percentiles (p50, p95, p99)by()Group by label

kill %1 2>/dev/null
✅ Checkpoint

 10 PromQL queries thực hành


Bước 2: Custom AlertRule
cat > podinfo-alerts.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: PrometheusRule
metadata:
  name: podinfo-alerts
  namespace: dev
  labels:
    release: monitoring
spec:
  groups:
  - name: podinfo.rules
    rules:
    - alert: PodinfoHighRestartRate
      expr: increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="dev", container="podinfo"}[1h]) > 3
      for: 5m
      labels:
        severity: warning
      annotations:
        summary: "Pod {{ $labels.pod }} restarting frequently"
 
    - alert: PodinfoReplicasMismatch
      expr: |
        kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="dev", deployment="podinfo"}
        != kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="dev", deployment="podinfo"}
      for: 5m
      labels:
        severity: critical
      annotations:
        summary: "podinfo replicas not matching desired"
EOF
 
kubectl apply -f podinfo-alerts.yaml
 
# Verify
kubectl port-forward svc/prometheus-operated -n monitoring 9090:9090 &
echo "Check alerts: http://localhost:9090/alerts"
sleep 3
kill %1 2>/dev/null

💡 Alert Anatomy: expr (PromQL condition) + for (duration must be true) + severity + annotations.

✅ Checkpoint

 Custom alerts visible in Prometheus


🧹 Cleanup
rm -f podinfo-alerts.yaml
# Giữ monitoring

🎤 Interview Questions

rate() vs increase()? → rate: per-second average. increase: total in window. rate(x[5m])×300 = increase(x[5m]).
PrometheusRule labels? → Must match Prometheus ruleSelector. kube-prometheus-stack default: release: monitoring.
Alert for field? → Condition must be true for this duration before firing. Prevents flapping alerts.


Tiếp: Lab 31: Helm Chart Creation →
⬅️ Lab 29 | 📋 Labs Overview

02---areas/k8s/labs/11-production/31-hel.title: Lab 31: Helm Chart Creation
02---areas/k8s/labs/11-production/31-hel.content:
Lab 31: Helm Chart Creation

🕐 30 phút | 📖 Ch11 Production | ⬅️ Lab 30


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Tạo Helm chart từ scratch
Templates + values.yaml
Helm hooks (pre-upgrade)
Install & verify


Bước 1: Chart Skeleton
mkdir -p /tmp/k8s-lab31
cd /tmp/k8s-lab31
helm create podinfo-chart
 
# Xem structure
find podinfo-chart -type f | head -15
✅ Checkpoint

 Chart skeleton tạo thành công


Bước 2: Custom values.yaml
cat > podinfo-chart/values.yaml << 'EOF'
replicaCount: 3
image:
  repository: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo
  tag: "6.7.1"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
nameOverride: "podinfo"
fullnameOverride: "podinfo"
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 80
  targetPort: 9898
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 64Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 256Mi
autoscaling:
  enabled: true
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 70
pdb:
  enabled: true
  minAvailable: 2
env:
  PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE: "Production"
  PODINFO_UI_COLOR: "#4CAF50"
EOF

Bước 3: Deployment Template
cat > podinfo-chart/templates/deployment.yaml << 'TEMPLATE'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "podinfo-chart.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "podinfo-chart.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  {{- if not .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  {{- end }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "podinfo-chart.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "podinfo-chart.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
        ports:
        - containerPort: {{ .Values.service.targetPort }}
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 10 }}
        env:
        {{- range $key, $value := .Values.env }}
        - name: {{ $key }}
          value: {{ $value | quote }}
        {{- end }}
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: {{ .Values.service.targetPort }}
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /readyz
            port: {{ .Values.service.targetPort }}
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir: {}
TEMPLATE

Bước 4: PDB + Hook Templates
# PDB
cat > podinfo-chart/templates/pdb.yaml << 'TEMPLATE'
{{- if .Values.pdb.enabled }}
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: {{ include "podinfo-chart.fullname" . }}
spec:
  minAvailable: {{ .Values.pdb.minAvailable }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "podinfo-chart.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
{{- end }}
TEMPLATE
 
# Pre-upgrade hook
cat > podinfo-chart/templates/pre-upgrade-hook.yaml << 'TEMPLATE'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "podinfo-chart.fullname" . }}-pre-upgrade
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": pre-upgrade
    "helm.sh/hook-weight": "0"
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": hook-succeeded
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: migrate
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "Running migration at $(date)"; sleep 3; echo "Done!"']
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 32Mi
TEMPLATE

Bước 5: Install
# Dry-run
helm template podinfo-chart ./podinfo-chart | head -60
 
# Install
kubectl create namespace helm-demo
helm install podinfo ./podinfo-chart -n helm-demo --wait
 
# Verify
kubectl get all -n helm-demo
helm list -n helm-demo
helm get values podinfo -n helm-demo
✅ Checkpoint

 Helm install thành công
 Deployment, Service, PDB, HPA created


🧹 Cleanup
# Giữ chart + namespace cho Lab 32

🎤 Interview Questions

Helm chart structure? → Chart.yaml (metadata), values.yaml (defaults), templates/ (Go templates). helm install = render + apply.
Helm hook? → Job/Pod chạy tại specific lifecycle point (pre-install, pre-upgrade, post-delete). Dùng cho migrations, cleanup.
Helm vs kubectl apply? → Helm: versioned releases, rollback, values management, hooks. kubectl: raw YAML, no versioning.

02---areas/k8s/labs/11-production/32-mul.title: Lab 32: Multi-Environment Deploy
02---areas/k8s/labs/11-production/32-mul.content:
Lab 32: Multi-Environment Deploy

🕐 25 phút | 📖 Ch11 Production | ⬅️ Lab 31


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Deploy 1 chart lên 3 environments
Helm upgrade, rollback, history
Values override priority


Bước 1: Values Files Per Environment
cd /tmp/k8s-lab31
 
cat > podinfo-chart/values-dev.yaml << 'EOF'
replicaCount: 1
autoscaling:
  enabled: false
pdb:
  enabled: false
env:
  PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE: "DEV"
  PODINFO_UI_COLOR: "#FF9800"
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 50m
    memory: 32Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 200m
    memory: 128Mi
EOF
 
cat > podinfo-chart/values-staging.yaml << 'EOF'
replicaCount: 2
autoscaling:
  enabled: true
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 5
pdb:
  enabled: true
  minAvailable: 1
env:
  PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE: "STAGING"
  PODINFO_UI_COLOR: "#2196F3"
EOF

Bước 2: Deploy 3 Environments
kubectl create namespace dev-helm staging-helm
 
helm install podinfo-dev ./podinfo-chart -n dev-helm \
  -f podinfo-chart/values-dev.yaml --wait
 
helm install podinfo-staging ./podinfo-chart -n staging-helm \
  -f podinfo-chart/values-staging.yaml --wait
 
# Compare
echo "=== DEV ===" && kubectl get pods -n dev-helm
echo "=== STAGING ===" && kubectl get pods -n staging-helm
echo "=== PRODUCTION ===" && kubectl get pods -n helm-demo

💡 Values Override Priority:
values.yaml (default) < -f values-staging.yaml < --set key=value


✅ Checkpoint

 Dev: 1 replica. Staging: 2 replicas. Prod: 3 replicas.


Bước 3: Helm Lifecycle
# Upgrade
helm upgrade podinfo ./podinfo-chart -n helm-demo \
  --set env.PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE="Production v2" --wait
 
# History
helm history podinfo -n helm-demo
 
# Rollback
helm rollback podinfo 1 -n helm-demo
 
# Get values/manifests
helm get values podinfo -n helm-demo
helm get manifest podinfo -n helm-demo | head -30
✅ Checkpoint

 Upgrade, history, rollback


🧹 Cleanup
helm uninstall podinfo -n helm-demo
helm uninstall podinfo-dev -n dev-helm
helm uninstall podinfo-staging -n staging-helm
kubectl delete namespace helm-demo dev-helm staging-helm
rm -rf /tmp/k8s-lab31

🎤 Interview Questions

Multi-env deploy? → 1 chart + values-dev/staging/prod files. helm install -f values-staging.yaml.
--set vs -f? → --set overrides everything (highest priority). -f loads from file.
Helm rollback? → helm rollback <release> <revision>. Creates new revision pointing to old config.

02---areas/k8s/labs/11-production/33-tro.title: Lab 33: Troubleshooting Scenarios
02---areas/k8s/labs/11-production/33-tro.content:
Lab 33: Troubleshooting Scenarios

🕐 30 phút | 📖 Ch11 Production | ⬅️ Lab 32


🎯 Mục Tiêu

Debug 5 common scenarios thực hành
Nắm troubleshooting decision tree
Production readiness checklist


Scenario 1: ImagePullBackOff
kubectl create deployment broken --image=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:nonexistent
sleep 10
 
kubectl get pods -l app=broken
# ImagePullBackOff
 
kubectl describe pod -l app=broken | tail -10
# Failed to pull image
 
# Fix
kubectl set image deployment/broken podinfo=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1 2>/dev/null
kubectl delete deployment broken
echo "✅ Root cause: wrong image tag"

Scenario 2: CrashLoopBackOff
kubectl run crasher --image=busybox:1.36 --command -- sh -c "exit 1"
sleep 20
 
kubectl get pods crasher
# CrashLoopBackOff
 
kubectl logs crasher
kubectl logs crasher --previous
kubectl describe pod crasher | grep -A 3 "Last State"
# Exit Code: 1
 
kubectl delete pod crasher
echo "✅ Root cause: command exits with error"

Scenario 3: Pending (Resources)
kubectl run toobig --image=busybox:1.36 --command -- sleep 3600 \
  --overrides='{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"toobig","command":["sleep","3600"],"resources":{"requests":{"cpu":"100","memory":"500Gi"}}}]}}'
sleep 5
 
kubectl get pod toobig
# Pending
 
kubectl describe pod toobig | tail -5
# insufficient cpu, insufficient memory
 
kubectl delete pod toobig
echo "✅ Root cause: excessive resource requests"

Scenario 4: Readiness Failure
kubectl create deployment readiness-test --image=ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
kubectl set env deployment/readiness-test PODINFO_UI_MESSAGE="test"
sleep 10
 
POD=$(kubectl get pod -l app=readiness-test -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
 
# Simulate readiness failure
kubectl exec $POD -- wget -qO- --post-data="" http://localhost:9898/readyz/disable
sleep 15
 
kubectl get pods -l app=readiness-test
# READY: 0/1
 
# Fix
kubectl exec $POD -- wget -qO- --post-data="" http://localhost:9898/readyz/enable
sleep 10
kubectl get pods -l app=readiness-test
# READY: 1/1
 
kubectl delete deployment readiness-test
echo "✅ Root cause: readiness probe failing"

Scenario 5: Service No Endpoints
kubectl create service clusterip bad-svc --tcp=80:9898
kubectl get endpoints bad-svc
# <none>
 
# Debug
kubectl describe svc bad-svc | grep Selector
# app=bad-svc (no Pods match!)
 
kubectl delete svc bad-svc
echo "✅ Root cause: selector doesn't match any Pods"

Troubleshooting Decision Tree

💡
Pod not working?
├── kubectl get pods → What's the STATUS?
│   ├── Pending → describe → insufficient resources? taint? PVC?
│   ├── ImagePullBackOff → describe → wrong image/tag? private registry?
│   ├── CrashLoopBackOff → logs + logs --previous → fix command/config
│   ├── Running but not Ready → describe → readiness probe failing?
│   └── OOMKilled → describe → increase memory limits
├── Service not connecting?
│   ├── get endpoints → <none>? → selector mismatch
│   ├── DNS not resolving? → CoreDNS running?
│   └── Timeout? → NetworkPolicy blocking?
└── kubectl get events --field-selector type=Warning



Production Readiness Checklist
✅ Replicas ≥ 2
✅ Liveness + Readiness + Startup probes
✅ Resource requests + limits
✅ SecurityContext (nonroot, readonly, drop caps)
✅ HPA configured
✅ PDB configured
✅ RollingUpdate: maxUnavailable=0
✅ Topology Spread across Nodes
✅ NetworkPolicy: default deny + allow
✅ Monitoring: ServiceMonitor + alerts
✅ Secrets: external management (Vault)
✅ Immutable tags (no :latest)


🏆 Kết Thúc
Bạn đã hoàn thành 33 bài labs — từ Pod đơn giản đến production deployment:
01-02: Pod basics & debugging
03-05: Architecture, scheduling, maintenance
06-08: Namespaces, labels, multi-container
09-13: Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Jobs
14-16: Services, DNS, Ingress
17-19: ConfigMap, Secrets, Resources
20-22: PV/PVC, StorageClass, StatefulSet storage
23-25: Probes, HPA, PDB, topology
26-28: RBAC, NetworkPolicy, PSS
29-30: Prometheus, Grafana, PromQL, alerts
31-33: Helm charts, multi-env, troubleshooting

Next steps: CKA exam prep, contribute to open source, build production clusters!

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: README
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
EX294 Exam Preparations
Repository contains exercises preparing for EX294 exam.
It should be treated as a database of questions but the readers need to keep in mind that none of them was taken from the actual test.
They were created based on the study point available at RedHat’s website
Inspiration
Content present in the repository is inspierd by other people’ sample exams, redhat training exercises and my own invention. Use links below to check them out

Red Hat Training
Ahmed Almasah’s Udemy Course
Blog post at lisenet.com

Infrastructure assumptions
In order to perform the exercises plan of the infrastructure must be established.
What I present is similar to configuration used by RedHat in their course preparing for the exam - RH294.
Look at one of my repositories to save time provisioning the machines on your own and have a cluster that is you can exercise against
Hosts
There are five servers used in total throughout the objectives.
All ansible code should be written and executed from the controller node.
Most of the exercises are targetted at changing configuration of managed host but modification of controller is something that the person preparing for the test should be able to do as well

controller - control node
managed1 - managed node
managed2 - managed node
managed3 - managed node
managed4 - managed node

Network
Access to each host should be possible with use of short name as well as fqdn which is build by concatenating short name with .example.com, e. g. controller.example.com. All of the nodes should have NAT access on top of direct access to each other
Users
Initially, there is a single user created on the servers

root - accessed by password vagrant

Authentication against other servers
Managed nodes can be accessed via ssh from the controller, without password with use of root user
System
All machines were provisioned with RHEL8/CentOS8 system
Requirements

ansible 2.8 - on control node
python3 - on both control and managed
sshd - up and running everywhere

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/01. Ansible Installation and Configuration/exercise.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: exercise
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
1. Ansible Installation and Configuration

Install the ansible package on the control node
Create automation user with devops password, the user should be allowed to execute any command without providing password to the prompt
Create inventory on the control node at /home/automation/plays/inventory. Meet following requirements:

managed1.example.com should be a member of the proxy host group
managed2.example.com should be a member of the webservers host group
managed3.example.com should be a member of the webservers and database host group
managed4.example.com should be a member of the database host group
proxy and webservers belong to group named public


Create a config file at /home/automation/plays/ansible.cfg with following requirements:

priviledged escalation is disabled by default
ansible should manage 8 hosts at a single time
use previously defined inventory file by default
uses /var/log/ansible/execution.log to save information related to playbook execution
roles path should include /home/automation/plays/roles
ensure that priviledge escalation method is set to sudo
do not allow ansible to ask for password when elevating privileges

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/01. Ansible Installation and Configuration/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
1. Ansible Installation and Configuration - Solution
Installing the ansible
yum install -y ansible
Configuring the user account

Create an account

useradd automation

Set password

echo devops | passwd --stdin automation

Allow access to privileged commands

echo "automation ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/automation
Creating inventory

Create directory for the inventory

mkdir -p /home/automation/plays

Create the inventory with following contents

[proxy]
managed1.example.com
 
[webservers]
managed2.example.com
managed3.example.com
 
[database]
managed3.example.com
managed4.example.com
 
[public:children]
webservers
proxy
Save it to /home/automation/plays/inventory
Create the config file with following content
[defaults]
inventory = ./inventory
forks = 8
log_path = /var/log/ansible/execution.log
roles_path = ~/.ansible/roles:/usr/share/ansible/roles:/etc/ansible/roles:/home/automation/plays/roles
 
[privilege_escalation]
become = false
become_ask_pass = false
become_method = sudo
Save it to /home/automation/plays/ansible.cfg
General thoughts
Ensure that you have proper ownership, to restore it call
chown -R automation:automation /home/automation

Do the same for /var/log/ansible directory

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/02. Ad-Hoc Commands/exercise.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: exercise
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
2. Ad-Hoc Commands

Write a script that meets following requirements:

Generates a SSH keypair
Is stored at /home/automation/plays/adhoc
Uses ansible ad-hoc commands
Creates automation user on all inventory hosts, devops is used as its password
Populates SSH key to all inventory hosts, access of automation user to any of them is allowed without password
automation user is allowed to escalate privileges on all inventory hosts without providing password



Ensure that the script works properly when automation user executes it

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/02. Ad-Hoc Commands/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
2. Ad-Hoc Commands - Solution
Here is how the script might look like
#!/usr/bin/bash
 
# Create the directory for ssh keys
ansible localhost -m file -a 'path=/home/automation/.ssh state=directory'
# Generate the keypair
ansible localhost -m openssh_keypair -a "path=/home/automation/.ssh/id_rsa owner=automation group=automation type=rsa"
# Create the user, calling it with sudo will avoid host key checking
sudo ansible all -m user -a "name=automation password={{ 'devops' | password_hash('sha512', 'salt')}}"
# Share public key with rest of the nodes, inventory is taken from the previous exercise
sudo ansible all -m authorized_key -a "key={{ lookup('file', '/home/automation/.ssh/id_rsa.pub') }} user=automation"
# Allow passwordless sudo
sudo ansible all -m copy -a 'content="automation ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" dest=/etc/sudoers.d/automation'
HOSTS=$(ansible all --list-hosts | sed '1d')
# Make the hosts known
for HOST in $HOSTS
do
  KEY=$(ssh-keyscan -t rsa $HOST 2>/dev/null)
  ansible localhost -m known_hosts -a "key='${KEY}' name=$HOST path=/home/automation/.ssh/known_hosts" -b
done
Place it at /home/automation/plays/adhoc, don’t forget to make it executeable
chmod 755 /home/automation/plays/adhoc

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/03. Archiving/exercise.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: exercise
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
3. Archiving

Create a playbook that meets following requirements:

Creates a gzip archive containing /etc and stores it at /backup/configuration.gz on the managed hosts
Is placed at /home/automation/plays/archive.yml
Runs against all host group
Retrieves archives from the managed nodes and stores them at /backup/<hostname>-configuration.gz on the control node
User automation should be owner of /backup and everything underneath. Both on the managed hosts and the control node. Only owner and members of his group should be able to read and manage files inside. Anyone should be allowed to list contents of /backup.

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/03. Archiving/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
3. Archiving - Solution
The playbook might look as follows:
---
- name: Create directory for archives
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Create folder for the archives
    file:
      path: /backup
      owner: automation
      group: automation
      state: directory
      mode: 0755
- name: Archive config files
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Create folder for the archive
    file:
      path: /backup
      owner: automation
      group: automation
      state: directory
      mode: 0755
  - name: Create the archive
    archive:
      dest: /backup/configuration.gz
      format: gz
      path: /etc
      owner: automation
      group: automation
      mode: 0660
  - name: Fetch the archive
    fetch:
      src: /backup/configuration.gz
      dest: /backup/{{ ansible_hostname }}-configuration.gz                                         
      owner: automation
      group: automation
      mode: 0660
...
To run it call
ansible-playbook archive.yml

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/04. Group differentiation/exercise.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: exercise

4. Group differentiation

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
6. Text Manipulation - Solution
The playbook might look as follows:
---
- name: Configure sshd
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    config_path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
  tasks: 
  - name: Disallow X11 forwarding
    lineinfile:
      regexp: '^X11Forwarding.*'
      path: "{{ config_path }}"
      line: X11Forwarding no
    notify: Restart the service
  - name: Set max auth tries
    lineinfile:
      regexp: '^MaxAuthTries.*'
      line: MaxAuthTries 3
      path: "{{ config_path }}"
    notify: Restart the service
  handlers:
  - name: Restart the service
    service:
      name: sshd
      state: restarted
...
To run it execute
ansible-playbook ssh_config.yml

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
7. Conditionals - Solution
The playbook might look as follows:
---
- name: Configure sysctl parameters
  hosts: all
  vars:
    ram_mb: 1024
  tasks:
  - name: Ensure that server meets memory requirements
    fail:
      msg: Server should have at least {{ ram_mb }}MB of ram
    when: ansible_memtotal_mb < ram_mb
  - name: Configure swappiness
    become: true
    sysctl:
      name: vm.swappiness
      value: '10'
      sysctl_set: true
      reload: true
...
To run the playbook go to /home/automation/plays and execute
ansible-playbook system_control.yml

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
8. YUM repositories - Solution
The playbook might look as follows:
- hosts: database
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
  - name: Import GPG key
    rpm_key:
      key: repo.mysql.com/RPM-GPG-KEY-mysql
  - name: Add definition of the repo

      enabled: true

ansible-playbook yum.yml 
Idea of using rpm_key module is to import the key to the internal list kept by rpm tool

9. Vault - Solution
Navigate to /home/automation/plays as automation user and create directories for the files
mkdir secrets vars
Create yml that is going to contain password for encrypted file containing db-related data

10. User Accounts
You have been given defintions of variables for the task
---
users:
- username: adam
  uid: 2000
- username: greg
  uid: 2001
- username: robby
  uid: 3001
- username: xenia
  uid: 3002
...
Store a file with the above content at /home/automation/plays/vars/users.yml
Create a playbook that meets following requirements:

Is placed at /home/automation/plays/users.yml
Creates users whose id starts with 2 on webservers host group. Password should be taken from the variable stored at /home/automation/plays/vars/user_password.yml (created in previous exercise)
Creates users whose id starts with 3 on database host group. Password should be taken from the variable stored at /home/automation/plays/vars/user_password.yml (created in previous exercise)
Users should be part of supplementary group wheel
Users’ shell should be set to /bin/bash
Password should use SHA512 hash format
Each user should have a SSH key uploaded - use the key from the first exercise
After running the playbook users should be able to SSH into their servers without providing password to prompt

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/10. User Accounts/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
10. User Accounts - Solution
The playbook might look as follows
- hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  vars_files:
  - vars/users.yml
  - vars/regular_users.yml
  tasks:
  - name: Create users for webservers
    user:
      name: "{{ item.username }}"
      uid: "{{ item.uid }}"
      groups: ['wheel']
      shell: /usr/bin/bash
      password: "{{ user_password | password_hash('sha512', 'salt') }}"
    loop: "{{ users }}"
    when: |
      (item.uid >= 2000 and item.uid < 3000 and inventory_hostname in groups['webservers']) or
      (item.uid >= 3000 and item.uid < 4000 and inventory_hostname in groups['database'])
  - name: Upload key
    authorized_key:
      key: '{{ lookup("file", "/home/automation/.ssh/id_rsa.pub") }}'
      user: "{{ item.username }}"
    loop: "{{ users }}"
    when: |
      (item.uid >= 2000 and item.uid < 3000 and inventory_hostname in groups['webservers']) or
      (item.uid >= 3000 and item.uid < 4000 and inventory_hostname in groups['database'])
Call the playbook like as it is presented below
ansible-playbook users.yml --vault-id user@./secrets/regular_users_password

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/11. Software Packages/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
11. Software Packages - Solution
In order to differentiate groups from each other you may want to use group_vars.
Navigate to /home/automation/plays and create a directory that is going to keep definitions for all groups
mkdir -p group_vars/all
Do the same for the specific groups you are going to use
mkdir -p group_vars/{proxy,database}
You will need a definition that is going to be common to all hosts and overriden if needed.
Here is how it might look like
common_packages: ['tmux']
specific_packages: []
To dump it call
printf "common_packages: ['tmux']\nspecific_packages: []\n" > group_vars/all/common.yml
Depending on the host group specific_packages need to be modified.
In case of database belonging hosts it should look like it is presented below
specific_packages: ['tcpdump', 'lsof']
Note that only a sinlge variable is overriden.
To dump it call
echo "specific_packages: ['tcpdump', 'lsof']" > group_vars/database/packages.yml
Do the same for the proxy group adjusting list of packages at the same time to meet the requirements
echo "specific_packages: ['mailx', 'lsof']" > group_vars/proxy/packages.yml
Finally, here is how the playbook might look like
---
- name: Setup Packages
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Install common packages
    yum:
      state: present
      name: "{{ common_packages }}"
  - name: Install group specific packages
    yum:
      state: present
      name: "{{ specific_packages }}"
...
In order to execute the playbook run
ansible-playbook software_packages.yml

12. Periodic jobs
Create a playbook that meets following requirements:

Is placed at /home/automation/plays/periodic_jobs.yml
Is executed against proxy group
Schedules a periodic job which runs every hour on workdays. It should be executed by the root. Every time the job is span it adds separator ----- which is followed by date and list of currently pluged devices below that. Please look at provided example. Make note of date format. Save the log to /var/log/devices.log. Set group and owner to the root user
Uses at to schedule a job that is going to be executed after 1 minute and dumps output from vmstat to /var/log/vmstat.log. The file should be owned by automation user and group. The file should be recreated each time the playbook is executed. If the playbook is executed a second time within a minute second job should not be scheduled

Example entry from two hours might look like it is presented below
----- 09/21/21 21:11 -----
sda      8:0    0   64G  0 disk 
├─sda1   8:1    0  2.1G  0 part [SWAP]
└─sda2   8:2    0 61.9G  0 part /

----- 09/21/21 22:11 -----
sda      8:0    0   64G  0 disk 
├─sda1   8:1    0  2.1G  0 part [SWAP]
└─sda2   8:2    0 61.9G  0 part /
sdb      8:16   0    5G  0 disk

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/12. Periodic jobs/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
12. Periodic jobs - Solution
The playbook might look as follows
---
- hosts: proxy
  name: Setup periodic jobs
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Schedule vmstat execution
    at:
      command: '/usr/bin/vmstat 2>/dev/null 1>/var/log/vmstat.log; chown automation:automation /var/log/vmstat.log'
      count: 1
      units: minutes
      unique: true
  - name: Schedule hourly job
    cron:
      name: Dump plugged devices
      weekday: '1-5'
      minute: '0'
      hour: '*'
      day: '*'
      month: '*'
      job: "echo ----- $(date \"+%m/%d/%y %H:%M\") >> /var/log/devices.log;lsblk >> /var/log/devices.log;chown root:root /var/log/devices.log"
...
Go to /home/automation/plays and execute
ansible-playbook periodic_jobs.yml

13. SWAP
Create a playbook that meets following requirements:

Is placed at /home/automation/plays/swap.yml

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/13. SWAP/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
13. SWAP - Solution
The playbook might look as follows
---
- name: Configure SWAP
  hosts: database
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    vg: swap
    lv: swap
  tasks:
  - name: Install tools
    yum:
      name: lvm2
  - name: Partition the drive
    parted:
      device: /dev/sdb
      label: gpt
      number: 1
      state: present
      part_start: 0%
      part_end: 1100MB
  - name: Create volume group
    lvg:
      pvs: /dev/sdb1
      vg: "{{ vg }}"
  - name: Create logical volume
    lvol:
      lv: "{{ lv }}"
      size: 100%VG
      vg: "{{ vg }}"
  - name: Create filesystem
    filesystem:
      dev: /dev/{{ vg }}/{{ lv }}
      fstype: swap
  - name: Mount on boot
    lineinfile:
      line: "/dev/{{ vg }}/{{ lv }} swap swap defaults 0 0"
      path: /etc/fstab
  - name: Check if mounted
    shell: "lsblk -s | grep {{ vg }}-{{ lv }}"
    changed_when: false
    register: mounts
  - name: Mount if not mounted
    shell: swapon /dev/{{ vg }}/{{ lv }}
    when: "'[SWAP]' not in mounts.stdout"
...
In order to execute the playbook run
ansible-playbook swap.yml
Readers note
I couldn’t use mount module due to this bug

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
16. Roles - Solution

Go to the /home/automation/plays and create a folder for roles

mkdir roles

If you configured ansible correctly while solving the first exercise role that you are going to create will be detected by playbook automatically

Change CWD to newly created directory and initate skeleton for the role

ansible-galaxy role init apache


Remove all folders different than tasks or meta
Edit tasks/main.yml to look as follows

---
- name: Install required packages
  yum:
    name:
    - httpd
    - firewalld
    state: present
- name: Allow required ports
  firewalld:
    permanent: true
    state: enabled
    port: "{{ item }}"
    immediate: true
  with_items:
  - 80/tcp
  - 443/tcp
- name: Ensure that services are started on boot
  service:
    name: "{{ item }}"
    state: started
    enabled: true
  with_items:
  - httpd
  - firewalld
- name: Prepare index page
  copy:
    content: "Welcome, you have connected to {{ ansible_facts.fqdn }}\n"
    dest: /var/www/html/index.html

Edit meta/main.yml as below

galaxy_info:
  author: Mateusz Stompór
  description: This role sets up webserver
  license: MIT
  min_ansible_version: 2.9
  galaxy_tags: []
dependencies: []

Finally create the playbook at /home/automation/plays/apache.yml with following content:

---
- hosts: webservers
  roles:
  - role: apache
    become: true
To run the playbook go to /home/automation/plays and call
ansible-playbook apache.yml

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
20. Advanced SSH
Aim of this task is to make ssh-server listen on non-standard port on top of commonly used - 22. To ensure that servers are secured properly firewall service must be running as well as selinux mode set to enforcing
Create a playbook named ssh.yml that meets following requirements:

Ensures that firewalld is installed and running on boot
Opens 20022 in firewall for incoming connections
Modifies sshd config to listen on both 22 and 20022
Is executed against webservers group
Uses system role selinux to enable enforcing mode and allow connection on port 20022
Reboots machines as the last task that playbook executes
Ensure that during playbook execution at least one server is available, configure it to run sequentially
Ensure that after reboot firewalld service is running, selinux mode set to enforcing and the machine can be accessed by both ports

You can use below command to verify the result
ssh -p 22 managed4.example.com exit && ssh -p 20022 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no managed4.example.com exit

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/20. Advanced SSH/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
20. Advanced SSH - Solution
Your playbook might look as follows
---
- hosts: webservers
  become: true
  serial: 1
  vars:
    selinux_state: enforcing
    selinux_ports:
    - { ports: '20022', proto: 'tcp', setype: 'ssh_port_t', state: 'present' }
  tasks:
  - name: Install firewalld
    yum: 
      name: firewalld
      state: present
  - name: Ensure that firewalld is running
    service:
      name: firewalld
      state: started
      enabled: true
  - name: Open non-standard port for the users in firewall
    firewalld:
      port: 20022/tcp
      state: enabled
      permanent: true
      immediate: true
  - name: Ensure that server listens on non-standard port
    lineinfile:
      line: Port 20022
      path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
  - name: Ensure that server listens on standard port
    lineinfile:
      line: Port 22
      path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
  roles:
  - role: rhel-system-roles.selinux
  post_tasks:
  - name: Reboot the systems
    reboot:
...
To run the playbook go to /home/automation/plays and execute
ansible-playbook ssh.yml

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: exercise
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
25. Prompt
You were asked to write a playbook that creates account for new employees. The idea is to execute the playbook each time a new person joins the company. To ease the boarding process your playbook should ask the user for his username and password while executing. All the people that are going to execute the playbook are suppossed to be part of networking team. From time to time they will need to interact with nmcli tool but despite that they shouldn’t have access to privileged commands
To achieve that create a playbook named prompt.yml at /home/automation/plays that meets following requirements:

Asks for username of a new user
Runs against all hosts
Asks for his password - ensure that it is hidden while the user is typing it. The user should type the password twice
Creates networking group
Allows the networking group to call nmcli tool with sudo without password. Ensure that nmcli is the ONLY tool that the group is allowed to execute with root privileges
Assigns the user to networking supplementary group

02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.filePath: 02 - Areas/Linux/RHCE/03 - Bài tập theo chủ đề/25 bài tập EX294 (repo mateuszstompor)/questions/25. Prompt/solution.md
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.title: solution
02---areas/linux/rhce/03---bài-tập-theo-.content:
25. Prompt - Solution
The playbook might look as follows:
---
- name: Create new account
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    group: networking
  vars_prompt:
  - name: username
    prompt: What is your username?
    private: false
  - name: password
    prompt: What is your password?
    private: true
    confirm: true
    salt_size: 2
    encrypt: sha512_crypt
  tasks:
  - name: Create group for the users
    group:
      name: '{{ group }}'
      state: present
  - name: Make people belonging to the {{ group }} allowed to use nmcli
    copy:
      content: "%{{ group }} ALL = NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/nmcli\n"
      dest: /etc/sudoers.d/{{ group }}
  - name: Create account for the user
    user:
      name: "{{ username }}"
      password: "{{ password }}"
      groups: ['{{ group }}']
...
Go to /home/automation/plays and execute
ansible-playbook prompt.yml

02---areas/linux/rhce/ex294---exam-objec.title: EX294 - Exam Objectives chính thức
02---areas/linux/rhce/ex294---exam-objec.content:
EX294 — Exam Objectives chính thức

Tổng hợp từ trang chính thức Red Hat, đối chiếu ngày 25/09/2026. Đây là bản tham chiếu chuẩn cho kế hoạch thi RHCE.


⚠️ Thay đổi tên chứng chỉ — tháng 5/2026
Red Hat đã tái cấu trúc toàn bộ chương trình chứng chỉ từ 11/05/2026 thành 5 track chuyên biệt (Enterprise Linux · Ansible · OpenShift · Cloud-native applications · AI), mỗi track có 5 bậc.
Điều này ảnh hưởng gì tới bạn:






























Trước 5/2026Hiện tạiTên kỳ thi EX294Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) examRed Hat Certified Advanced System Administrator in Ansible examDanh hiệu nhận đượcRHCERed Hat Certified Engineer in Ansible (bậc 3 — Engineer)Mã kỳ thiEX294EX294 (không đổi)Nội dung thi—Không đổi — Red Hat mô tả đây là thay đổi khung và tên gọi, không phải đổi nội dung


                  
                  ✅ Kết luận quan trọng: bạn vẫn lấy được danh hiệu bậc Engineer 
                  
                

Có một chỗ dễ hiểu nhầm: tên kỳ thi nghe như bậc “Advanced System Administrator” (thấp hơn Engineer), nhưng danh hiệu thì không.
RHCSA (EX200) + EX294 = Red Hat Certified Engineer in Ansible — bậc 3 trong track Ansible.
Bạn đã có RHCSA 300/300 (hiệu lực tới 2028), nên chỉ cần pass EX294 là lên thẳng bậc Engineer. Luận điểm “RHCE hiếm và có giá trị” của bạn vẫn đứng vững nguyên vẹn.




                  
                  💡 Ghi gì lên CV năm 2027 
                  
                

Ghi “Red Hat Certified Engineer in Ansible (EX294)”. Nếu muốn qua được bộ lọc từ khoá của HR thì thêm dạng quen thuộc trong ngoặc: Red Hat Certified Engineer in Ansible (RHCE, EX294). Người giữ chứng chỉ RHCE cũ được grandfather, không bị mất hiệu lực.


Các bậc trong track Ansible (để biết đường đi tiếp sau này):

                  🔴 RHEL 9 hay RHEL 10 — phải hỏi trước khi dựng lab 
                  
                

Tình hình tính tới 25/09/2026:

Khoá chính thức của Red Hat hiện là AU294, dựa trên RHEL 10 · ansible-core 2.16 · AAP 2.6. Khoá cũ RH294 dựa trên RHEL 9 · AAP 2.2.
Kỳ thi EX294 bản RHEL 9 vẫn là bản đang mở đăng ký; bản RHEL 10 đã được công bố và một số đơn vị đào tạo đã rao lịch học theo RHEL 10.

Vì sao quan trọng với bạn: plan hiện tại dựng lab 4 VM Rocky Linux 9. Nếu công ty đăng ký nhầm bản RHEL 10 thì lab lệch phiên bản.
Hành động: khi nộp đề xuất, hỏi rõ “kỳ thi EX294 phiên bản nào — RHEL 9 hay RHEL 10”. Chưa có câu trả lời thì cứ dựng lab Rocky 9 vì đó là bản đang mở đăng ký.
Mức độ ảnh hưởng nếu lệch: nhỏ. Danh sách objectives của hai bản giống nhau; khác biệt nằm ở phiên bản ansible-core, bộ ansible-dev-tools, và vài mặc định của hệ điều hành. Kỹ năng học trên RHEL 9 chuyển sang RHEL 10 gần như trọn vẹn — nhưng biết trước vẫn hơn.

Đề chấm kết quả trên máy, không chấm code đẹp. Hệ quả:

Playbook chạy được nhưng xấu vẫn full điểm. Playbook đẹp mà không chạy được thì 0 điểm.
Luôn chạy lại playbook lần 2 để chắc chắn idempotent và không lỗi.
Cấu hình phải sống sót qua reboot (/etc/fstab, enabled: true, SELinux persistent, firewalld permanent). Nếu task nói “persistent” mà bạn quên, máy chấm sẽ thấy trạng thái sai.
ansible-doc là bạn đồng hành duy nhất trong phòng thi. Tập tra module bằng nó tới mức phản xạ, đừng dựa vào note.

                  🚫 Các khoá "practice test" trắc nghiệm — bỏ qua hết 
                  
                

Đã xem 2 khoá:

Imran Afzal — “RHCE EX294 Practice Exams”: 5 bài × 40 câu, 90 phút/bài. Chỉ 40 lượt đánh giá.
BalaSagar — “EX294: RedHat Advanced System Administrator in Ansible” (8/2026, ~239k₫): 6 bài × 250 câu = 1500 câu. Bản đồ syllabus thực ra tốt nhất trong các khoá practice (có Navigator, Git & VS Code, Collections, Storage/Identity/Security) và tác giả dùng đúng tên chứng chỉ mới. Nhưng: khoá mới toanh, 1 học viên / 1 đánh giá, và tác giả chuyên xuất bản practice test cho AWS/GCP/AI chứ không phải Red Hat — không có cách nào kiểm chứng 1500 câu đó đúng hay sai.

Vấn đề gốc chung: EX294 là 4 tiếng gõ terminal, chấm bằng trạng thái thật của máy. Trắc nghiệm kiểm tra bạn nhớ gì, đề thi kiểm tra bạn làm được gì — đây là chỗ nhiều người nhầm rồi trượt.
Chi phí thật không phải tiền mà là thời gian: 1500 câu × ~1 phút ≈ 25 tiếng ≈ gần 3 tuần quỹ học. Số giờ đó bỏ vào lab thì giá trị hơn nhiều.
