05 — Davis AI: Practice Test


                  
                  NOTE
                  
                

File này tổng hợp các câu hỏi ôn tập theo chủ đề Davis AI trong kỳ thi Dynatrace Associate.
Format: mỗi câu hỏi hiển thị đầy đủ đáp án sai + giải thích, đáp án đúng được đánh dấu ✅.




                  
                  Quy ước cho file này 
                  
                


Giữ nguyên cấu trúc: ## Câu hỏi N — ... → câu hỏi → danh sách lựa chọn → toggle Đáp án & Giải thích.
Câu có nhiều đáp án đúng: kết thúc dòng câu hỏi bằng  (Select all that apply) (ví dụ: Which of the following …? (Select all that apply)).
Đặt toàn bộ phần giải thích và dòng Liên kết bên trong cùng toggle, không để rơi ra ngoài.
Khi thêm câu mới, giữ văn phong ngắn gọn, tiếng Việt cho phần giải thích, và dùng wikilink cho khái niệm Dynatrace đã có note.




Câu hỏi 1 — Davis cold start on new entities
Why can Davis start analysing a new entity sooner than a tool that relies on a long training period?

A. A three-quarter wait is enforced on every new entity before any Davis output is emitted
B. A senior engineer manually pre-trains a model for each individual host before it ever goes live
C. Every alert is disabled until enough training data has accumulated for that specific entity
D. Entities pay a per-entity licence fee that unlocks instant AI access for that entity only
E. Topology context and shared patterns across similar entities give Davis a running start



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: E



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Không có fixed multi-quarter wait. Baselines adapt theo thời gian, nhưng Davis không im lặng hàng tháng.B❌Manual per-host pre-training không phải cách hoạt động — không scale với môi trường thật.C❌Ngược với câu hỏi. Davis nhắm cover new entities, không tắt alert chờ training.D❌Licensing không phải thứ bật early analysis. Davis dùng platform context để bắt đầu nhanh.E✅Đúng. Davis dựa vào similar entities và topology relationships thay vì chờ im lặng.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis leverage topology context và shared patterns across similar entities để tránh cold start. New entities hưởng lợi từ những gì platform đã biết về neighbours.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Smartscape · Topology



Câu hỏi 2 — Per-dimension baselines
Why does Davis baseline metrics per dimension rather than in aggregate?

A. A spike on one customer’s cart service does not hide inside a global average over the whole tenant
B. Historical data for a metric can be safely discarded after the first week of collection
C. The UI can sort baselines alphabetically without any extra computation on the back end service
D. Every dimension shares a single threshold, to keep things simple for operators reading the UI



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Đúng. Per-dimension baselines ngăn noisy-majority traffic che khuất slice nhỏ nhưng broken.B❌Discard history sẽ phá baseline. Per-dimension không liên quan retention.C❌Sorting không liên quan per-dimension baselines.D❌Ngược lại per-dimension. Một threshold chung là failure mode baselines tồn tại để tránh.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Per-dimension baselines giữ problem trên một customer, region, hoặc endpoint khỏi bị ẩn bởi global average khỏe.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Auto-Adaptive Baselines · Anomaly Detection



Câu hỏi 3 — Davis CoPilot tasks
Davis CoPilot can help with which of the following tasks? (Select all that apply)

A. Summarising a Davis problem so a non-expert can read it quickly
B. Executing remote operating-system commands against monitored hosts directly from a chat prompt
C. Approving service-level agreement exceptions on behalf of the customer’s account management team
D. Editing the customer’s production configuration on a monitored host based on a chat instruction
E. Explaining in plain language what an existing DQL query does
F. Translating a natural-language question into a DQL query



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A, E, F








































#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Problem summarisation là CoPilot task được support.B❌Remote host execution không thuộc CoPilot. Operational actions qua Workflows với policy, không side-effect của chat.C❌CoPilot không approve SLA exceptions. Quyết định thương mại thuộc account owners.D❌CoPilot không edit production config trên monitored hosts. Change management qua Workflows và pipelines của customer.E✅Đúng. CoPilot đọc query và mô tả nó làm gì — hữu ích cho review và onboarding.F✅Prompt-to-DQL là headline CoPilot capability.
Giải thích tổng thể:
CoPilot surface thật: natural language → DQL, query explanation, problem summarisation. Không edit source code, gửi invoice, hay chạy shell commands.
Liên kết: Davis CoPilot · DQL · Davis AI · Workflows



Câu hỏi 4 — Auto-adaptive baseline behaviour
What does an auto-adaptive baseline do in Davis?

A. Forces every metric on the tenant to share the same baseline value so results stay comparable
B. Learns the normal range of a metric over time and flags deviations from that learnt normal
C. Sets a fixed global threshold that every team on the tenant has to agree on before it can be changed
D. Hides every anomaly from the UI so operators are never bothered by noisy signals overnight
E. Deletes historical metric data so new baselines can be recomputed from scratch every week



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: B



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Một baseline value chung sẽ hủy per-metric sensitivity. Không phải auto-adaptive.B✅Đúng. Auto-adaptive baselines học normal và alert khi metric lệch khỏi band đã học.C❌Fixed global thresholds là static approach mà baselines cải thiện.D❌Ẩn anomalies trái mục đích. Baselines surface chúng, không suppress.E❌Historical data cần để compute baseline. Xóa weekly là counterproductive.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Auto-adaptive baselines học shape bình thường của metric, kể cả seasonality, và flag khi metric drift ngoài band đã học.
Liên kết: Auto-Adaptive Baselines · Davis AI · Anomaly Detection



Câu hỏi 5 — Davis and topology
Why does Davis work on top of the topology rather than just on raw metrics?

A. Because metrics cannot physically be stored in Grail without a topology entity attached to them
B. Topology tells Davis how components influence each other, which is what root-cause reasoning needs
C. So users get a slower, more thorough scan of every data point one by one in strict order
D. Only topology data fits in RAM while metrics have to be streamed off disk for every query
E. Topology is cheaper to store than time-series data, so Davis picks whichever is cheaper at the moment



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: B



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Metrics có thể mang dimensions không cần full topology entity. Topology là analytical choice của Davis, không phải storage hard requirement.B✅Đúng. Không biết service A gọi B trên host C, Davis không propose specific root-cause entity.C❌Davis không cố ý chậm lại. Topology vì causation tốt hơn, không phải processing lâu hơn.D❌Không phải cách platform lưu data. Grail và topology cùng tồn tại; Davis reach vào cả hai.E❌Cost không phải lý do. Topology là reasoning substrate vì semantic, không vì rẻ.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis reason over live topology (Smartscape) để follow influence và call relationships — cách propose root cause thay vì chỉ flag correlations.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Smartscape · Topology · Grail



Câu hỏi 6 — Anomaly detection approaches in Davis
Which of the following are legitimate anomaly detection approaches available in Davis? (Select all that apply)

A. Hard-coded alert thresholds that Davis sets identically for every metric on the tenant
B. An ingest-time filter that drops every metric reading outside a three-standard-deviation window
C. Auto-adaptive multidimensional baselines that learn normal behaviour per dimension
D. Periodic manual review meetings where threshold changes are agreed by the tenant’s full SRE team
E. Static thresholds you configure manually when the metric shape is well understood



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C, E



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Davis không apply cùng hard-coded threshold cho mọi metric. Thresholds configure per metric; adaptive path học per-dimension.B❌Ingest-time filtering là preprocessing, không phải anomaly detection approach. Davis detect trên stored data.C✅Multidimensional baselines là Davis default cho hầu hết metrics.D❌Governance meetings không phải detection technique. Davis cung cấp algorithmic side.E✅Static thresholds vẫn tồn tại — đúng khi có hard SLO cần watch.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis support adaptive multidimensional baselines cho noisy/seasonal metrics và static thresholds cho metric có ceiling biết trước.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Auto-Adaptive Baselines · Anomaly Detection



Câu hỏi 7 — Davis governance expectations
Which of the following is a reasonable expectation about how Davis handles governance?

A. Davis relaxes tenant RBAC for on-call engineers during active incidents so response time is not constrained by the usual permission workflow
B. Davis operates within the tenant’s access controls and its output is auditable in the UI
C. Davis reasoning is preserved as a compressed diagnostic artefact accessible only to Dynatrace support during escalation cases
D. Davis evaluates problems against the most permissive role available on the tenant so access boundaries do not block analysis or reduce its coverage



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: B






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌RBAC không được relax lúc incident. Response time qua role design trước, không override permissions.B✅Đúng. Davis respect RBAC; problem-level audit trail có trong UI để review.C❌Davis output visible và auditable cho tenant users. Không phải artefact chỉ support.D❌Davis hoạt động trong access model của tenant, không bypass bằng “most permissive role”.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis nằm trong cùng governance model với platform: RBAC áp dụng, evidence behind mỗi problem có thể inspect.
Liên kết: Davis AI · RBAC · Problems



Câu hỏi 8 — What is Davis CoPilot
What is Davis CoPilot?

A. An internal billing tool that estimates how much each Davis query cost the tenant in consumption units
B. A deprecated chat feature that was removed from the product in the most recent release
C. The generative-AI assistant that helps users write DQL and make sense of the results they get back
D. A mandatory survey asking customers to rate Davis before the tenant will run any query at all



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌CoPilot không handle billing. Consumption track ở nơi khác trong tenant.B❌CoPilot là shipping, active feature — không deprecated.C✅Đúng. Natural-language front door tới DQL và problem summaries.D❌Không có gating survey. CoPilot là optional assistant.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis CoPilot là generative layer: NL → DQL, explain queries, summarise problems bằng ngôn ngữ thường.
Liên kết: Davis CoPilot · DQL · Davis AI



Câu hỏi 9 — Causal AI core idea
What is the core idea of causal AI as Dynatrace uses the term?

A. Inferring root cause from how entities influence each other, not just from which signals fired together
B. Weighting the most recently deployed service higher than all others when multiple entities report anomalies within the same problem window
C. Summarising incident notes with a language model after the event is resolved so the resulting narrative can be reused in post-mortems
D. Ranking incidents by how much revenue they are estimated to have cost the business each hour
E. Running a chat-style assistant that asks follow-up questions until the cause is narrowed down



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Đúng. Đó là causal-vs-correlation distinction Dynatrace vẽ.B❌Recent-deployment weighting là heuristic change analysis, không phải causal AI. Causal AI dùng entity-influence từ topology.C❌LLM summarisation cho documentation, không phải causal AI. Causal AI trên topology graph và signal correlations.D❌Revenue impact là business metric, không phải định nghĩa causal AI.E❌Gần generative AI hơn. Causal AI trên topology và events, không qua dialogue.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Causal AI trong Davis reason over topology để infer cause and effect — tách khỏi tools chỉ correlate time-aligned signals.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Causal AI · Smartscape · Problems



Câu hỏi 10 — Why combine causal, predictive, generative AI
Why are causal, predictive, and generative AI combined in Davis rather than sold as separate tools?

A. The three techniques cannot technically run on separate tenants under any circumstances at all, so they are sold together
B. Each answers a different question (what is wrong, what is coming, how to express it) and they compose into one workflow
C. It is purely a marketing bundle with no practical reason behind it, added to the product as a brand and positioning move
D. Combining the three halves the cost of each one, so customers save money by default on their platform licensing line



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: B






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Có thể tách technically. Gộp vì giúp user, không vì bắt buộc.B✅Ba lớp bổ sung nhau; dùng cùng nhau giúp operator từ signal tới fix không đổi tool.C❌Combination thực dụng, không cosmetic. Mỗi AI style ở chỗ hữu ích nhất.D❌Pricing không phải lý do. Ba lớp trả lời câu hỏi khác nhau trên cùng data.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Causal = what is wrong now; predictive = what is coming; generative = how to express/explain. Cùng data plane làm handoff seamless.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Causal AI · Predictive AI · Davis CoPilot



Câu hỏi 11 — Auto-adaptive vs static thresholds
Why are auto-adaptive baselines often better than static thresholds?

A. Auto-adaptive baselines adapt to seasonality and per-dimension behaviour that static thresholds miss
B. Auto-adaptive baselines never need a human to review them, unlike static thresholds which are manual
C. Static thresholds are generated by Davis automatically, so they are the safer default to start with
D. Static thresholds run faster against the database, so they are always the right choice operationally



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Traffic có time-of-day, day-of-week, per-customer patterns; static thresholds làm phẳng tất cả.B❌Auto-adaptive vẫn cần human review — không unsupervised mãi mãi.C❌Static thường do human set. Davis default là adaptive baseline.D❌Speed không phải điểm. Accuracy theo thời gian mới quan trọng; static drift stale khi pattern đổi.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Traffic thật seasonal và dimensional. Auto-adaptive học shape đó; static coi 3am như 3pm và tiny tenant như largest.
Liên kết: Auto-Adaptive Baselines · Davis AI · Anomaly Detection



Câu hỏi 12 — Davis vs Workflows responsibility
How do Davis and Workflows typically divide responsibility?

A. Davis and Workflows are billed as a single inseparable unit and cannot be used apart at all
B. Workflows decide what went wrong; Davis decides which services to restart on the fleet
C. Davis detects, explains, and raises; Workflows reacts by running the chosen response
D. Workflows and Davis fully overlap, so customers usually disable one of them in practice



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Licensing không bắt gộp. Hai product riêng với interface rõ.B❌Đảo vai trò. Davis detect/explain; Workflows là nơi express actions.C✅Davis là eyes và brain; Workflows là hands.D❌Không overlap. Mỗi bên complement kia.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis raise tay; Workflows thực hiện response. Signalling do Davis, action do Workflows policy bạn viết.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Workflows · Problems



Câu hỏi 13 — What Davis is NOT built to do
Which of the following is NOT what Davis is built to do?

A. Detect incidents and propose likely root causes from topology and related events
B. Forecast upcoming capacity needs and flag anomalous metric behaviour
C. Replace the need for engineers to understand what their services actually do
D. Help users turn natural-language questions into DQL via Davis CoPilot



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Detect-and-explain là job cốt lõi của Davis — không phải đáp án NOT.B❌Predictive forecasting và anomaly detection nằm trong Davis.C✅Đúng (NOT). Davis là power tool, không thay domain knowledge; engineering judgement vẫn trong loop.D❌Generative help qua CoPilot là capability đang ship.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis giúp triage nhanh hơn và hiểu nhiều hơn — không substitute cho việc biết services của bạn.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Davis CoPilot · Problems



Câu hỏi 14 — DQL predictive forecasting
Which DQL construct is associated with predictive forecasting in Dynatrace?

A. A forecast command in DQL (timeseries ... | forecast) projects the series forward
B. summarize count() is the forecasting function that Davis relies on under the hood
C. join on bizevents is what produces a trend line from a metric in the UI
D. The clause filter entity.type == "HOST" is how Davis tells the engine to predict the future values of a metric
E. The keyword RANDOM() in DQL triggers a predictive run over the selected window



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅forecast trong DQL extend time series forward dựa trên pattern đã học.B❌summarize aggregate dữ liệu hiện có; không project tương lai.C❌join combine datasets; không liên quan project metric forward.D❌filter thu hẹp rows, không forecast.E❌Không có RANDOM() forecast trigger. Forecasting là DQL command riêng.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Forecasting trong Grail qua forecast trong DQL — extend series theo seasonality và trend Davis đã học.
Liên kết: DQL · Grail · Davis AI · Predictive AI



Câu hỏi 15 — CoPilot natural language response
When a user asks Davis CoPilot a question in natural language, what does it typically return?

A. A proposed DQL query and an explanation, which the user can review and then run
B. Nothing, because CoPilot only listens and never responds in the current release of the product
C. A hard-coded answer taken from a static FAQ that was frozen in an earlier release
D. A billing breakdown showing how much the question itself will cost to answer for this tenant



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅CoPilot draft; human review — assist loop được thiết kế vậy.B❌CoPilot có respond. Silent assistant không phải assistant.C❌CoPilot generative, không static FAQ lookup.D❌CoPilot không quote per-question bill; focus vào trả lời câu hỏi.
Giải thích tổng thể:
CoPilot produce DQL draft + explanation. User review rồi run — draft-and-review loop, không fire-and-forget.
Liên kết: Davis CoPilot · DQL · Davis AI



Câu hỏi 16 — Frequent issue detection
What does frequent issue detection in Davis do?

A. Deletes problems that happen often so the problems feed stays short and readable for operators
B. Trains a separate model per tenant so the UI looks visually different for every customer brand
C. Marks recurring problems as low-priority so they never page anyone on the tenant again
D. Highlights patterns of the same underlying issue repeating across the environment



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: D






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Deletion sẽ ẩn real incidents — ngược với intent.B❌Frequent issue detection không phải UI theming feature.C❌Hạ priority im lặng sẽ mask real issues. Feature surface pattern, không mute.D✅Đúng. Spot cùng issue lặp lại để fix root cause thay vì symptom.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Frequent issue detection surface repeated problems như pattern — team fix root cause một lần thay vì đóng cùng incident nhiều lần.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Problems · Frequent Issue Detection



Câu hỏi 17 — Smartscape and Davis
How does Smartscape relate to Davis?

A. An unrelated product from a different vendor that Dynatrace resells alongside its own Davis product
B. The live topology map Davis uses to reason about how entities affect each other in real time
C. A replacement for Davis that shipped in the latest release and made Davis obsolete
D. A billing layer that decides how many Davis queries a tenant is allowed to run in a month



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: B






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Smartscape là topology graph của Dynatrace, không phải reseller product.B✅Đúng. Causal reasoning của Davis dựa trên Smartscape graph.C❌Smartscape và Davis không thay thế nhau. Smartscape là topology Davis reason over.D❌Smartscape không liên quan billing. Là topology graph, không phải metering service.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Smartscape là topology map tự động của entities và relationships. Davis dùng Smartscape để biến raw signals thành causal explanations.
Liên kết: Smartscape · Davis AI · Topology · Causal AI



Câu hỏi 18 — Davis problem components
A Davis problem typically includes which of the following parts? (Select all that apply)

A. A cost estimate in local currency for the total business impact of the incident
B. Related events that contribute to the problem, grouped together in one place
C. Timeline showing when the problem started, how it evolved, and when it closed
D. Root-cause entity identified by Davis, when one can be determined
E. Set of impacted entities linked to the problem through the topology graph
F. A pre-generated customer communication draft translated into every supported tenant language



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: B, C, D, E








































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Cost estimation là downstream analysis, không phải built-in Davis problem field.B✅Related events bundled vào problem — không phải hunt events feed.C✅Timeline là core — scrub through incident trong UI.D✅Davis propose single root-cause entity khi evidence support.E✅Impacted entities gathered qua Smartscape relationships.F❌Davis không draft customer communications. Messaging là trách nhiệm customer.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis problem bundle: timeline, proposed root cause, impacted entities, related events. Phần còn lại trong list không thuộc problem payload.
Liên kết: Problems · Davis AI · Smartscape · Events



Câu hỏi 19 — Davis AI platform role
What role does Davis AI play inside the Dynatrace platform?

A. A template engine that generates dashboards based on the platform’s data model, shipped separately
B. A standalone workflow runner for scheduled batch jobs that has nothing to do with analytics at all
C. A deprecated product name kept around for marketing reasons but that is no longer actually shipped
D. The AI layer on top of the data: problem detection, forecasting, and natural-language help



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: D






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Dashboarding ở Notebooks/Dashboards. Davis là AI engine trên data, không phải template system.B❌Workflow execution là Workflows. Davis analytical — AI engine, không phải scheduler.C❌Davis active, shipping — causal, predictive, generative. Chưa retired.D✅Đúng. Causal (root cause), predictive (baselines/forecasts), generative (CoPilot) trên platform data.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis là AI engine của Dynatrace platform — causal, predictive, generative trong một chỗ cho operators.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Causal AI · Predictive AI · Davis CoPilot



Câu hỏi 20 — Davis and automated actions
How does Davis fit together with automated actions in Dynatrace?

A. All automation is blocked by default; Davis must be turned off before any action can run on a tenant
B. Davis problems and events can trigger Workflows, which then run the actual remediation
C. No action can run until a human first imports the action set from a partner marketplace every time
D. Every action is run by Davis itself and nothing is ever handed off to an automation layer



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: B






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Davis không block automation. Hai bên làm việc cùng nhau.B✅Đúng. Davis raises; Workflows reacts. Signalling và action governed riêng.C❌Có thể ship Workflows riêng không cần marketplace mỗi lần run.D❌Davis là detection/reasoning. Actions nằm trong Workflows.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis: detection và causation. Workflows: action. Davis output (problems, events, forecasts) là trigger cho Workflows.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Workflows · Problems · Events



Câu hỏi 21 — Where Davis surfaces output
Where does Davis most commonly surface its output?

A. Only in emails sent to the tenant owner once a month as a digest, with nothing in the UI
B. Exclusively inside the OneAgent local config file on each host, as YAML comments
C. Inside a separate desktop application that is sold as an optional add-on to the platform
D. In the Problems feed, on entity pages, inside DQL results, and as Davis CoPilot answers



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: D






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Davis là first-class UI feature, không phải email digest product.B❌OneAgent config không chứa Davis output — chỉ agent configuration.C❌Không có Davis desktop app riêng. Davis trong web UI và APIs.D✅Đúng. Output xuất hiện nơi operators đã làm việc — không chỉ một màn hình.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis output across experience: problems feed, entity pages, DQL results, Davis CoPilot prompts.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Problems · DQL · Davis CoPilot



Câu hỏi 22 — Event vs problem
What is the difference between an event and a problem in Davis?

A. Events are always good news, problems are always bad news, and Davis sorts them alphabetically
B. Events come only from synthetic monitors, whereas problems come only from Real User Monitoring
C. They are synonyms; Davis uses the two words interchangeably in the UI and in the API
D. Events are individual signals; problems are grouped events Davis believes describe one incident



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: D






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Events là neutral signals. Problems là grouped incidents, không phải “bad news” literal.B❌Cả hai có thể từ mọi signal source. Split là structural, không per-product.C❌Không interchangeable. Events = raw signals; problems = bundled incident.D✅Đúng. Problem là grouping related events + impacted entities + root cause.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Events: raw signals (anomalies, state changes, deployments). Problem: Davis bundle related events quanh một incident, kèm impacted entities và proposed root cause.
Liên kết: Events · Problems · Davis AI



Câu hỏi 23 — Davis forecast capabilities
Which of the following are things Davis forecast can legitimately do? (Select all that apply)

A. Pre-scale the cluster hardware without any human review or workflow in between
B. Decide on its own to silently extend the threshold of a metric once a breach becomes likely
C. Project future values of a metric based on its past seasonal pattern
D. Estimate when a metric is likely to breach a threshold, based on the same projection
E. Automatically cancel a production deploy if any forecast looks unfavourable to the model
F. Generate a new metric from scratch for a time series that does not yet exist in Grail



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C, D








































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Autonomous pre-scaling không phải forecast alone. Acting là Workflows/automation choice.B❌Forecast không silently move thresholds. Project values; acting là human-configured step.C✅Forecasting built trên seasonality và trend của time series.D✅Sau khi project curve forward, estimate khi nó cross threshold line.E❌Automation deploy thuộc Workflows/release tool với policy — forecast alone không cancel.F❌Cần existing observed series. Không invent metric chưa từng ingest.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Forecast project metric forward từ learnt seasonality/trend. Pre-scale hay cancel deploy là Workflows decision, không phải forecasting tự làm.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Predictive AI · DQL · Workflows · Grail



Câu hỏi 24 — Davis CoPilot invocation surfaces
Which surfaces inside Dynatrace can Davis CoPilot be invoked from? (Select all that apply)

A. The ActiveGate command line, which has no UI layer to host a chat prompt in the first place
B. An operating-system shell command that runs locally on every host after OneAgent is installed
C. The DQL query editor, to draft or explain a query
D. The Davis problem view, to produce a natural-language summary of an open incident



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C, D






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌ActiveGate là infrastructure — không host chat UI cho CoPilot.B❌CoPilot không phải local shell command. Lives trong platform UI/APIs.C✅Query editor là natural place cho prompt-to-DQL.D✅Problem summarisation nằm nơi đọc problems.
Giải thích tổng thể:
CoPilot gặp user nơi họ đã làm việc: DQL editor và problem view. Không wired vào infrastructure components.
Liên kết: Davis CoPilot · DQL · Problems



Câu hỏi 25 — Davis AI styles combined
Davis AI combines which of the following styles of AI? (Select all that apply)

A. Predictive AI, which forecasts metric behaviour and baselines noise
B. Generative AI, which writes DQL and narrative summaries from prompts
C. Evolutionary AI that rewrites the OneAgent binary based on fitness scores per host
D. Swarm AI, where thousands of small agents vote on every decision made by the platform
E. Causal AI, which reasons about cause and effect across the topology



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A, B, E



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Auto-adaptive baselines và Davis forecast thuộc predictive family.B✅Davis CoPilot là generative: NL → DQL, problem summarisation.C❌OneAgent không bị rewrite runtime bởi evolutionary process.D❌Không phải category thật trong Davis. Không vote-based swarm agents.E✅Causal AI cho phép propose specific root-cause entity thay vì chỉ correlate.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Davis = causal (root cause) + predictive (baselines, forecasts) + generative (CoPilot).
Liên kết: Davis AI · Causal AI · Predictive AI · Davis CoPilot



Câu hỏi 26 — Reviewing CoPilot DQL draft
When a CoPilot-generated DQL query looks plausible, what should the user typically do?

A. Save the suggestion as a shared template so the next time a similar question is asked the team starts from this CoPilot-generated baseline automatically
B. Run the query against a small sampled slice of the dataset first and promote to the full dataset only after the sample results look sensible
C. Read it and sanity-check it before running, treating CoPilot as a draft, not as autopilot
D. Ask CoPilot to regenerate the query with a tighter prompt until successive attempts converge on a similar structure, then run that final version



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Template query chưa verify lan mistakes across team. Bước đầu là sanity-check, không archive.B❌Staged execution hữu ích cho expensive queries nhưng không thay đọc logic. Vẫn phải sanity-check trước run.C✅Đúng. Draft + human review là safe default cho generative tooling.D❌Prompt iteration có thể cải thiện suggestion nhưng vẫn phải đọc final query. Convergence ≠ correctness.
Giải thích tổng thể:
CoPilot như junior colleague nhanh: đọc draft, check join keys và filters, rồi run. Speed-up hữu ích — không thay việc đọc query.
Liên kết: Davis CoPilot · DQL



Câu hỏi 27 — Davis event correlation
How does Davis correlate events that belong to the same incident?

A. IP address only, so any two events sharing an IP are always joined into one incident automatically
B. Time alone, so any events in the same five-minute window are grouped into one problem
C. Topology links, time proximity, and event similarity, weighed together in one decision
D. Alphabetical ordering of the event name as a simple deterministic fallback when other signals are missing



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌IP-only grouping gây collision trong shared-IP environments.B❌Time-only tạo false positives lúc busy. Davis dùng topology và content.C✅Đúng. Ba signals kết hợp — related events cùng problem, unrelated tách ra.D❌Alphabetical grouping không có semantic value.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Event grouping dùng topology proximity, time proximity, và content similarity — collapse related signals thành một problem không over/under-grouping.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Events · Problems · Smartscape



Câu hỏi 28 — CoPilot data privacy expectations
What should a Dynatrace customer expect about how CoPilot handles their data?

A. Raw production data is sent verbatim to a public AI benchmarking leaderboard for cross-vendor comparisons
B. Customer data is stored permanently in the model’s public training set without any consent
C. CoPilot runs within the tenant’s privacy boundary, and customer data is not fed into public models
D. Every question must be approved by a Dynatrace human operator before any answer is returned
E. Every CoPilot response is first mirrored to a public training queue and only then returned to the tenant



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Customer data không publish lên public leaderboards — compliance failure.B❌Không roll customer data vào public training sets im lặng.C✅Đúng. Privacy/governance commitments; data stays trong tenant boundaries.D❌Không có per-question human approval loop. CoPilot interactive.E❌Không có public training queue trong response path.
Giải thích tổng thể:
CoPilot trong privacy/governance framework của Dynatrace. Data dùng trả lời câu hỏi của chính customer, không train public models.
Liên kết: Davis CoPilot · Davis AI



Câu hỏi 29 — Davis root cause selection
When Davis finds a problem, how does it decide which entity is the root cause?

A. Selecting the entity whose anomaly score exceeded its baseline by the largest margin during the problem window
B. Selecting whichever service was most recently deployed in the environment, on the assumption that recent change is the strongest predictor of incident cause
C. Routing the candidate root cause through a human confirmation gate where the on-call engineer accepts or rejects the choice before the problem is finalised
D. Following topology and event correlations back to the entity that best explains the others



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: D






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Magnitude-based là naive heuristic; entity spike lớn thường là downstream symptom.B❌Recent deployment là một input, không phải cách chọn root cause. Selection anchored topology + correlations.C❌Root cause tự động từ topology/events — không mandatory human gate.D✅Đúng. Walk influence graph trong Smartscape, fold events, chọn entity explain phần còn lại.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Root cause derived bằng walk topology ngược từ impacted entities, weigh related events, chọn entity best explain downstream.
Liên kết: Davis AI · Smartscape · Problems · Causal AI



Câu hỏi 30 — What CoPilot is NOT designed to do
Which of the following is something Davis CoPilot is NOT designed to do?

A. Take direct autonomous action in production without any human in the loop
B. Draft and explain DQL based on a natural-language prompt from the user
C. Help onboard users who are still learning what DQL can and cannot do in the platform
D. Summarise Davis problems so a reader can triage them faster



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Đúng (NOT). Production actions là Workflows với policy — không phải generative side-effect.B❌Prompt-to-DQL là headline task — CoPilot được thiết kế làm việc này.C❌Onboarding new users là use case hữu ích — CoPilot được thiết kế hỗ trợ.D❌Problem summarisation là advertised task — CoPilot được thiết kế làm việc này.
Giải thích tổng thể:
CoPilot là draft-and-review assistant, không autonomous actuator. Muốn action trong prod → Workflows, không phải CoPilot.
Liên kết: Davis CoPilot · Workflows · DQL · Problems




📚 Tổng hợp kiến thức — Davis AI


                  
                  NOTE
                  
                

Phần này tổng hợp các điểm kiến thức cốt lõi được rút ra từ toàn bộ câu hỏi trong file. Dùng để ôn nhanh trước khi thi.


🧠 Davis AI — 3 Styles of AI

























StyleCâu hỏi trả lờiVí dụCausal AIWhy? — root cause từ entity influence relationshipsTrace ngược topology để tìm nguyên nhânPredictive AIWhat’s coming? — baselines, forecasts, anomaly detectionMetric sẽ breach threshold lúc nào?Generative AIHow to explain? — NL summaries, DQL generationDavis CoPilot

Ba styles kết hợp vì mỗi cái trả lời câu hỏi khác nhau và compose thành một workflow liền mạch
Davis = AI engine (không phải dashboard template, không phải workflow runner)

🔍 Causal AI & Problems
Root cause selection

Cách hoạt động: walk topology graph ngược từ impacted entities → weigh related events → chọn entity best explains downstream
Không phải: chọn entity có anomaly score lớn nhất, chọn service deploy gần nhất, hay require human gate

Davis Problem = bundle của:

✅ Timeline (start → evolution → close)
✅ Proposed root-cause entity
✅ Set of impacted entities (qua Smartscape relationships)
✅ Related events grouped together
❌ KHÔNG: cost estimate, customer communication draft

Event vs Problem

Events: raw signals (anomalies, state changes, deployments)
Problems: Davis bundle related events quanh một incident + impacted entities + root cause
❌ Không phải synonyms

Event correlation: 3 signals kết hợp

Topology links (Smartscape relationships)
Time proximity (cùng window)
Event similarity (content)

📈 Predictive AI & Baselines
Auto-adaptive baselines vs Static thresholds






























Auto-adaptiveStaticHọc từ data✅ Học normal range per dimension❌ Fixed valueSeasonality✅ Handle time-of-day, day-of-week❌ Phẳng hóa tất cảPer-dimension✅ Per service, per customer, per region❌ Shared thresholdUse caseMetric shape phức tạp/seasonalCó hard SLO ceiling biết trước

Per-dimension baselines: ngăn spike một slice nhỏ bị ẩn trong global average
Auto-adaptive cold start: dùng topology context + shared patterns từ similar entities (không phải wait silent months)

DQL forecast

Syntax: timeseries ... | forecast
Project time series forward dựa trên learnt seasonality + trend
Estimate khi metric sẽ breach threshold
❌ KHÔNG: tự pre-scale cluster, tự cancel deploy, tự move threshold

Frequent issue detection

Surface repeated problems như pattern → fix root cause một lần thay vì đóng cùng incident nhiều lần

🤖 Davis CoPilot — Generative AI Surface
CoPilot CÓ THỂ:

✅ Translate natural language → DQL (prompt-to-DQL)
✅ Explain existing DQL query bằng plain language
✅ Summarize Davis problem để non-expert đọc nhanh
✅ Onboard users mới học DQL

CoPilot KHÔNG THỂ:

❌ Execute remote OS commands trên monitored hosts
❌ Edit production config trực tiếp
❌ Approve SLA exceptions
❌ Take autonomous action in production without human in loop
❌ Delete alerts, detect anomaly trên metrics (đó là Davis AI engine)

Workflow của CoPilot:

User hỏi bằng NL
CoPilot generate DQL draft + explanation
User review và sanity-check
User chạy query

→ Draft-and-review loop — không phải fire-and-forget
CoPilot invocation surfaces:

DQL query editor, Davis problem view
❌ KHÔNG: ActiveGate CLI, local shell command

Privacy:

Chạy trong tenant’s privacy boundary
Data KHÔNG được gửi ra public models hay training datasets

🔄 Davis vs Workflows





















DavisWorkflowsDetection + explanationAction + remediation”Eyes and brain""Hands”Raise problemReact to problem

Davis output (problems, events, forecasts) là triggers cho Workflows
Davis không thực hiện actions; Workflows làm việc đó

🗺️ Smartscape và Davis

Smartscape là live topology map Davis dùng để reason về entity influence
Không biết entity nào gọi entity nào → không thể propose specific root cause
Davis respect RBAC — hoạt động trong access model của tenant (không bypass)

📍 Davis output surfaces

Problems feed, Entity pages, DQL results, Davis CoPilot answers
❌ KHÔNG phải: monthly email digest, OneAgent config files, separate desktop app

⚡ Các điểm hay nhầm lẫn

Causal AI ≠ Predictive AI ≠ Generative AI — ba concepts riêng biệt
Davis không replace kỹ năng của engineer — power tool, không oracle
Forecast không tự scale hay cancel deploy — chỉ project metrics forward
CoPilot là assistant (draft), không autopilot (execute)
Static threshold vẫn có giá trị (hard SLO ceiling) — không phải luôn dùng adaptive
Event ≠ Problem (event = raw signal; problem = grouped incident)

Liên kết: Davis AI · Causal AI · Predictive AI · Davis CoPilot · Auto-Adaptive Baselines · Anomaly Detection · Problems · Events · Smartscape · Workflows · DQL · Grail · Frequent Issue Detection

06 — Automation & Data Processing: Practice Test


                  
                  NOTE
                  
                

File này tổng hợp các câu hỏi ôn tập theo chủ đề Automation & Data Processing trong kỳ thi Dynatrace Associate.
Format: mỗi câu hỏi hiển thị đầy đủ đáp án sai + giải thích, đáp án đúng được đánh dấu ✅.




                  
                  Quy ước cho file này 
                  
                


Giữ nguyên cấu trúc: ## Câu hỏi N — ... → câu hỏi → danh sách lựa chọn → toggle Đáp án & Giải thích.
Câu có nhiều đáp án đúng: kết thúc dòng câu hỏi bằng  (Select all that apply) (ví dụ: Which of the following …? (Select all that apply)).
Đặt toàn bộ phần giải thích và dòng Liên kết bên trong cùng toggle, không để rơi ra ngoài.
Khi thêm câu mới, giữ văn phong ngắn gọn, tiếng Việt cho phần giải thích, và dùng wikilink cho khái niệm Dynatrace đã có note.




Câu hỏi 1 — OpenPipeline ingest sources
Which of the following data sources can OpenPipeline ingest from? (Select all that apply)

A. OneAgent-collected signals such as host metrics, logs, and events
B. OpenTelemetry data arriving through OTLP and routed into Grail by the pipeline
C. External webhook sources such as SDLC events from GitHub or GitLab
D. Third-party APIs called by extensions or pulled on a schedule into the tenant
E. Database binlogs tailed in real time from a customer-managed PostgreSQL primary, with no agent or API layer
F. SNMP traps collected directly from network switches over UDP, without any intermediate forwarder



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A, B, C, D








































#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Agent-produced data flows through OpenPipeline into Grail.B✅OTLP là core supported source; OpenPipeline configure bước tiếp theo.C✅Webhook ingestion là first-class path cho SDLC và business events.D✅API-driven ingest cho sources không tự push data.E❌Direct binlog tailing không phải OpenPipeline capability. DB signals qua extensions, logs, hoặc OTLP.F❌SNMP trap ingestion không phải first-class OpenPipeline source. Network telemetry thường qua extension framework.
Giải thích tổng thể:
OpenPipeline ingest từ agents, APIs, webhooks, và OTLP — single configurable door data vào Grail.
Liên kết: OpenPipeline · Grail · OneAgent · OpenTelemetry



Câu hỏi 2 — Site Reliability Guardian role
What is the main role of Site Reliability Guardian (SRG) in Dynatrace?

A. A permission mechanism that controls which engineers are allowed to open problems inside the Dynatrace UI
B. Converting OTLP traces into logs during ingest before they land in Grail buckets
C. Deploying OneAgent to Kubernetes clusters on behalf of the platform team
D. A change-risk gate that evaluates SLOs, error rate, and performance before a release is accepted
E. A dashboard template library that platform teams install on new tenants after bootstrapping



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: D



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Access control là IAM/RBAC. SRG là release evaluation, không phải permission layer.B❌Data shaping at ingest là OpenPipeline. SRG không transform telemetry.C❌Agent deployment là Operator/deployment tooling — tách khỏi SRG.D✅SRG là gate “release looks safe” dựa trên SLOs, errors, performance platform đã có.E❌SRG không phải dashboard library — là release và change guard.
Giải thích tổng thể:
SRG là automated quality gate cho releases/changes — evaluate signals đã collect và cho pass/fail pipeline.
Liên kết: Site Reliability Guardian · SLO · Workflows



Câu hỏi 3 — Release markers benefits
Which of the following are real benefits of ingesting release markers (for example, PR merges or deploy events) into Dynatrace? (Select all that apply)

                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Canonical: ingest → reason → act.B❌Static snapshots outdated ngay khi system đổi.C❌Dashboard PDF là reporting artefact, không automation loop.D❌Region/cache là ops details, không end-to-end shape.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Ingest → decide → act. OpenPipeline vào Grail, Davis/DQL evaluate, Workflows respond.
Liên kết: OpenPipeline · Grail · Davis AI · Workflows · DQL



Câu hỏi 27 — DQL task and conditional notify
A workflow uses a DQL task to compute an error rate, then decides whether to notify. What enables that decision?

A. Automatic topology discovery in OneAgent that decides at runtime whether to fire the alert
B. Deep code injection inside the monitored application that signals the workflow when a threshold breaks
C. Conditional transitions that branch based on the output of a previous task
D. A dashboard variable selector configured on the same tenant that stores the last query result



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: C






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌Topology discovery là OneAgent — không workflow control flow.B❌Code injection cho observability, không workflow branching.C✅Error-rate value → condition → next branch.D❌Dashboard variables là UI binding, không drive workflow.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Conditional transitions evaluate output tasks trước (như DQL result) — native decision mechanism.
Liên kết: Workflows · DQL



Câu hỏi 28 — OpenPipeline routing rule use case
Which of the following is a legitimate reason to use an OpenPipeline routing rule?

A. Sending security-relevant logs to a bucket with long retention while dev logs go to a short-retention bucket
B. Bypassing authentication on ingest requests that arrive from inside the customer’s corporate network
C. Forcing every log line the tenant receives into a single bucket so downstream queries only need to target one dataset
D. Redirecting queries that target Grail to a different storage backend at read time based on the user issuing them



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Textbook routing: data khác nhau → retention/access/cost khác nhau.B❌Routing không control authentication — credentials mọi ingest path.C❌Single-bucket defeats purpose buckets — needs khác nhau.D❌Routing trên ingest path, không read-time redirection.
Giải thích tổng thể:
Routing split data vào buckets theo nature (security, dev, audit) với retention/permissions phù hợp.
Liên kết: OpenPipeline · Grail



Câu hỏi 29 — Webhook SDLC HTTP 401
In a webhook-based SDLC ingestion scenario, what is the most common cause of an HTTP 401 response?

A. A DQL query inside the paired workflow uses the wrong summarize clause for its dataset
B. Authentication is missing or invalid, for example a bad token or a misconfigured auth header
C. OneAgent on the sending host is older than the tenant’s minimum required version
D. The ingest payload uses a JSON schema that has not yet been registered on the tenant’s OpenPipeline configuration
E. Too many parallel branches in the workflow overload the ingest endpoint and trigger 401



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: B



































#Kết quảGiải thíchA❌DQL syntax không produce 401 — errors ở read time tenant side.B✅401 = authentication failure: missing, expired, malformed credential.C❌Agent version issues là errors khác, không 401.D❌Unregistered schema thường parsing error payload, không 401 auth layer.E❌Branch count không đổi auth status — 401 là credential problem.
Giải thích tổng thể:
401 at ingest ≈ credentials: header, token, scope. Check request webhook thực sự gửi.
Liên kết: OpenPipeline · Workflows



Câu hỏi 30 — OpenPipeline definition
OpenPipeline is best described as:

A. The ingestion and processing layer that prepares data for Grail so it is queryable and usable
B. A UI dashboard builder dedicated to presenting automation outcomes to business stakeholders
C. A tool that exclusively collects infrastructure metrics and does not handle logs or events
D. A replacement for OneAgent code modules that takes over host-side instrumentation entirely



                  
                  💡 Đáp án & Giải thích 
                  
                

✅ Đáp án đúng: A






























#Kết quảGiải thíchA✅Validates, transforms, routes, loads data vào Grail.B❌Không phải dashboard builder — Notebooks/Dashboards riêng.C❌Logs, events, metrics, business events — nhiều source types.D❌OpenPipeline sau signals produced — không replace OneAgent.
Giải thích tổng thể:
OpenPipeline = configurable ingestion layer vào Grail: parse, enrich, mask, route — đúng shape cho DQL và Workflows.
Liên kết: OpenPipeline · Grail · DQL · Workflows




📚 Tổng hợp kiến thức — Automation & Data Processing


                  
                  NOTE
                  
                

Phần này tổng hợp các điểm kiến thức cốt lõi được rút ra từ toàn bộ câu hỏi trong file. Dùng để ôn nhanh trước khi thi.


🔄 OpenPipeline — Ingestion & Processing Layer

Định nghĩa: configurable ingestion và processing layer chuẩn bị data cho Grail
Vị trí: nằm TRƯỚC Grail — nhận data IN, process, route vào đúng bucket
Không phải: dashboard builder, storage layer, OneAgent replacement

Ingest sources được hỗ trợ:

✅ OneAgent signals (metrics, logs, events)
✅ OpenTelemetry / OTLP
✅ Webhooks (SDLC events từ GitHub, GitLab)
✅ Third-party APIs (extension-driven hoặc pull-scheduled)
❌ KHÔNG: direct database binlogs, raw SNMP traps không qua forwarder

Processing rules use cases:

✅ Mask PII trước khi persist vào Grail (at ingest — không phải query time)
✅ Normalize schemas giữa các source heterogeneous → DQL queries đơn giản hơn
✅ Route: security logs → long-retention bucket; dev logs → short-retention bucket
✅ Sample high-volume data, drop low-value events
❌ KHÔNG thay authentication, KHÔNG tự tạo dashboards

SDLC webhooks:

Events từ GitHub qua webhook → OpenPipeline → Grail (events/SDLC dataset)
Queryable bằng DQL, dùng trong Workflows và dashboards
HTTP 401 on webhook = authentication missing/invalid (bad token, misconfigured auth header)

⚙️ Workflows — Automation Engine
Workflow = Tasks + Transitions

Task: single executable step — DQL query, HTTP request, Slack, Jira, ServiceNow…
Transitions: conditional branches quyết định flow tiếp theo dựa trên task output

Trigger types:





























TypeMô tảEvent/Problem triggerDavis mở problem → workflow fireScheduled triggerCron-style cadence (daily report, weekly cleanup)Manual triggerUser start từ UI với sample payload❌ Query-timeDQL query KHÔNG trigger workflow❌ Dashboard openRendering UI KHÔNG trigger
Design patterns:





























PatternDùng choParallel branchesHai tasks độc lập chạy đồng thờiFor-each / LoopCùng task lặp trên list (services, entities, tickets)Conditional transitionsBranch dựa trên output của task trước (e.g. DQL error rate)Retry configChống transient failures (network blip, temporary 5xx)DeduplicationAct only on first occurrence of problem (condition + timebox)
Jinja templating:

Inject dynamic strings và JSON payloads từ variables + previous task outputs
Dùng cho: problem IDs, entity names, metric values → Slack messages, Jira tickets, HTTP bodies
❌ KHÔNG: security primitive, service discovery

Security best practices:

API token scopes: least-privilege — chỉ scope mà workflow thực sự cần
Secrets: lưu trong Dynatrace credential mechanism, reference by ID — KHÔNG hard-code, KHÔNG base64 encode
Testing: non-production environment + manual trigger + sample payload → arm real triggers sau

Execution history:

Audit trail: mỗi run, inputs, outputs, final status per task
❌ KHÔNG thay Grail telemetry store

📊 SLO — Service Level Objectives
SLO definition = 3 thành phần:

SLI (Service Level Indicator): thứ đo — fraction of successful requests
Objective: target — e.g. 99.9%
Evaluation window: rolling 7-day, 28-day…

Sound SLO alerting practices:

✅ Burn-rate windows (short + long) — bắt fast regression VÀ slow leak
✅ Supporting context (error-rate trends, release markers) → actionable alerts
❌ KHÔNG: flat compliance threshold (bỏ qua burn rate)

🛡️ Site Reliability Guardian (SRG)

Vai trò: automated quality gate cho releases/changes
Evaluate: SLOs, error rate, performance — cho pass/fail vào pipeline
Kết hợp với Workflows: SRG guard fails → trigger Workflows rollback/notification/remediation
❌ KHÔNG phải: permission layer, data converter, dashboard library

📍 Release Markers

Ingest deploy/PR merge events vào Dynatrace
Benefits:

✅ Audit trail joined với Davis problems trên timeline
✅ Correlate performance/reliability shifts với specific deployments



🔁 End-to-End Pattern
Signals → Grail (qua OpenPipeline)
    → Davis AI / DQL (detect/evaluate)
    → Workflows (notify/remediate)


Canonical shape: Ingest → Reason → Act
Impacted services trong problem: dùng Smartscape topology (live entity relationships)

⚡ Các điểm hay nhầm lẫn

Base64 ≠ encryption — KHÔNG dùng để “bảo vệ” secrets
Retry ≠ deduplication — retry cho transient errors; deduplication cho repeated triggers
Parallel branches ≠ loops — parallel = concurrency; loop = sequential iteration trên list
PII masking phải ở ingest (OpenPipeline) — không phải query time hay Workflow task
SRG + Workflows = complementary, không phải thay thế nhau
DQL query KHÔNG trigger workflows — chỉ là read operation
HTTP 401 = auth problem (không phải payload schema, không phải agent version)

Liên kết: OpenPipeline · Grail · Workflows · SLO · Site Reliability Guardian · Release Markers · DQL · Davis AI · Smartscape · Jinja · API Tokens · Business Events · Jira · Problems

02---areas/observability/dynatrace/assoc.title: Associate Practice Test 01 — Full Mock (tick answers)
02---areas/observability/dynatrace/assoc.content:
Associate Practice Test 01 — Full Mock


                  
                  NOTE
                  
                

Bản đề 60 câu được format từ dump practice test (file Test01). Dùng checkbox để đánh dấu đáp án bạn chọn trong Obsidian (Live Preview / Reading).

Một lựa chọn: chỉ nên tick một ô (hoặc tick ô bạn nghi là đúng rồi đối chiếu sau).
Chọn nhiều: đề trong tiêu đề có Select all that apply — được tick nhiều ô.




Q01 - Which Dynatrace app is used to monitor database types, database resources, and the most resource-intensive statements in the environment?

 A. Database extensions
 B. Databases
 C. Clouds
 D. Hosts


Q02 - Which of the following tools or technologies can be used to ingest data into Dynatrace, either directly or through integration? Select all that apply

 A. Network protocol analyzers
 B. OpenTelemetry
 C. OneAgent
 D. Kubernetes
 E. Extensions


Q03 - Deploying a Dynatrace Operator on a Kubernetes cluster will… (Select all that apply)

 A. Automatically restart unhealthy application pods
 B. Provide Kubernetes observability
 C. Allow anomaly detection
 D. Deploy an ActiveGate on that Kubernetes cluster
 E. Deploy the easytravel application for demonstration purposes


Q04 - If we fully monitor our Kubernetes cluster, what benefits will we observe? Select all that apply

 A. Anomaly detection
 B. Prometheus metrics
 C. Full-Stack observability
 D. Application logs
 E. Kubernetes native events ingestion
 F. Automated incident remediation


Q05 - What is the Dynatrace Operator used for?

 A. Automating the rollout and lifecycle management of the Dynatrace components
 B. Automating the deployment and scaling of Kubernetes applications
 C. Orchestrating containerized applications across multiple cloud environments
 D. Monitoring and managing Kubernetes cluster health and performance


Q06 - Which OneAgent monitoring mode is primarily used to achieve comprehensive visibility across the entire infrastructure, focusing on host and process metrics?

 A. Infrastructure Monitoring mode
 B. Application-Only Monitoring mode
 C. Network-Only Monitoring mode
 D. Full-Stack Monitoring mode


Q07 - Which OpenTelemetry ingestion method does not require other installed components or services?

 A. OneAgent ingest endpoint
 B. Collector
 C. ActiveGate ingest API
 D. SaaS ingest API


Q08 - Which feature of Dynatrace helps in blocking attacks in real-time?

 A. Runtime Vulnerability Analytics
 B. Security Posture Management
 C. Code-Level Vulnerability Detection
 D. Runtime Application Protection


Q09 - Which of the following are functionalities of the Dynatrace platform? Select all that apply

 A. Application Observability
 B. Customer Relationship Management
 C. Supply Chain Management
 D. Business Analytics
 E. Digital Experience
 F. Infrastructure Observability


Q10 - What does this definition refer to? “A quick and efficient visualization of all the topological dependencies in your infrastructure, processes, and services”

 A. Service flow
 B. Distributed traces
 C. Davis AI
 D. Smartscape


Q11 - In the context of distributed traces, what is a span?

 A. A user session that tracks all activities performed by a user during their visit to the application
 B. An instance of an executed computer program
 C. A type of database query that retrieves user information from a server
 D. A record of an interaction between a request and a service, triggered by the activity of a request moving through and across multiple services


Q12 - Which layer is NOT part of Dynatrace Smartscape’s five-layer observability?

 A. Applications
 B. Databases
 C. Hosts
 D. Services


Q13 - Which of the following can be analyzed using Multidimensional Analysis? Select all that apply

 A. Configuration analysis
 B. Top web requests
 C. Security vulnerabilities
 D. Network traffic patterns
 E. Database statements
 F. Exception analysis


Q14 - Which of the following is a benefit of using Service Backtrace?

 A. It provides insights into user session data
 B. It monitors database performance
 C. It helps in understanding which services directly call a particular back-end service
 D. It manages user access


Q15 - What is the primary purpose of Dynatrace Service Flow?

 A. To visualize the sequence of service calls triggered by each service request
 B. To monitor host performance
 C. To manage security vulnerabilities
 D. To analyze user sessions


Q16 - Which of the following are supported application types in Dynatrace? Select all that apply

 A. Web applications
 B. Desktop applications
 C. Mainframe applications
 D. Mobile applications
 E. Custom applications


Q17 - What are public Synthetic locations used for?

 A. To run synthetic monitors from various global locations owned by Dynatrace
 B. To monitor real user interactions from different geographical regions
 C. To create virtual environments using the Dynatrace Cloud Emulator
 D. To be able to monitor internal applications or APIs


Q18 - Which of the following can be analyzed within a user session in Dynatrace? Select all that apply

 A. Database schema changes
 B. Application server backend specifications
 C. User location
 D. User firewall settings
 E. Session duration
 F. User actions


Q19 - Which of the following best describes a load action in Dynatrace?

 A. Measure the duration time of the JavaScript code
 B. A user action that involves loading a new page or refreshing an existing one
 C. An action that tracks the user’s mouse movements across the page
 D. A custom action defined through JavaScript API to measure specific user interactions like opening a drop-down menu


Q20 - When would it make sense to use agentless RUM?

 A. To monitor an application when you cannot modify the HTML
 B. To enable session replay
 C. To minimize monitoring overhead
 D. To monitor databases with minimum overhead
 E. To monitor an application when you can’t install a OneAgent on the frontend servers
 F. Agentless RUM is not possible


Q21 - How does Session Replay in Dynatrace help improve user experience?

 A. By capturing and replaying user interactions to identify usability issues and errors
 B. By monitoring server CPU and memory usage
 C. By providing insights into user behavior and interaction patterns
 D. By creating a simulated user journey accross a web application


Q22 - A business team was shown an interesting report using USQL in the Dynatrace Platform. However, they usually use other tools to further explore the data. What can be done about this?

 A. User session exports can be set up in the general settings
 B. Nothing, the recommendation will always be to use Dynatrace for analysis
 C. Raw Dynatrace data will need to be injected to their platform and the query will need to be adjusted


Q23 - The Business team wants to make sure the shopping cart on their application provides a good experience to end users. Does Dynatrace have any functionality to give higher importance to certain page loads or actions?

 A. Yes, the overall DEM experience would provide that
 B. Yes, this would be the Distributed Traces
 C. Yes, this would be the Conversion Goals
 D. Yes, this would be the Key User Actions


Q24 - What is Waterfall analysis used for?

 A. To monitor overall page load times without breaking down individual resources
 B. To track the number of user sessions
 C. To visualize user emotions during page load
 D. To analyze the loading times of individual resources in user actions


Q25 - Which of the following statements is true regarding Apdex? Select all that apply

 A. Apdex is always based on the key performance metric only
 B. Apdex is always based on key performance metrics thresholds and errors that impact user experience.
 C. Apdex is calculated for every user action and application
 D. Apdex is calculated only at application level


Q26 - One of the mobile applications monitored in Dynatrace is receiving negative reviews on the App Store due to poor user experience. Is there a way to visually reproduce these user experiences?

 A. Yes, using Session Replay, but only on crashes
 B. No, Session Replay is not available for mobile apps
 C. Yes, using Session Replay


Q27 - What is Business Analytics used for?

 A. To monitor and analyze the health, performance, and availability of the entire IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, and cloud environments
 B. To monitor and analyze the performance, health, and behavior of applications, ensuring they run smoothly and efficiently
 C. To track and analyze the performance and behavior of real users interacting with an application in real-time to enhance their experience
 D. To connect application performance and user experience data to business metrics


Q28 - What is the purpose of credential vaults in synthetic monitors?

 A. To store and manage credentials securely for synthetic monitors
 B. To encrypt test results for enhanced security
 C. To cache frequently accessed data for faster test execution
 D. To manage network configurations for synthetic monitors


Q29 - Where can the details of a synthetic monitor in Synthetic Classic be found? (Type, device, frequency, locations…)

 A. Under “properties” of the synthetic monitor
 B. In the configuration, after select “edit”
 C. After a successful execution, in the execution details


Q30 - What are log events used for in Dynatrace?

 A. To monitor network traffic
 B. To generate an alert based on an error in the logs
 C. To schedule maintenance tasks
 D. To manage user permissions


Q31 - The leadership team is hesitant about implementing Log Management and Analytics with Dynatrace due to concerns that the logs of their applications contain sensitive information, such as email addresses or credit card details. What strategies could be employed to address these concerns and convince them of the benefits?

 A. The leadership team is right, it’s not safe to monitor the application logs if that’s the case
 B. Explaining they can use masking rules to mask sensitive information at capture, and processing rules to mask it at ingest
 C. Explaining that Dynatrace will mask this information at display, although the information will still be stored in Dynatrace’s storage
 D. Explaining that Dynatrace’s Application Security can remediate these risks


Q32 - In what situations should the parameters dt.trace_id and dt.span_id be manually included in logs?

 A. When OneAgent can’t be installed, but log data need to be linked to traces
 B. When the business events OneAgent captures need to be linked to logs
 C. When logs are captured using OneAgent, but need to be linked to traces


Q33 - OneAgent is being used to capture logs. What is a possible reason why the logs are not present in the Dynatrace environment?

 A. Log Management and Analytics needs to be purchased separately
 B. Log ingest rules haven’t been set up at a global level
 C. Log sources are not enabled
 D. Log Monitoring has been disabled at a process group level


Q34 - When does log processing happen?

 A. After data is stored in Grail, when displayed in a raw format
 B. When data arrives in the environment, before it’s stored in Grail
 C. When logs are queried in a Notebook using DQL
 D. Only when logs are captured using an extension


Q35 - Which of the following are use cases for log processing rules? Select all that apply

 A. Mask sensitive information in a log content
 B. Create a log metric out of a log record
 C. Alert based on a log pattern
 D. Transform log data. For example, add extra fields to a log record


Q36 - What can be used to send Dynatrace-detected Problems to Jira?

 A. Problems API
 B. Configuration API
 C. Problem notifications
 D. It can’t be done


Q37 - What options are available for adjusting anomaly detection for services? Select all that apply

 A. CPU time increase
 B. Service load spikes
 C. Slow disk reading times
 D. Service load drops
 E. Failure rate increase
 F. Response time degradation


Q38 - Which are existing event categories in Dynatrace, that result in a creation of a new problem? Select all that apply

 A. Error
 B. Resource
 C. Availability
 D. Warning
 E. Failure
 F. Issue


Q39 - What might be found in the Business Impact Analysis of a problem in Dynatrace? Select all that apply

 A. Impacted users
 B. CPU and memory utilization
 C. Affected service calls
 D. Server uptime
 E. Database query performance


Q40 - If you get a failure rate increase problem, what tool can you use to analyze the problem?

 A. Process crash analysis
 B. Continuous CPU profiling
 C. Memory dump
 D. Failure analysis


Q41 - What is the primary purpose of the Dynatrace HUB?

 A. To monitor network traffic and security
 B. To offer training and certification programs for Dynatrace users
 C. To manage user access and permissions within Dynatrace
 D. To provide a marketplace for official Dynatrace apps and extensions


Q42 - Some of the Azure Virtual Machines available on the Clouds app are not present on the Hosts page. What could be the reason for that?

 A. This situation is impossible
 B. The OneAgent isn’t installed on those VMs
 C. The ActiveGate isn’t connected to Azure Monitor
 D. It’s missing an extension to connect both apps


Q43 - What is used to remotely monitor technologies in Dynatrace Extensions?

 A. Dynatrace Operator
 B. ActiveGates
 C. OneAgent
 D. OpenTelemetry


Q44 - Is there any way to detect anomalies with Kubernetes resources?

 A. No
 B. Yes, by connecting the Kubernetes cluster to Dynatrace and enabling the anomaly detection
 C. Yes, by setting up log events
 D. Yes, if it has been detected in a Kubernetes native event


Q45 - Which of the following is a reason for muting a vulnerability in Dynatrace?

 A. The vulnerability is a false positive
 B. The vulnerability is ignored
 C. The vulnerability is resolved
 D. The vulnerability is critical


Q46 - When would it be beneficial to ingest monitoring data using extensions in Dynatrace?

 A. To enable real-time user session analysis
 B. When OneAgent is not installed
 C. To improve server hardware tracking
 D. To enhance network performance monitoring


Q47 - Is Full-Stack Monitoring necessary for database servers?

 A. Yes, but only if you need code-level details
 B. Yes, if you need infrastructure-level metrics
 C. No, Infrastructure Monitoring mode will provide the same functionalities


Q48 - Is OneAgent required to capture distributed traces?

 A. No, OpenTelemetry, OpenTracing, and OneAgent SDK can also be used
 B. No, agentless RUM can also be used
 C. Yes


Q49 - A business team wants to monitor the percentage of users who purchase an item on their website out of the total number of users. Which of the following could be used? Select all that apply

 A. Conversion goal based on a specific user action
 B. Conversion goal based on destination URL
 C. Conversion goal based on user session duration
 D. Conversion goal based on number of user actions


Q50 - What would you use to analyze the user action performance across continents and OS types?

 A. Notebooks with DQL
 B. Waterfall analysis
 C. User session queries with USQL
 D. Dashboards with DQL


Q51 - A synthetic monitor local outage problem has been created. What does this mean?

 A. All the synthetic monitors are experiencing slowdowns
 B. The synthetic monitor is unavailable at all configured locations
 C. The synthetic monitor is unavailable for one or more consecutive runs at any location
 D. One of the synthetic monitors is experiencing an increase in traffic


Q52 - What metric is described by the definition: ‘A point-in-time measurement indicating when the visual area of a page has fully loaded’?

 A. Visually complete
 B. User action duration
 C. Speed index
 D. Failure rate


Q53 - What’s the benefit of executing synthetic monitors on-demand?

 A. To check how real users experience the webpage
 B. To be able to automate the executions as part of a CI/CD pipeline
 C. To run the monitors at specific intervals, ensuring continuous validation of application performance and availability
 D. To discard previously-executed monitors


Q54 - What is needed to monitor the availability of an internal API endpoint via synthetic monitors? Select all that apply

 A. An HTTP monitor
 B. One of Dynatrace’s global network of public locations
 C. An up-to-date Chromium browser
 D. A private location
 E. A dedicated synthetic-enabled ActiveGate


Q55 - How can Business Events be captured?

 A. Using Bizevents detection rules
 B. Remotely, using an ActiveGate
 C. Using OneAgent
 D. Using the Dynatrace API
 E. Using the RUM JavaScript API


Q56 - A security notification has just been received via email, indicating that the environment has some vulnerabilities. What steps should be taken to begin addressing these issues?

 A. The solution is to always restart the server
 B. Check Davis Security Advisor and apply the recommended actions
 C. SSH to the affected servers and update the OS
 D. File a support ticket to the Dynatrace support team. This needs to be escalated


Q57 - What is the easiest way of displaying a Kubernetes resource metric (CPU, memory,…) on a dashboard?

 A. By using the shortcut hyperlink available on the documentation. The dashboard is built just with one click
 B. The only way to do it is by using Data Explorer to query the metric
 C. The only way to do it is by manually typing a DQL query
 D. By finding the desired metric in the Kubernetes app, and selecting “Pin to dashboard”


Q58 - What is the purpose of auto-adaptive thresholds in Dynatrace?

 A. To set fixed limits for metrics
 B. To analyze user sessions
 C. To dynamically adjust thresholds based on metric behavior
 D. To monitor network traffic


Q59 - Where can assistance with deploying a custom extension be found?

 A. Support Center
 B. Dynatrace University events
 C. Dynatrace Community
 D. Dynatrace Developer
 E. Documentation


Q60 - The easytravel application team wants to create a dashboard to display the evolution over time of logs with error status. Which of the following could be done? (Select all that apply)

 A. Query the dt.error.log.status metric in Data Explorer and pin it to a dashboard
 B. Build a DQL query that filters by error logs and counts the occurances, and add the query to a dashboard
 C. Create a log event and pin the event on a dashboard
 D. Create a log metric and pin the log metric on a dashboard

02---areas/observability/dynatrace/assoc.content:
Dynatrace Associate — Hub nghiên cứu câu hỏi trắc nghiệm (MCQ Theory)


                  
                  TL;DR 
                  
                


Phần theory gồm ~60 câu MCQ, thời gian 45 phút (theo report Georgi T11/2025).
Dạng câu: single-choice và multiple-choice (“select all that apply”). Đề ghi rõ khi multi-select.
Trend 2026: tăng câu hỏi về Grail, DQL, OpenPipeline, gen3 apps, Workflows, BizEvents. Giảm câu về Managed deployment, classic dashboards.
Câu hỏi thường ở dạng scenario-based: “User X báo cáo vấn đề Y, bạn nên dùng feature nào?”
Nhiều câu hỏi về con số cụ thể: retention periods, timeout values, port numbers.
